穆日玛尼石经墙

Muri Mani Wall
国家级 唐—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty唐—清
地址 Address甘孜藏族自治州石渠县
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 石经 布局 雕刻

中文描述 Description

穆日玛尼石经墙位于甘孜州石渠县格蒙乡，距县城55公里，海拔4300米。

石经墙始建于7—8世纪，称最初被称为奔琼玉喀。

10—11世纪成为当时岭国的皇家供奉圣物，成为重要的朝圣场所。

18世纪第一世穆日活佛仁增江措仁波切主持维修和扩建玛尼墙，后人为了纪念他的功绩，将古玛尼墙改称为穆日玛尼石经墙。

今天的石经墙全长450米，宽9-15米，高2-2.5米，以上千年来累积的无数石板石块堆积而成，石头上既刻有千手千眼观音、宗喀巴大师、莲花生大师、度母等各式佛像近千尊，也有大藏经《甘珠尔》《解脱经》《阿弥陀佛经》《贤劫经》《般若八千诵》《白莲花经》《金刚经》《心经》《长寿经》《普贤行愿品》等无数经文石刻，而雕满六字真言的玛尼石就更是不计其数了。

甚至是更为古老的苯教经文、咒语与神像都凝聚了深厚的宗教虔诚，墙体虽不高大，但是其沉重的历史沉淀仍然震慑人心。

当代乡民仍然保有环绕日经墙转经，获得祝福的信仰传统。

英文翻译 English Translation

Muri Mani Wall is located in Gemeng Township, Shiqu County, Garze Prefecture, 55km from the county seat at 4,300m elevation.

Founded in the 7th-8th century, originally called Benqiong Yuka.

In the 10th-11th century it became a royal offering sacred object of the Ling Kingdom and an important pilgrimage site.

In the 18th century, the 1st Muri Living Buddha Renzeng Jiangcuo Renboqie presided over maintenance and expansion; later generations renamed it Muri Mani Wall in his honor.

Today the wall is 450m long, 9-15m wide, 2-2.5m tall, built from countless stone slabs accumulated over a millennium, carved with nearly a thousand Buddha images and countless scripture inscriptions including the Kangyur, Liberation Sutra, Amitabha Sutra, Bhadrakalpika Sutra, Prajna 8000 Verses, White Lotus Sutra, Diamond Sutra, Heart Sutra, Longevity Sutra, and Samantabhadra Vows.

Even ancient Bon religion scriptures, mantras, and deity images are preserved.

Local people still maintain the tradition of circumambulating the wall for blessings.

松格嘛呢石经城和巴格嘛呢石经墙

Songge Mani Stone Mound and Bage Mani Wall
国家级 明—清 城墙
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address甘孜藏族自治州石渠县境内扎溪卡草原
类型 Type城墙
看点 Highlights: 石砌建筑 佛像 佛塔

中文描述 Description

松格嘛呢石经城和巴格嘛呢石经墙位于四川石渠县境内扎溪卡草原上。

其中松格嘛呢石经城位于阿日扎乡六村境内，巴格嘛呢墙则位于长沙贡马乡，距石渠县城大约60公里。

松格嘛呢石经城与巴格嘛呢石经墙均为典型的藏传佛教嘛呢石堆砌建筑。

前者始建于11—12世纪格萨尔王时期。

相传为了缅怀格萨尔王功绩，纪念战死的将士而砌筑成嘛呢堆，随后规模不断扩大，最终超越单纯的嘛呢堆与石经墙而扩展成为按照佛教经典坛城布局的石经城。

目前整个石经城高度在4—13.6米，上部体量向内缩进呈塔形。

石经城平面为长方形，长边长约70米，短边40—50米，周长共计228米。

城内壁面上挖有许多佛龛，其中供奉着各式石刻佛像，艺术价值极高。

石经城内道路狭窄崎岖，供乡民转经所用，中心位置是由五块圆石所覆盖的井眼，气氛神秘。

巴格嘛呢石经墙始建于17世纪，目前全长1.6公里，厚2—3米，墙身最高处约3米。

石经墙由石片砌筑而成，其石片上刻有各式佛像3000多尊，以及藏文经典《甘珠尔》与《丹珠尔》的刻石。

石经墙每隔一段距离就有几座佛塔，给予石墙更为丰富的建筑内容。

经过数百年持续不断的堆砌延伸，今天的巴格嘛呢墙已经是世界上最长的嘛呢石经墙之一。

英文翻译 English Translation

Songge Mani Stone Mound and Bage Mani Wall are located on the Zhaxika Grassland in Shiqu County, Garze Prefecture.

Songge Mani Stone City is in Liucun, Arizha Township; Bage Mani Wall is in Changshagongma Township, about 60km from Shiqu County seat.

Both are typical Tibetan Buddhist mani stone pile structures.

Songge was founded in the 11th-12th century during King Gesar's era.

Legend says it was built as a mani pile to commemorate King Gesar's achievements and fallen soldiers, then expanded beyond a simple mani pile/wall into a stone city laid out as a Buddhist mandala.

Today the stone city is 4-13.6m tall, with upper portion tapering inward in pagoda form.

Rectangular plan: long side ~70m, short side 40-50m, perimeter 228m.

Interior walls have many niches enshrining various stone-carved Buddha images of high artistic value.

Narrow winding paths for circumambulation; center has a well covered by five round stones, creating a mysterious atmosphere.

Bage Mani Wall was founded in the 17th century, currently 1.6km long, 2-3m thick, max height 3m.

Built from stone slabs carved with over 3,000 Buddha images and Tibetan Kangyur and Tengyur scriptures.

Several pagodas at intervals enrich the architectural content.

After centuries of continuous extension, Bage Mani Wall is today one of the world's longest mani stone walls.

八邦寺

Babang Temple
国家级 宋 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty宋
地址 Address甘孜藏族自治州德格县八邦乡然青村
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 藏式建筑 彩绘 雕像

中文描述 Description

德格八邦寺，位于德格县八邦乡政府北300米处的山冈上，海拔3800米，寺名八邦意为财富集中人杰地灵之地。

八邦寺原为止贡噶举派创始人止贡巴仁钦贝的弟子巴登向秋能巴于13世纪中叶所建，当时取名为巴雄秋能。

清雍正七年(1729年)，由德格土司登巴泽仁聘请西藏噶玛寺第八世司徒活佛重建，是噶玛噶举派在康区的主要道场，与西藏楚布寺并称噶玛噶举派两大圣地。

八邦寺规模宏大，因坐落在山丘之上，建筑依山势而建，层层叠叠，此起彼伏，因而有小布达拉宫之称。

寺庙坐北朝南，院落布局，主殿卓拉空建在山脊之上，为两进合院式的三层藏式建筑。

殿高24米，内有八根整树成形的巨柱，气势雄浑。

除了殿堂外，卓拉空中还有转经廊、护法殿、活佛寝宫、藏经阁、灵塔、管事房等设施，功能复杂，却秩序井然。

作为德格土司第一家庙，八邦寺建筑群，尤其是卓拉空主殿尺度巨大，气象宏伟，装饰华丽，金碧辉煌。

寺庙凭借山势，参差错落，经幡飘舞之间，尽显噶举派佛教传统的庄严与神秘。

除了建筑之外，八邦寺所藏各类佛像数千尊，以及唐卡上万幅，典籍刻板12万余块都是无价之宝，对于研究康区佛教与民俗文化历史是极其珍贵的史料。

英文翻译 English Translation

Babang Temple is located on a hill 300m north of Babang Township government, Dege County, at 3,800m elevation.

The name Babang means a place of concentrated wealth and outstanding people.

Originally founded in the mid-13th century by Baden Qiuqiunengba, disciple of Drigungpa Rinchen Pal (founder of the Drigung Kagyu school), then named Baxiong Qiuneng.

In the 7th year of Yongzheng (1729), Dege chieftain Dengba Zeren invited the 8th Situ Rinpoche from Tibet's Karma Temple to rebuild it.

It is the main Kagyu school monastery in Kham region, and together with Tibet's Tsurphu Monastery, one of the two great Kagyu sacred sites.

The temple is large-scale, built on a hill following the terrain in layered, undulating formation — hence called Little Potala Palace.

Facing south with courtyard layout, the main hall Zhuolakong sits on the ridge, a two-courtyard three-story Tibetan-style building, 24m tall with eight giant columns carved from whole trees.

Beyond the main hall, Zhuolakong contains scripture-circumambulation corridors, protector hall, living Buddha's chambers, scripture library, reliquary stupas, and administration offices — complex but orderly.

As the first family temple of the Dege chieftain, the complex especially the main hall has monumental scale, grandeur, and resplendent decoration.

Set against the mountain with fluttering prayer flags, it embodies the solemnity and mystery of Kagyu Buddhism.

The temple houses thousands of Buddha statues, tens of thousands of thangkas, and over 120,000 woodblock printing plates — priceless materials for studying Kham Buddhist and folk cultural history.

德格印经院

Dege Sutra-printing House (Dege Parkhan)
国家级 清 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address甘孜藏族自治州德格县
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 藏式建筑 经书 印刷

中文描述 Description

德格印经院地处四川省甘孜州德格县更庆镇，全名扎西果芒大法库印经院，又称德格聚慧经院，由德格第十二代土司巴泽仁于清雍正七年(1729年)始建，后历经数次维修，始成今日的规模，现位于藏传佛教萨迦派寺院更庆寺内。

自18世纪建立以来，德格印经院就一直是藏传佛教典籍雕版印刷的中心。

数百年来持续刻印各教派经文，尤以《大藏经》最为精美，举世闻名。

至今院内仍然保留木刻雕版21.7万块，均为桦木刻制，雕刻精美，字迹清晰。

如此规模的刻板收藏以及持续的印经活动，让德格印经院名列藏区三大印经院之首，更让其成为当之无愧的世界级的宗教文化瑰宝。

印经院建筑坐北朝南，占地约1640平方米，是一座合院布局的三层藏式密梁平顶建筑，总建筑面积达5450平方米。

建筑内院四周高度不一，轮廓丰富，最低的是南侧大门，仅有二层。

穿过大门即见印经院早期建筑经堂。

经堂建在高2.68米的土台之上，面阔14.6米，进深8.8米，殿内绘制有佛像壁画以及德格土司登巴泽仁传略壁画。

印经院主要功能用房位于建筑第二、三层，其中经板库最为巨大，占有6间，库中藏有内容涵盖宗教、医学、历史、艺术、工艺技术等各个方面的木刻雕版，不少雕版所刻内容甚至是举世无双的孤本。

德格印经院不仅是藏族雕版印刷文化的杰出代表，也是人类文化传播史上的一件活的文物，伴随着人们持续刻印藏传经典，这一伟大的文化传统还将继续传承下去。

1996年，德格印经院被国务院正式列为全国重点文物保护单位。

英文翻译 English Translation

Dege Sutra-printing House (Dege Parkhan) is located in Gengqing Town, Dege County, Garze Prefecture.

Full name: Tashi Gomang Great Dharma Treasury Printing House, also called Dege Juhui Scripture House.

Founded by the 12th Dege chieftain Bazeren in the 7th year of Yongzheng (1729), repaired several times to reach today's scale.

Located within Gengqing Monastery of the Sakya school.

Since its 18th-century founding, Dege Parkhan has been the center of Tibetan Buddhist woodblock printing.

For centuries it has continuously printed scriptures of all schools, especially the magnificent Kangyur (Tripitaka), world-renowned.

Today it preserves 217,000 woodblocks, all carved from birch, with exquisite carving and clear script.

This scale of woodblock collection and continuous printing activity makes Dege Parkhan the foremost of the three great Tibetan printing houses and a truly world-class religious cultural treasure.

The building faces south, covering ~1,640 sq m, a three-story Tibetan-style courtyard building with dense beams and flat roof, total 5,450 sq m.

Interior courtyard walls vary in height; the lowest is the south gate at only two stories.

Beyond the gate is the early scripture hall, built on a 2.68m earthen platform, 14.6m wide, 8.8m deep, with Buddha murals and a mural biography of Dege chieftain Dengba Zeren.

Main functional rooms are on the 2nd and 3rd floors; the woodblock library is the largest, occupying 6 rooms, housing woodblocks covering religion, medicine, history, art, and technology — many are unique unica found nowhere else.

Dege Parkhan is not only an outstanding representative of Tibetan woodblock printing culture but also a living artifact in human cultural transmission history.

Designated a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit by the State Council in 1996.

白玉噶托寺

Kathok Temple in Baiyu
国家级 南宋 建筑群、宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty南宋
地址 Address甘孜藏族自治州白玉县河坡乡公布村
类型 Type建筑群、宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 远瞻 藏式建筑 雕像 佛教文化

中文描述 Description

白玉噶托寺位于甘孜州白玉县河坡乡公布村，距白玉县城51公里，系藏传佛教宁玛派(红教)六大寺院之一，也是康区宁玛派最大的朝拜圣地。

这所寺院由宁玛派高僧嘎·当巴德西修建于南宋绍兴二年(1132年)。

噶托的藏语意思是噶字上面，传说原寺址有一巨大白石，石上天然形成了一藏文字，读音为噶，寺庙因此而得名。

噶托寺现为康区第一大寺庙，是宁玛派最重要的寺庙之一，影响力遍及西藏、青海、云南等省区和蒙古、印度、不丹等国。

噶托寺占地面积约1.7平方公里，建筑面积达5021平方米，规模庞大、气势宏伟。

寺中大量建筑铺陈于多尼山腰，顺山势层层叠叠，非常壮观。

寺庙僧侣众多，共有经堂8座，辩经场4座，僧众住房500余间。

寺中原有经堂、密宗神殿、修学堂、印经院等建筑，后多有损毁，近年来经过大规模重修，较以往更为辉煌。

尤其是新建大金殿，从上至下金光灿烂，在群山之中熠熠闪光，已成为噶陀寺新的标志性建筑。

英文翻译 English Translation

Kathok Temple in Baiyu is located in Gongbu Village, Hepo Township, Baiyu County, Garze Prefecture, 51km from Baiyu County seat.

One of the six great Nyingma (Red Hat) monasteries of Tibetan Buddhism and the largest Nyingma pilgrimage site in Kham.

Founded by Nyingma master Ga Dangba Dexi in the 2nd year of Shaoxing, Southern Song (1132).

Kathok means above the letter ga in Tibetan; legend says the original site had a giant white stone with a naturally formed Tibetan letter pronounced ga, hence the name.

Today Kathok is the largest monastery in Kham and one of the most important Nyingma temples, with influence spanning Tibet, Qinghai, Yunnan, and Mongolia, India, Bhutan.

Covers ~1.7 sq km with 5,021 sq m building area — massive and imposing.

Many buildings spread on Duoni Mountain slope, layered following the terrain, spectacular.

Large sangha: 8 scripture halls, 4 debate grounds, over 500 monk residences.

Originally had scripture halls, tantric shrines, study halls, and printing house; many were damaged but extensively rebuilt in recent years, more magnificent than before.

Especially the new Great Golden Hall, resplendent from top to bottom, gleaming among the mountains, has become Kathok's new landmark.

波日桥

Bori Bridge
国家级 清 桥梁
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address甘孜藏族自治州新龙县乐安乡
类型 Type桥梁
看点 Highlights: 木石结构 悬臂结构

中文描述 Description

波日桥是一座藏式伸臂桥，位于甘孜州新龙县乐安乡境内，横跨于雅砻江之上，因跨度巨大，结构独特，历史悠久，该桥被誉为康巴第一桥。

波日桥全长125米，宽3米，采用藏区常见的悬臂桥结构，由藏族建筑大师唐通吉布于清道光二十四年(1844年)设计修建。

该桥主要由桥身、桥墩和桥亭构成，其桥墩由圆杉木、卵石、片石相间砌筑而成，平面为尖圆形，敦厚且坚固。

从桥墩中部起，有4—6根圆木自上而下层层相叠，并逐层增加悬挑长度，最终形成从桥墩上生长出来的两个悬臂臂。

悬挑臂上架横木为梁，再铺上木板作为桥面，两侧设木栏。

桥两端的桥墩之上有片石砌成的桥亭，屋顶木架斜坡，上覆石板瓦。

整座桥古朴厚重，桥墩的粗壮与悬臂的通透形成强烈对比。

近50米跨度的悬臂结构极为罕见，故波日桥堪称藏地，乃至全国桥梁建筑中的杰出之作。

英文翻译 English Translation

Bori Bridge is a Tibetan-style cantilever bridge located in Le'an Township, Xinlong County, Garze Prefecture, spanning the Yalong River.

With its great span, unique structure, and long history, it is known as the First Bridge of Kham.

Total length 125m, width 3m, using the cantilever bridge structure common in Tibetan areas.

Designed and built by Tibetan master architect Tangtong Gyalpo in the 24th year of Daoguang (1844).

The bridge consists of deck, piers, and bridge pavilions.

Piers are built from alternating round fir logs, pebbles, and flagstones, with a pointed circular plan — solid and sturdy.

From the middle of each pier, 4-6 round logs are stacked layer by layer from top to bottom, increasing cantilever length with each layer, forming two cantilever arms growing from the piers.

Horizontal timbers are laid across the cantilever arms as beams, then planks as deck, with wooden railings on both sides.

Atop both end piers are pavilions built from flagstones, with sloped timber roofs covered in stone slate tiles.

The entire bridge is simple and massive; the sturdy piers contrast strongly with the transparent cantilevers.

The nearly 50m cantilever span is extremely rare, making Bori Bridge an outstanding work of Tibetan and indeed national bridge architecture.

丹巴古碉群

Ancient Watchtowers in Danba
国家级 元—清 堡垒
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty元—清
地址 Address甘孜藏族自治州丹巴县梭坡乡、中路乡
类型 Type堡垒
看点 Highlights: 民居 碉楼 结构

中文描述 Description

四川省甘孜藏族自治州丹巴县是藏族碉楼分布最为密集的地区，有千碉之国的美誉，形态各异、大小不同共562座碉楼分布于全县15个乡、镇、村中。

古碉楼是嘉绒藏族的独特建筑类型，主要具有对抗土匪强盗的军事功能，从藏民最初营建碉楼至今已有千年历史。

大渡河上游的梭坡、中路两乡是丹巴古碉楼分布最为密集的区域。

其中梭坡碉群位于莫洛村内，整个碉群现存四角碉6座，八角碉1座。

7座碉楼顺山势而建，高低错落形态丰富，已成为丹巴最具标志性的景观。

今存丹巴古碉大多建于元至清，建筑面积介于25—120平方米，高度从10米至60米不等。

碉楼均采用石块砌筑，底层墙厚将近一米，这保证了古碉历经数百年风雨仍然屹立不倒。

丹巴数百座碉楼实际上涵盖多种类型，平面形状有四角、五角、六角、八角、十三角等数种，而碉楼功能也可分为烽火碉、要隘碉、官寨碉、界碉、经堂碉、房中碉等形制，这展现了碉楼文化在此地的蓬勃生命力，也说明了碉楼在当地民众生活中不可替代的地位。

伴随着热兵器的使用，碉楼已经失去了主要的防御作用，但是作为康巴人们高超建筑技艺的见证，以及藏族文化传统的承载物，它们今天也吸引了越来越多关注的目光。

2006年，丹巴古碉楼被正式列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。

英文翻译 English Translation

Danba County, Garze Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan, is the most densely distributed area of Tibetan watchtowers, renowned as the Kingdom of a Thousand Watchtowers.

562 watchtowers of various forms and sizes are distributed across 15 townships and villages.

Ancient watchtowers are a unique architectural type of the rGyalrong Tibetan people, primarily serving military defense against bandits, with a thousand-year history since Tibetan people first built them.

Suopo and Zhonglu townships in the upper Dadu River basin have the densest distribution.

The Suopo cluster in Moluo Village preserves 6 four-corner and 1 eight-corner watchtowers, built along the mountain slope in varied heights — Danba's most iconic landscape.

Most surviving Danba watchtowers date from Yuan to Qing dynasties, with floor areas 25-120 sq m and heights 10-60m.

All built from stone masonry, with base walls nearly 1m thick, ensuring survival through centuries of weather.

The hundreds of Danba watchtowers encompass multiple types: four-corner, five-corner, six-corner, eight-corner, and thirteen-corner plans; functions include beacon towers, strategic pass towers, official residence towers, boundary towers, scripture hall towers, and in-house towers — demonstrating the vigorous vitality of watchtower culture and its irreplaceable role in local life.

With the advent of firearms, watchtowers lost their primary defensive function, but as witnesses to Kham people's superb building skills and carriers of Tibetan cultural tradition, they attract growing attention today.

Designated as the 6th batch National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit in 2006.

塔公寺

Tagong Temple
省级 明—清 建筑群 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address甘孜藏族自治州康定县塔公乡
类型 Type建筑群 宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 藏式建筑 雕像 佛塔

中文描述 Description

塔公寺位于甘孜州康定县境内的塔公草原之上，属藏传佛教萨迦派(花教)寺庙。

塔公寺全名一见如意解脱寺，塔公藏语意为菩萨喜欢的地方。

该寺因寺内保存有一尊与拉萨大昭寺相同的释迦牟尼像而被称为小大昭寺。

除此之外，寺内藏有元朝帝师八思巴法足足印，以及成就佛塔与千手千眼观音像等珍宝。

塔公寺始建于唐，距今已有千年历史，现存建筑多为清代重建。

寺庙占地2万多平方米，建筑面积约6000平方米。

整座寺庙由大雄宝殿、觉卧佛殿、祖师殿、护法殿、千手千眼观音圣殿、莲师殿、成就塔殿、僧舍及绕寺一周的转经廊、塔林(150多座佛塔)等组成。

塔公寺措钦大殿由前殿和大经堂两个部分组成，前殿面阔七间22.2米，进深两间5.9米。

大经堂与前殿同宽，进深六间18.5米。

建筑采用传统藏式建筑结构，系穿斗式木梁架体系，石块砌墙，平屋顶上覆盖重檐歇山屋顶。

塔公寺在藏地萨迦派中地位极高，每年藏历六至八月，寺庙以及周边的塔公草原上会举行一系列的佛事与民俗活动，吸引周边大量民众参加，热闹非凡，闻名遐迩。

英文翻译 English Translation

Tagong Temple is located on the Tagong Grassland in Kangding County, Garze Prefecture, a Sakya (Flower Hat) school monastery.

Full name: Yijian Ruyi Jietuo Temple (One Glance Liberation Temple).

Tagong in Tibetan means the place Bodhisattvas love.

The temple is called Little Jokhang because it preserves a Shakyamuni Buddha image identical to that in Lhasa's Jokhang Temple.

Additionally, it houses the footprint of Yuan dynasty Imperial Preceptor Phags-pa, achievement stupas, and a Thousand-Armed Thousand-Eyed Guanyin image.

Founded in Tang dynasty with a thousand-year history; existing buildings mostly rebuilt in Qing.

Covers over 20,000 sq m with ~6,000 sq m building area.

Composed of Mahavira Hall, Jowo Buddha Hall, Patriarch Hall, Protector Hall, Thousand-Armed Guanyin Hall, Padmasambhava Hall, Achievement Stupa Hall, monk residences, circumambulation corridor around the temple, and a stupa forest (150+ stupas).

The Tsokchen (Assembly) Hall consists of front hall and great scripture hall: front hall 7 bays wide (22.2m), 2 bays deep (5.9m); great scripture hall same width, 6 bays deep (18.5m).

Traditional Tibetan structure with chuan-dou timber frame, stone walls, flat roof topped with double-eave xieshan roof.

Tagong Temple holds extremely high status among Sakya monasteries.

Each year from Tibetan calendar 6th to 8th month, a series of Buddhist and folk activities are held at the temple and surrounding Tagong Grassland, attracting large crowds — famous and lively.

长青春科尔寺

Changqingchun ke'er Temple
省级 明—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address甘孜藏族自治州理塘县高城镇北约1公里托洛纳卡山腰西麓
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 藏式建筑 布局 彩绘 雕像

中文描述 Description

长青春科尔寺又称理塘寺，位于甘孜藏族自治州理塘县高城镇北约1公里托洛纳卡山腰西麓。

明万历八年(1580年)，长青春科尔寺由出生于理塘的第三世达赖喇嘛创建，最初为白教寺庙，后改为加沙教寺庙，后被黄教代替。

建寺以来，长青春科尔寺已经多次扩建，成为甘孜州南部地区最大的寺庙。

长青春科尔意为弥勒佛法轮，意味着法轮恒转，真谛永存世间。

寺庙坐北向南，依山而建，背靠崩热神山和多闻正神山。

寺院建筑高低错落，层次分明。

寺庙占地面积33.34万平方米，建筑面积6660平方米，藏式土木结构建筑。

前部有6座活佛家庙，家庙之后，中央为大殿、弥勒佛殿、护法神殿。

大殿东侧，前为厨房，后为藏经阁、千佛殿。

十六尊者殿、释迦牟尼殿。

大殿西侧有2座活佛家庙。

大殿之后东为密宗寺院及显宗院，西为香根活佛故居，最北为金顶红宫。

文革后，寺庙被省政府批准为重点开放寺庙，省、州政府多次拨款对寺庙进行维修，经过十余年的改造，寺庙已恢复了弥勒殿、大经堂、千佛殿、法相院、香根寝舍、金顶红宫等寺庙建筑。

僧众百姓自发捐塑了19米高的弥勒佛像及千佛殿内的三千座佛像，另在金顶红宫内还设立了一、二世香根活佛的灵塔。

每年的藏历六月(现在定为每年公历的7月10日)百花盛开，绿草茵茵之时，作为理塘的民族传统节日，在长青春科尔寺，都会按照古老的习俗举办规模最大，最隆重的祝毕日嘎(六月转山)来祭拜神山。

英文翻译 English Translation

Changqingchun ke'er Temple, also called Litang Temple, is located on the western slope of Tuoluonaka Mountain, about 1km north of Gaocheng Town, Litang County, Garze Prefecture.

Founded in the 8th year of Wanli (1580) by the 3rd Dalai Lama, who was born in Litang.

Originally a Kagyu (White Hat) temple, later changed to another school, then replaced by Gelug (Yellow Hat).

Expanded multiple times since founding to become the largest temple in southern Garze Prefecture.

Changqingchun ke'er means Maitreya Dharma Wheel, signifying the dharma wheel eternally turns and true dharma perpetually abides.

Facing south, built against the mountain, backed by Bengre Sacred Mountain and Duowen Zheng Sacred Mountain.

Buildings are staggered in height with clear layering.

Covers 333,400 sq m with 6,660 sq m building area, Tibetan-style earthen-wood structure.

Front has 6 Living Buddha family temples; behind them, center has Main Hall, Maitreya Hall, Protector Hall.

East of main hall: kitchen in front, then Scripture Library and Thousand-Buddha Hall.

Sixteen Arhats Hall, Shakyamuni Hall.

West of main hall: 2 Living Buddha family temples.

Behind main hall: east is Tantric monastery and Sutra academy, west is Xianggen Living Buddha's former residence, northernmost is Golden-top Red Palace.

After the Cultural Revolution, approved as a key open temple by provincial government; provincial and prefecture governments repeatedly funded repairs.

After over a decade of renovation, the temple has restored Maitreya Hall, Great Scripture Hall, Thousand-Buddha Hall, Dharma-Character Academy, Xianggen Quarters, Golden-top Red Palace.

Monks and people spontaneously donated to sculpt a 19m Maitreya Buddha and 3,000 Buddha statues in the Thousand-Buddha Hall; the Golden-top Red Palace also houses the reliquary stupas of the 1st and 2nd Xianggen Living Buddhas.

Every year in Tibetan 6th month (now set as July 10), when flowers bloom and grass is green, as Litang's traditional ethnic festival, the temple holds the largest and most solemn Zhu Biriga (June Mountain Circumambulation) to worship the sacred mountain following ancient customs.

乡城碉楼群

Watch Towers in Xiangcheng
国家级 唐—清 堡垒
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty唐—清
地址 Address甘孜藏族自治州乡城县
类型 Type堡垒
看点 Highlights: 古碉楼 材料 结构

中文描述 Description

乡城是碉楼的王国。

这些古碉楼是乡城历史的忠实见证者，将每一个身临其境的人带入久远的历史中去。

乡城最大的古碉群位于离城区不远的尼斯村，据史料记载，这里的碉楼在鼎盛时期曾多达1000多座。

远古时期的白狼羌、唐代的吐蕃，元明两朝的蒙古人都曾在此大兴土木。

关于这些古碉的用处，目前学界流传着两种说法：一种是它们并不用于战事，而仅是一种宗教符号，人们修建碉楼的主要目的仅仅是供奉自己的护法神。

另一种说法则与之大相径庭：古碉是出于战争考虑。

因为有资料记载，这些古碉多数建于明代，而明代时期乡城战乱频发，加之这里又是康巴地区的交通要道。

在此地建碉楼，就有重要的战略意义和价值。

乡城的碉楼基本都只有9层，修建时每年只修一层，一共要建9年才能完工——乡城碉楼为什么只修9层，而且要用上这么长的时间？

要知道这些碉楼并不大，截面不过10平方米，人们完全可以一口气完成。

乡城文联主席夏坝丁真给出了问题的答案：因为这里的人们崇尚数字9，从碉楼开工到每一层竣工的时候，人们都会祷告祈福、每修一层就等于念了999次真经。

他们相信，这样来年会得到佛祖保佑，风调雨顺，五谷丰登。

乡城古碉之美，在于其古朴的气质。

乡城现存的碉楼和丹巴地区的不同，丹巴地区多为石碉，而乡城则多用湿度相当的泥土夯制而成，给人一种厚重而纯粹的视觉美。

一栋栋直上云天的高碉没有任何装饰，有的只是岁月刻下痕迹。

在碉楼的四壁上，人们还可以看见许多雨水冲刷的痕迹，这些痕迹古老而悠长。

英文翻译 English Translation

Xiangcheng is the kingdom of watchtowers.

These ancient towers are faithful witnesses of Xiangcheng's history, transporting every visitor into the distant past.

Xiangcheng's largest watchtower cluster is in Nisi Village, not far from the county seat; historical records show it once had over 1,000 towers at its peak.

The ancient Bailan Qiang, Tang dynasty Tubo, and Yuan-Ming Mongols all built extensively here.

Regarding their purpose, two scholarly views exist: one says they were not for warfare but merely religious symbols, built primarily to enshrine one's personal protector deity.

The other view is quite different: the towers were built for warfare.

Records show most were built in Ming dynasty, when Xiangcheng saw frequent warfare and was also a Kham transportation hub — building towers here had important strategic significance.

Xiangcheng towers typically have only 9 stories, with only one story built per year, taking 9 years to complete.

Why only 9 stories and why so long?

The towers are not large, with cross-sections of only 10 sq m, and could be completed in one go.

Xia Ba Dingzhen, chairman of Xiangcheng Federation of Literary and Art Circles, gives the answer: people here venerate the number 9; from groundbreaking to each story's completion, people pray and offer blessings, and building one story equals reciting the true sutra 999 times.

They believe this brings Buddha's blessing in the coming year — favorable weather and abundant harvests.

The beauty of Xiangcheng's ancient towers lies in their primitive simplicity.

Unlike Danba's mostly stone towers, Xiangcheng towers are rammed from earth of appropriate moisture, giving a heavy, pure visual beauty.

The towers soaring to the sky have no decoration, only traces carved by time.

On the four walls, one can see many rain-wash marks — ancient and enduring.

葛丹桑披罗布岭寺

Ge Dan Sang Pi Luo Bu Ling Lamasery
国家级 清 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address甘孜藏族自治州乡城县桑披镇巴姆山南麓
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 藏式建筑 雕像 彩绘

中文描述 Description

葛丹桑披罗布岭寺位于甘孜藏族自治州乡城县桑披镇巴姆山南麓，是一座藏传佛教格鲁派的寺院。

噶丹表示传承格鲁派祖师宗喀巴首建之西藏噶丹寺的名系，桑披意为遂心如意、兴旺发达，罗布则是宝贝、神物的意思，岭即寺庙，意为遂心如意、兴旺发达的宝寺。

桑披岭寺于清康熙八年(1669年)在五世达赖洛桑嘉措的倡导下，由乡城本地高僧若·崩公本洛与五世达赖派遣的蒙古军官吉布康珠在噶举派甲夏寺的原址上兴建，是格鲁派在康巴地区兴建十三座寺庙之一。

清嘉庆十六年(1811年)住持赤江活佛宋久曲成为九世达赖隆朵降措的经师，嘉庆二十年(1815年)又荣登第六十九任噶丹法王宝座，从此，桑披岭寺成为乡城第一大寺。

1936年，红军长征路经乡城，受到僧众的欢迎与接待，并送粮运草、收养伤员，离开时萧克、王震等曾赠给寺庙扶助番民，独立解放的匾额，是藏汉团结的象征。

1995年10月，根据县城城市规划及大部分喇嘛意愿，桑披岭寺迁至现址巴姆山麓的同沙宫。

寺依山势而建，错落有致，坐西向东，藏式土木建筑。

进入东大门即为跳神坝，跳神坝的围廊共有80根木柱，占地面积3335平方米。

跳神坝之后即为正殿，前低后高，占地面积2001平方米，可容5000余人盘腿诵经。

正殿高六层，底层有木柱280根。

正殿两旁墙壁上绘四大天王及垂死轮回图。

底层供奉千手千眼观音、白伞佛母、垂活佛像、绿度母、弥勒佛、宗喀巴三师等。

其中宗喀巴坐像高达13米。

第二层护法神殿，在第三层可以看到东面的祥麟法轮与两旁的神鼓阁、法号阁西面的第四、五、六层称为金顶。

英文翻译 English Translation

Ge Dan Sang Pi Luo Bu Ling Lamasery is located at the southern foot of Bamu Mountain, Sangpi Town, Xiangcheng County, Garze Prefecture — a Gelug school Tibetan Buddhist monastery.

Gadan indicates lineage from Ganden Monastery in Tibet (first built by Gelug patriarch Tsongkhapa); Sangpi means fulfillment and prosperity; Luobu means treasure and sacred object; Ling means monastery — together: a treasure monastery of fulfillment and prosperity.

Sangpi Ling Monastery was founded in the 8th year of Kangxi (1669) under the advocacy of the 5th Dalai Lama Losang Gyatso, by local Xiangcheng master Ruo Bengong Benluo and Mongolian officer Jibu Kangzhu dispatched by the 5th Dalai Lama, on the original site of the Kagyu school Jiaxia Monastery — one of thirteen Gelug monasteries built in Kham.

In the 16th year of Jiaqing (1811), abbot Chijiang Living Buddha Songjiu Qucheng became the scripture teacher of the 9th Dalai Lama Lungtok Gyatso; in the 20th year of Jiaqing (1815) he ascended to the 69th Ganden Tripa throne — from then on Sangpi Ling became Xiangcheng's largest monastery.

In 1936, the Red Army's Long March passed through Xiangcheng, welcomed and hosted by the monastic community who provided grain, fodder, and cared for the wounded; upon departure, Xiao Ke, Wang Zhen, and others presented the temple with a plaque reading Assist Tibetan People, Independence and Liberation — a symbol of Tibetan-Han unity.

In October 1995, per county urban planning and majority lama wishes, Sangpi Ling relocated to its current site at Tongsha Palace on Bamu Mountain slope.

Built along the terrain, staggered, facing east, Tibetan-style earthen-wood architecture.

Entering the east gate leads to the Cham dance courtyard, whose surrounding corridor has 80 timber columns, covering 3,335 sq m.

Beyond is the main hall, lower in front and higher behind, 2,001 sq m, seating 5,000+ people cross-legged for scripture recitation.

Main hall is six stories tall; ground floor has 280 timber columns.

Side walls depict Four Heavenly Kings and the Wheel of Life.

Ground floor enshrines Thousand-Armed Guanyin, White Umbrella Buddha Mother, Living Buddha image, Green Tara, Maitreya, and Tsongkhapa with his two disciples — the Tsongkhapa seated image is 13m tall.

Second floor: Protector Deity Hall.

Third floor: east side has auspicious deer and dharma wheel with flanking divine drum pavilions and horn pavilions; west side 4th, 5th, 6th floors are called the Golden Top.

达扎寺

Dazha Temple
国家级 清 建筑群、宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address阿坝藏族羌族自治州若尔盖县达扎寺镇北部
类型 Type建筑群、宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 土木结构 彩绘 雕像

中文描述 Description

达扎寺位于四川省阿坝州若尔盖县达扎寺镇北部，属藏传佛教格鲁派寺院，由其第一世达扎活佛曲吉·毛郎伦珠于清康熙二年(1663年)创建，后经历代活佛扩建。

达扎寺最初建于黑河与热河交汇处。

清道光九年(1829年)，第四世达扎活佛洛桑丹增嘉措与其兄弟索郎扎西把寺院迁到现址，并修建大经堂、尊胜佛母殿等建筑，创建了上部密宗院。

寺院规模不断扩大，各种法会甚多，还开设了三大扎仓，即三大学院(闻思学院、密宗学院、时轮学院)，因而达扎寺成为重要的藏传佛教文化中心。

达扎寺院同时具有藏族传统建筑与汉式建筑的风格。

寺院依靠塞尔神山，顺山势布局，坐北朝南，占地面积63812平方米。

整座寺院平面布局以大经堂为中心，四周分布时轮经堂、密宗院经堂、宗喀殿、六臂大黑天护法神殿、马头明王殿、活佛院、辩经院、医学院、四座佛塔、达扎书院、僧房等建筑。

主体建筑大经堂始建于道光年间，由门厅、正殿、后殿组成，均为土木结构，抬梁式梁架，围以夯土墙。

经堂中各木结构均雕刻有丰富彩绘，凸显了大经堂的重要地位。

殿内四周墙面均绘有壁画，线条流畅，色彩鲜艳，是典型的藏传佛教绘画实例。

达扎寺还收藏了清代、民国时期的大量珍贵文物，如金铜佛像、唐卡、印版等，具有很高的艺术与历史价值。

英文翻译 English Translation

Dazha Temple is located in the north of Dazha Temple Town, Ruoergai County, Aba Prefecture, a Gelug school Tibetan Buddhist monastery.

Founded by its 1st Dazha Living Buddha Quji Maolanglunzhu in the 2nd year of Kangxi (1663), expanded by successive living buddhas.

Originally built at the confluence of the Hei and Re rivers.

In the 9th year of Daoguang (1829), the 4th Dazha Living Buddha Losang Danzhen Gyatso and his brother Solang Zhaxi relocated the temple to its current site, building the Great Scripture Hall, Ushnishavijaya Hall, and founding the Upper Tantric College.

The temple expanded continuously, with numerous Dharma assemblies and three major dratsang (colleges): Debating College, Tantric College, and Kalachakra College — making it an important Tibetan Buddhist cultural center.

The temple combines traditional Tibetan and Han architectural styles.

Set against Mount Saier, laid out along the mountain slope, facing south, covering 63,812 sq m.

The plan centers on the Great Scripture Hall, surrounded by Kalachakra Hall, Tantric College Hall, Tsongkhapa Hall, Six-Armed Mahakala Protector Hall, Hayagriva Hall, Living Buddha quarters, debating courtyard, medical college, four stupas, Dazha Academy, and monk residences.

The main Great Scripture Hall, founded in Daoguang era, consists of entrance hall, main hall, and rear hall — all earthen-wood structure with post-and-lintel frame and rammed earth walls.

Timber elements are richly carved and painted.

Interior walls are covered with murals with fluid lines and vivid colors — typical Tibetan Buddhist painting examples.

The temple also houses precious Qing and Republican era artifacts such as gilt bronze Buddha statues, thangkas, and printing blocks, of high artistic and historical value.

松潘古城墙

Ancient City Wall of Songpan
国家级 明 城墙
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address四川省松潘县
类型 Type城墙
看点 Highlights: 城墙 城门 城楼 瓮城

中文描述 Description

松潘古城墙位于四川省松潘县城，松潘是历代中央政府在川西北的军事重镇，因此有较为完备的防御设施。

现存城墙为明洪武十二年(1379年)在原唐松州涂城的基础上扩建而成，经正统年间扩建，形成松潘古城如今内外两城的格局。

松潘古城分内、外两城。

内城依山势建造，平面约为三角形，外城毗邻城南河谷平坝，经城门与内城相通。

城墙主体外墙由青砖砌筑、内夯土石。

此地城墙极为厚重，每砖长约半米，重达30斤，历经岁月磨砺，尽显沧桑。

部分区段为了强化防御改由条石砌筑，更为坚固。

经过修整，城墙目前保存较好，总长6200米，有的区段高厚均达到12米，坚固雄壮。

城墙城门古城有城门7座，其中内城有觐阳延薰威远镇羌小西门五门，外城有临江安阜两门，原均有瓮城拱卫，现仅余南门瓮城。

城门上原有高大城楼，但均已经遭到损毁。

现存于东门、北门上的城楼分别于1992年和1993年重建。

2001年，松潘古城墙被国务院公布为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。

英文翻译 English Translation

Ancient City Wall of Songpan is located in Songpan County town, Sichuan.

Songpan was a military stronghold of successive central governments in northwestern Sichuan, hence its comprehensive defensive facilities.

The existing wall was expanded in the 12th year of Hongwu (1379) on the basis of the original Tang dynasty Songzhou Tucheng, further expanded in the Zhengtong era, forming today's inner and outer city layout.

Songpan ancient city has inner and outer cities.

The inner city follows the mountain terrain with a roughly triangular plan; the outer city adjoins the river valley flatland south of the city, connected to the inner city through gates.

The wall's outer face is built of blue-gray bricks with rammed earth and stone core.

Extremely thick: each brick is about half a meter long and weighs 15kg, weathered by time.

Some sections were reinforced with dressed stone for stronger defense.

After restoration, the wall is well preserved, totaling 6,200m in length, with some sections reaching 12m in both height and thickness — solid and majestic.

The city had 7 gates: inner city has Jinyang, Yanxun, Weiyuan, Zhenqiang, and Small West gates; outer city has Linjiang and Anfu gates.

All originally had barbican defenses, only the south gate barbican survives.

Tall gate towers originally stood atop the gates but were destroyed; the east and north gate towers were rebuilt in 1992 and 1993 respectively.

Designated as the 5th batch National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit by the State Council in 2001.

棒托寺

Bangtuo Temple
国家级 明—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address阿坝藏族羌族自治州壤塘县茸木达乡茸木村东北1公里
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 藏式建筑 塔林 彩绘 雕像

中文描述 Description

棒托寺(又名棒托夏周罗尔吾寺)位于阿坝藏族自治州壤塘县茸木达乡茸木村东北1公里处，是始建于元代的藏传佛教宁玛派寺院。

棒托寺藏语意为草坝上的寺庙，这是因为寺庙所处的大渡河支流则曲河河湾处，是一处自然形成的平地草坝。

寺庙背靠瞻巴拉山，面对则曲河U形河湾，选址颇为讲究，独具匠心。

棒托寺规模宏大，占地面积1万余平方米。

除了典型藏式建筑之外，棒托寺最为知名的是寺中32座喇嘛塔。

因寺中喇嘛塔数量众多，规模宏大，棒托寺喇嘛塔群与西藏降扎寺、甘夜色达寺并称藏区三大塔群。

喇嘛塔群均为窣堵坡式，方形塔基，瓶形塔身，十三法轮塔刹。

塔基部分局部中空，供奉千手千眼佛、释迦佛、绿度母、白度母等佛像，并绘有大量彩绘，颜色艳丽，形象生动。

寺中最大的是建于宣统二年(1910年)的神变塔，塔基边长21.5米，高42米，占地面积达484平方米，塔内绘有大量经变壁画，每层均有开窗，出挑屋檐在白色塔身上留下强烈阴影，再加上丰富的塔身轮廓，塑造出强烈和独特的建筑形象，成为棒托寺标志性建筑。

寺中亦有大量石刻经文，共约10万余片，堆放在塔群中部。

除了《甘珠尔》经外，大部分为《嘎木绒》经，具有很高的艺术与历史价值。

2001年，棒托寺被国务院公布为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。

英文翻译 English Translation

Bangtuo Temple (also called Bangtuo Xiazhou Luoerwu Temple) is located 1km northeast of Rongmu Village, Rongmuda Township, Rangtang County, Aba Prefecture — a Nyingma school Tibetan Buddhist monastery founded in the Yuan dynasty.

Bangtuo in Tibetan means temple on the grass flatland, named because the site at the river bend of the Zequ River (a Dadu River tributary) is a naturally formed flat grassland.

The temple backs onto Zhanbala Mountain and faces the U-shaped river bend — a carefully chosen, ingenious site.

Large-scale, covering over 10,000 sq m.

Beyond typical Tibetan architecture, Bangtuo is best known for its 32 Lama stupas.

With numerous and massive stupas, Bangtuo's stupa group ranks among Tibet's three great stupa groups alongside Jiangzha Temple and Seda Temple.

All stupas are stupa-style with square bases, vase-shaped bodies, and thirteen-wheel spires.

Some bases are partially hollow, enshrining Thousand-Armed Thousand-Eyed Buddha, Shakyamuni, Green Tara, White Tara, with extensive colorful murals.

The largest is the Shenbian (Miracle) Stupa built in the 2nd year of Xuantong (1910): base 21.5m per side, 42m tall, 484 sq m footprint, with extensive sutra transformation murals inside, windows on each level, and overhanging eaves casting strong shadows on the white stupa body — creating a powerful, unique architectural image and becoming Bangtuo's landmark.

The temple also has about 100,000 stone-carved scripture slabs stacked in the center of the stupa group.

Besides the Kangyur, most are the Gamurong Sutra — of high artistic and historical value.

Designated as the 5th batch National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit by the State Council in 2001.

日斯满巴碉房

Risimanba Watchtower-shaped Residential Building
国家级 元末明初 建筑群、民居、村寨
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty元末明初
地址 Address阿坝藏族羌族自治州壤塘县中壤塘乡宗科加斯满村石波寨
类型 Type建筑群、民居、村寨
看点 Highlights: 木石结构 多层住宅 藏族传统碉房建筑

中文描述 Description

日斯满巴碉房位于壤塘县宗科乡加斯满村石波寨，该寨历史上是嘉绒藏区绰斯甲土司的辖地。

寨中的藏族碉房自元明时期开始修建，迄今仍保持较完整的风貌，系藏族民居建筑中极为典型的聚落实例。

在这之中，最为引人注目的是高耸的日斯满巴碉房。

日斯满巴碉房始建于明朝，基址位于加斯满山坡地上，占地面积约221平方米。

碉房背靠大山，南部面向宗科至伊里的公路。

建筑总体采用传统的藏族木石结构，外围以片石砌墙，底部墙厚达0.8米，顶部仍有0.5米厚度，保证了碉房的稳固。

碉房内部为木质结构，以木梁支撑密集树棍，再铺上树枝、泥土和木板以形成地面。

在这些传统工艺之上，日斯满巴碉房的独特之处在于其众多层数与出众的高度。

传统藏族碉房仅有3—4层的高度，而日斯满巴碉房多达9层，高度约25米。

整个建筑从南向北逐渐退进，形成众多平台，可供休息与晾晒作物之用。

九层住宅分工明确，底层养畜牲畜，二层为厨房与客厅，三、四层为卧室，五层为经堂，六至九层皆为库房。

碉房各层均有良好的采光和通风条件，体现了多层碉房的优越性。

日斯满巴碉房虽年代久远，但如今仍保持良好状态，其高度与层数也是嘉绒藏区之最，即使在全国范围内也不多见，充分展现了藏族民居传统工艺的可能性，以及藏族先民以建筑顺应地形的宝贵经验，是我国民居建筑文化当中的瑰宝。

英文翻译 English Translation

Risimanba Watchtower-shaped Residential Building is located in Shibo Village, Jiasiman, Zongke Township, Rangtang County — historically under the jurisdiction of the Choskyal Tusi of the rGyalrong Tibetan region.

Tibetan tower-houses in the village were built from the Yuan-Ming period and retain a relatively complete appearance — an extremely typical settlement example in Tibetan residential architecture.

Among them, the most striking is the towering Risimanba tower-house.

Founded in the Ming dynasty, its base sits on the Jiasiman hillside, covering about 221 sq m.

The tower-house backs onto a mountain and faces the Zongke-Yili road to the south.

Overall it uses traditional Tibetan timber-stone structure: outer walls of random rubble masonry, base walls 0.8m thick, top still 0.5m thick, ensuring stability.

Interior is timber structure: beams support dense sticks, then branches, earth, and planks form floors.

Beyond these traditional techniques, Risimanba's uniqueness lies in its many stories and exceptional height.

Traditional Tibetan tower-houses are only 3-4 stories, while Risimanba reaches 9 stories and about 25m tall.

The building gradually recedes from south to north, creating numerous platforms for rest and crop drying.

The nine-story dwelling has clear functional division: ground floor for livestock, 2nd floor kitchen and living room, 3rd-4th floors bedrooms, 5th floor scripture hall, 6th-9th floors storage.

Each floor has good lighting and ventilation, demonstrating the advantages of multi-story tower-houses.

Despite its age, Risimanba remains in good condition.

Its height and story count are the greatest in the rGyalrong Tibetan region, rare even nationwide — fully demonstrating the possibilities of traditional Tibetan residential craftsmanship and the precious experience of Tibetan ancestors adapting architecture to terrain, a treasure in China's residential architectural culture.

直波碉楼

Watchtowers in Zhibo
国家级 明—清 堡垒
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address阿坝藏族羌族自治州马尔康县东17公里
类型 Type堡垒
看点 Highlights: 军事 远瞻 结构

中文描述 Description

直波碉楼位于阿坝藏族羌族自治州马尔康县的松岗镇直波村，距县城约17公里，主要建筑为两座八角碉楼。

碉楼是这一地区常见的民间防御设施，供村民保护自己、防御盗匪，因此往往地势险要、建造牢固，还配有射击瞭望的相关设施。

两座直波碉楼均建造于清乾隆年间，隶属于松岗土司官寨。

一北一南两座碉楼分别位于山腰与寨内，可互相照应。

碉楼平面为八角形，边长两米左右，南碉高29米，北碉高24.7米。

墙体采用片石砌筑，下部墙体厚达0.9米，顶部缩减到0.4—0.5米。

碉楼内部以木材搭建楼层，有狭窄楼梯相通，各层均有瞭望射击孔，以利防御。

松岗碉群原有三座，但第三座已经损毁，余下两座历经多次地震仍竖立不倒，验证了这种构筑方式的结构强度。

除了军事防御之外，在洪水泛滥之时，村名也能够通过在碉楼中躲藏而保全自身安危。

直波碉楼以其强度与高度，稳固地站立，经受住了岁月风雨的考验，是我国藏族碉楼建筑中的代表性案例，已被归入第五批全国重点文物保护单位。

英文翻译 English Translation

Watchtowers in Zhibo are located in Zhibo Village, Songgang Town, Maerkang County, Aba Prefecture, about 17km from the county seat.

The main structures are two octagonal watchtowers.

Watchtowers are common folk defensive facilities in this region, protecting villagers from bandits — hence they are often sited on strategic terrain, solidly built, and equipped with shooting and observation facilities.

Both Zhibo towers were built during the Qing Qianlong era, belonging to the Songgang Tusi official residence.

One north and one south, located on the mountainside and within the village respectively, able to support each other.

Octagonal plan, about 2m per side; south tower 29m tall, north tower 24.7m.

Walls of random rubble masonry: lower walls 0.9m thick, tapering to 0.4-0.5m at top.

Interior timber floors connected by narrow stairs; each floor has observation and shooting holes for defense.

The Songgang tower group originally had three towers; the third was destroyed, while the remaining two have withstood multiple earthquakes without collapsing — verifying the structural strength of this construction method.

Beyond military defense, during floods villagers could take shelter in the towers to ensure their safety.

With their strength and height, the Zhibo towers stand firm, weathering the tests of time — representative cases in China's Tibetan watchtower architecture, included in the 5th batch National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units.

卓克基土司官寨

Official Residence of Zhuokeji Tusi
国家级 清 堡垒
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address距马尔康县城7公里的卓克基镇西索村
类型 Type堡垒
看点 Highlights: 土司制度 藏式建筑 院落 彩绘

中文描述 Description

卓克基土司官寨位于四川省阿坝藏族羌族自治州马尔康县卓克基镇西索村，由卓克基土司索观瀛于20世纪初兴建。

官寨为土司住宅与权力机构所在地，因此规模宏大，功能复杂。

整个建筑坐西北向东南，平面接近于方形，边长约为37米，总占地面积1400平方米，最高五层，建筑面积达到5400平方米。

建筑采用合院布局，主体环绕内院，外形方正封闭，体现了土司的地位与权力。

官寨为石木结构，结合使用藏地与汉地不同的结构形式。

建筑外墙以片石砌筑，最厚处达1米。

官寨屋顶采用同时采用了藏式密梁平顶与汉式悬山披屋顶，形成丰富的屋顶轮廓线。

寨门于建筑西南面，高二层，在入口上布置土司接待汉族宾客的会客室。

寨门两侧分别为四层与五层建筑，均采用悬山屋顶，容纳土司住房、书房、厨房、库房以及士兵住房与喇嘛的僧房与小经堂。

正对寨门的是官寨中最具纪念性的部分，这里安置有黄教喇嘛的大经堂以及土司专用经堂，有木质出挑结构突出在石墙之外，形象显著。

在官寨南面耸立还有一座四角碉楼与楼房相互连通，供危机时储藏贵重物资以及做最终防御所用，这与欧洲城堡建筑中的存守塔具有同样的功效。

卓克基土司官寨是我国土司文化体系中重要的建筑实例，其宏大的规模与完整的形制均属罕见，寨中集中体现了藏族土司制度、佛教文化、军事防御等多方面的历史特征，而且还曾为中央红军第六军团所困，在中国历史上留下了独特一笔，更加增强了其文物价值。

英文翻译 English Translation

Official Residence of Zhuokeji Tusi is located in Xisuo Village, Zhuokeji Town, Maerkang County, Aba Prefecture, 7km from the county seat.

Built by Zhuokeji Tusi Suoguanying in the early 20th century.

As the Tusi's residence and seat of power, it is large-scale with complex functions.

Facing southeast from northwest, nearly square plan, ~37m per side, total site 1,400 sq m, up to 5 stories, 5,400 sq m building area.

Courtyard layout with main body surrounding an inner courtyard, square and enclosed exterior — reflecting the Tusi's status and power.

Stone-timber structure combining Tibetan and Han structural forms.

Outer walls of random rubble masonry, up to 1m thick at thickest.

Roofs combine Tibetan dense-beam flat roofs and Han-style overhanging gable roofs, creating rich roof silhouettes.

The gate is on the southwest face, two stories high, with a reception room above the entrance for the Tusi to receive Han guests.

On either side of the gate are 4-story and 5-story buildings with overhanging gable roofs, housing the Tusi's quarters, study, kitchen, storage, soldier barracks, and lama quarters with a small scripture hall.

Directly opposite the gate is the most monumental part: the Gelug lama's great scripture hall and the Tusi's private scripture hall, with timber cantilevered structures projecting beyond the stone walls — visually prominent.

To the south stands a four-corner watchtower connected to the buildings, for storing valuables in crises and final defense — equivalent to the keep in European castles.

Zhuokeji Tusi Residence is an important architectural example in China's Tusi cultural system; its grand scale and complete form are rare.

It embodies historical features of Tibetan Tusi system, Buddhist culture, and military defense.

It was also besieged by the 6th Army Corps of the Central Red Army, leaving a unique mark in Chinese history and further enhancing its cultural relic value.

草登寺

Caodeng Temple
省级 清 建筑群、宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address阿坝藏族羌族自治州马尔康县草登乡代基村
类型 Type建筑群、宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 木石结构 彩绘 雕像

中文描述 Description

草登寺位于阿坝州马尔康县草登乡代基村海拔2700米的山坳间，距马尔康县城87公里。

该寺现为马尔康县境内最大的格鲁派寺院，由阿坝格尔底寺八世活佛洛桑臣烈所创建，在该地区宗教文化生活中扮演着重要角色。

草登寺始建于明清，经清咸丰三年(1853年)与清光绪十九年(1894年)两次扩建而达宏大规模，现占地面积约7万平方米，建筑面积约1.7万平方米。

寺内主要建筑有大经堂、小经堂、殊胜塔、弥勒佛殿等，均为典型藏式建筑，外墙由片石砌筑，施白色粉刷，顶部以木架斜屋顶覆盖，上铺石板瓦。

整座寺院中大经堂最为显要，其殿阔七间25米，进深同为七间24米，殿高约十一二米，内部立柱共48根。

大经堂内有丰富的雕饰和彩绘。

草登寺内现设有密宗学院、显宗学院与藏医学院三大学院。

该寺是承袭藏传佛教传统文化的重要中心，对整个安多藏区有较大影响。

除建筑之外，寺内所藏大量唐卡、佛像、佛学经典等也同样具有珍贵价值。

英文翻译 English Translation

Caodeng Temple is located in a mountain col at 2,700m elevation in Daiji Village, Caodeng Township, Maerkang County, Aba Prefecture, 87km from Maerkang County seat.

It is currently the largest Gelug school monastery in Maerkang County, founded by the 8th Living Buddha Losang Chenlie of Aba Gerdeng Monastery, playing an important role in the region's religious and cultural life.

Founded in Ming-Qing, expanded twice in the 3rd year of Xianfeng (1853) and 19th year of Guangxu (1894) to reach its grand scale.

Currently covers ~70,000 sq m with ~17,000 sq m building area.

Main buildings include Great Scripture Hall, Small Scripture Hall, Supreme Stupa, and Maitreya Buddha Hall — all typical Tibetan architecture with random-rubble outer walls whitewashed, timber sloped roofs covered with stone slate tiles.

The Great Scripture Hall is most prominent: 7 bays wide (25m), 7 bays deep (24m), ~11-12m tall, with 48 interior columns.

Rich carvings and paintings inside.

Caodeng Temple currently has three colleges: Tantric College, Sutra College, and Tibetan Medical College.

It is an important center inheriting traditional Tibetan Buddhist culture, with significant influence across the Amdo Tibetan region.

Beyond architecture, its extensive collection of thangkas, Buddha statues, and Buddhist scriptures is equally precious.

沃日土司官寨经楼与碉楼

Scripture Depository Pavilion and Watchtower of the Official Residence of Wori Tusi
国家级 清 土司建筑、碉楼
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address阿坝藏族羌族自治州小金县沃日乡政府驻地
类型 Type土司建筑、碉楼
看点 Highlights: 木石结构

中文描述 Description

沃日土司官寨位于小金县沃日乡境内，由沃日安抚司建于清乾隆十五年(1750年)，现仅存经楼与碉楼两座建筑。

沃日土司在乾隆年间因协助征剿金川有功而受封安抚司，至末代土司杨春普共历23代。

土司官寨是土司居住、办公以及驻兵的综合型建筑，通常规模较大。

但此地主要建筑已经损毁，原有两座经楼也早已不复存在，今日所见经楼为1945年重建，不复当年情景。

碉楼紧贴经楼，坐西向东，平面为长方形，边长分别为6.7米和6.2米。

碉楼由片石砌筑，高达19米，其形体细长挺拔，历经百年数次地震侵扰，仍保持良好的强度，展现了藏族人民高超的结构技艺，是嘉绒藏区石木结构的又一典范。

英文翻译 English Translation

Scripture Depository Pavilion and Watchtower of the Official Residence of Wori Tusi is located in Wori Township, Xiaojin County.

Built by the Wori Pacification Commissioner in the 15th year of Qianlong (1750), only the scripture pavilion and watchtower survive today.

The Wori Tusi was granted the Pacification Commissioner title for assisting in the Jinchuan campaigns during Qianlong era; 23 generations served through the last Tusi Yang Chunpu.

The Tusi official residence was a comprehensive building for residence, administration, and troop stationing, typically large-scale.

However, the main buildings here were destroyed; the original two scripture pavilions long gone.

The scripture pavilion seen today was rebuilt in 1945, not the original.

The watchtower adjoins the scripture pavilion, facing east, rectangular plan, 6.7m and 6.2m sides.

Built of random rubble masonry, 19m tall, slender and upright.

Despite a century of multiple earthquakes, it maintains good structural strength — demonstrating the Tibetan people's superb structural craftsmanship, another exemplar of stone-timber architecture in the rGyalrong Tibetan region.

筹边楼

Choubian Building
国家级 清 楼阁、军事建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address阿坝藏族羌族自治州理县薛城镇薛城小学内
类型 Type楼阁、军事建筑
看点 Highlights: 木石结构 彩绘

中文描述 Description

筹边楼位于阿坝州理县薛城镇薛城小学内一块突兀天然岩石之上。

该楼最初由唐剑南道西川节度使李德裕建于唐文宗太和元年(830年)，用以军事操练、经营川西防务。

后来数百年内，该楼几经损毁重建，现有建筑为清乾隆三年(1739年)由保县县令陈克绳主持复建，又经乾隆年间两度修缮，才形成如今的状态。

筹边楼现为二层重檐歇山式建筑，平面为正方形，通高约7.9米，雄壮而古朴。

楼体下部台基以片石砌筑，与天然岩石浑然一体，台基之上是二层木楼，面阔和进深均为三间7.4米。

一层的屋檐四角高高翘起，与岩石及台基的雄浑形成鲜明对比，尽显木构建筑的轻盈与灵活。

二层楼高3.6米，平面边长缩减为3.6米，四周壁板彩绘各种人物故事，其中以李德裕戍边的情节为多。

登临二楼远眺，能将薛城镇主要市井尽收眼底。

筹边楼因其特殊的历史内涵而成为汉藏两地悠久交流历史的重要见证。

它的建筑规模虽然不大，但是充分利用天然岩石与坚固台基的抬升，使得楼阁分外挺拔和引人注目。

时至今日筹边楼仍然是当地城镇中具有统治力的建筑元素。

英文翻译 English Translation

Choubian Building is located atop a protruding natural rock within Xuecheng Primary School, Xuecheng Town, Li County, Aba Prefecture.

Originally built by Li Deyu, Military Commissioner of Xichuan, Jiannan Circuit, in the 1st year of Taihe (830) of Emperor Wenzong of Tang, for military drills and managing western Sichuan defense.

Over subsequent centuries it was repeatedly destroyed and rebuilt.

The existing building was reconstructed in the 3rd year of Qianlong (1739) under Bao County Magistrate Chen Kesheng, and repaired twice more during Qianlong era to reach its current state.

Now a two-story double-eave xieshan-style building, square plan, ~7.9m total height — majestic and austere.

The lower platform base is built of random rubble masonry, blending with the natural rock; above it is a two-story timber building, 3 bays by 3 bays (7.4m each).

The first floor's four eave corners soar high, contrasting with the rock and platform's massiveness, showcasing timber architecture's lightness and agility.

Second floor is 3.6m tall, plan reduced to 3.6m per side, with wall panels painted with various figure stories, mostly depicting Li Deyu's frontier defense.

Climbing to the second floor offers panoramic views of Xuecheng Town's main streets.

Choubian Building, with its special historical significance, is an important witness to the long history of Han-Tibetan exchange.

Though modest in scale, it充分利用 the natural rock and solid platform elevation to make the building exceptionally upright and eye-catching.

To this day, Choubian Building remains a dominant architectural element in the local town.

桃坪羌寨

Taoping Qiang Village
国家级 西汉—清 建筑群、村寨、民居
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty西汉—清
地址 Address阿坝藏族羌族自治州理县桃坪乡
类型 Type建筑群、村寨、民居
看点 Highlights: 碉楼 木石结构 羌族文化

中文描述 Description

桃坪羌寨位于阿坝藏族羌族自治州理县杂谷脑河畔的桃坪乡，始建于公元前111年，是四川省保存较完整的古羌寨之一。

该寨是羌族建筑群落的典型代表，碉楼与民居融为一体，被誉为神秘的东方古堡。

桃坪羌寨依山而建，背山面水，坐北朝南，寨内住户毗连成片，布局紧凑而工整。

羌寨呈八卦布局，有八个以古保为中心的放射状的出口，出口连接甬道构成路网，寨内村巷曲折迂回。

桃坪羌寨现存两座9层碉楼，总高26米，均以石块垒砌，以木榫联系室内楼面，各层四方开有射击窗口。

碉楼与碉房民居融为一体，民居位于碉楼周围下方，相通相连。

寨房外墙由卵石、片石相混砌筑，室内为木构，平面呈长方形。

寨房一般3—4层，底层为牲畜圈和厕所，二层为生活起居层，三层作储藏用，四层为屋顶晒坝和储藏粮食的照楼。

羌寨内建有四通八达的地下供水系统，自高山引来，经暗沟流至每家每户的门前，揭开门前的石板即可取水，既方便生活，又有消防、制冷、战事防御等作用。

英文翻译 English Translation

Taoping Qiang Village is located in Taoping Township, Li County, Aba Prefecture, on the bank of the Zagunao River.

Founded in 111 BCE, it is one of Sichuan's better-preserved ancient Qiang villages.

A typical representative of Qiang architectural complexes, with watchtowers integrated into dwellings, it is known as the mysterious Eastern Ancient Castle.

Built against the mountain, facing water, facing south, households are contiguous in a compact, orderly layout.

The village follows a bagua (eight trigrams) layout with eight radial exits centered on the ancient fort; exits connect to passageways forming a road network, with winding village lanes.

Taoping Qiang Village currently preserves two 9-story watchtowers, 26m total height, both built of stacked stone blocks with wooden dowels connecting interior floors; each story has shooting windows on four sides.

Watchtowers integrate with tower-house dwellings; residences surround the tower bases below, interconnected.

Exterior walls of village houses are built of mixed cobbles and random stones; interiors are timber, rectangular plan.

Village houses are typically 3-4 stories: ground floor for livestock pens and toilets, 2nd floor for living, 3rd floor for storage, 4th floor as roof drying terrace and grain-storage tower.

The village has an extensive underground water supply system: water from high mountains flows through hidden channels to every household's doorstep; lifting the stone slab in front of the door provides water — convenient for daily life, while also serving fire prevention, cooling, and wartime defense functions.

REGION

凉山彝族自治州

凉山彝族自治州
5
处项目

登相营古驿站

Dengxiangying Ancient Courier Station
县级 明—民国 堡垒
级别 Level县级
年代 Dynasty明—民国
地址 Address凉山彝族自治州喜德县冕山北镇12公里
类型 Type堡垒
看点 Highlights: 城墙 驿站 总体布局

中文描述 Description

要找到登相营并非易事。

从西昌坐上到喜德县的汽车，车一下高速，就开始颠簸在崎岖的山路上。

半途在冕山镇下车，接着转乘面包车，又在更加崎岖泥泞的山路上行驶了一个半小时有余才抵达目的地——登相营古驿站。

登相营在公路一旁的洼地里，站在公路上望去，倾斜曲折的城墙怀抱着一片瓦房，安宁祥和，真有些阡陌交通，鸡犬相闻的意味。

城墙看起来很有年头了，一块块石头堆叠在一起，虽然比起砖墙简陋不少，但也有无穷有趣的变化。

城墙表面长出了厚厚的苔藓，将凹凸不平的石头表面隐藏了起来，显得精致了许多。

在北边，还有瓮城存留的遗迹。

走入城墙内，都是一间间民房，但不同的是许多房屋都是用石头建成的，也许是当地的特色。

这里彝族、汉族各占一半，生活和谐，村子很小，我们这些外来的不速之客一进来，当地人就发现了我们，遇见的村民总会多加留意。

登相营原名登相(也许来自于北边的小相岭)，是南方丝绸之路上一个只有几户客栈的小驿站。

明成化二年(1466年)，宁番卫在此屯兵，称作登相营。

此后，许多百姓在此开设客栈、商店、酒馆等，方便驻军和来往客商，形成了一处繁华的山区物资集散地。

新中国成立前夕，当地人民起义击溃了3万国民党残部，城墙上的弹孔也许就是那时留下的。

不幸的是，1989年，登相营发生了一场大火，房屋严重损毁，加之南方丝绸之路的废弃，登相营辉煌不再。

英文翻译 English Translation

Dengxiangying Ancient Courier Station is not easy to find.

From Xichang, take a bus to Xide County; once off the highway, the road becomes rugged mountain terrain.

Transfer to a minibus at Mianshan Town, and after another 1.5 hours on rough muddy mountain roads, you arrive at Dengxiangying.

The station sits in a depression beside the highway.

From the road, the sloping, winding walls embrace a cluster of tile-roofed houses — peaceful and harmonious, with the feel of crisscrossing paths and the sounds of chickens and dogs.

The walls show their age: stones stacked together, simpler than brick walls but with endlessly interesting variations.

Thick moss covers the wall surfaces, hiding the uneven stone and making them appear more refined.

In the north, remains of a barbican (wengcheng) survive.

Inside the walls are all folk houses, but many are built of stone — perhaps a local specialty.

The village is half Yi and half Han, living harmoniously.

Small as it is, we outsiders were immediately noticed; villagers always paid us extra attention.

Dengxiangying, originally named Dengxiang (perhaps from nearby Xiaoxiang Ridge to the north), was a small courier station with only a few inns on the Southern Silk Road.

In the 2nd year of Chenghua (1466), Ningfan Garrison stationed troops here, calling it Dengxiangying (Dengxiang Camp).

Thereafter, many people opened inns, shops, and taverns to serve the garrison and traveling merchants, forming a prosperous mountain goods distribution center.

On the eve of the founding of New China, local people rose up and defeated 30,000 remnant Nationalist troops; bullet holes in the walls may date from that time.

Unfortunately, a fire in 1989 severely damaged the houses, and with the abandonment of the Southern Silk Road, Dengxiangying's glory faded.

利利兹莫衙门石柱

Stone Column of the Office of Lili Zimo
省级 明 石柱
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address凉山彝族自治州昭觉县大坝乡柯且村
类型 Type石柱
看点 Highlights: 雕 土司文化

中文描述 Description

利利兹莫衙门石柱位于昭觉县大坝乡政府附近，从西昌搭上去布拖县的汽车，半途在大坝乡下车即可。

石柱在一块不大的平地上，就在公路旁边。

一位彝族妇女正带着她的小孩坐在石柱边，询问她得知，兹莫在彝族语中就是土司的意思，因而石柱应该是利利土司的衙门遗留下来的。

石柱一共4根，呈长方形排列。

每根石柱底部均为正方形，边长约为40厘米，高约1.5米。

柱身上有贯通的方形孔洞，也许用以与其他的构件相连接。

柱子上端为动物的雕像，由于风化的原因，动物的面貌都已模糊。

不过仍可以根据体态粗略地识别出应为狮子，有一石柱甚至仍能看清胸前的铃铛。

利利土司曾是凉山一带最大的土司。

元代曾在凉山设罗罗斯宣慰使，治所西昌，同时也在美姑县利美甲谷设置管理机构。

元朝灭亡后，罗罗斯宣慰使率众归顺，明将其封为建昌卫土指挥使，后将位于美姑县利美甲谷的管理机构迁至今柯且村。

明朝中叶，下属发动叛乱，土司战败，土司衙门被毁，仅留下几根石柱供人凭吊，讲述那千百年前的风风雨雨。

英文翻译 English Translation

Stone Column of the Office of Lili Zimo is located near the Damu Township government, Zhaojue County.

From Xichang, take a bus toward Butuo County and get off at Damu Township halfway.

The stone columns stand on a small flat ground beside the highway.

A Yi woman sat with her child beside the columns; asking her, we learned that zimo means tusi (chieftain) in Yi language, so these columns should be remains of the Lili Tusi's official office (yamen).

There are 4 columns arranged in a rectangle.

Each column base is square, ~40cm per side, ~1.5m tall.

The column shafts have through square holes, perhaps for connecting with other structural components.

The column tops are animal carvings; due to weathering, the animals' features are blurred.

However, one can roughly identify them as lions by their body shape; one column even still shows a bell on its chest.

The Lili Tusi was once the largest tusi in the Liangshan region.

In Yuan dynasty, the Luoluosi Pacification Commission was established in Liangshan, with its seat in Xichang, while a management office was also set up in Lijiagu, Meigu County.

After the Yuan fell, the Luoluosi Pacification Commissioner surrendered with his people; the Ming appointed him as the Native Military Commander of Jianchang Guard, later relocating the management office from Lijiagu, Meigu County to today's Keqie Village.

In mid-Ming, subordinates launched a rebellion; the tusi was defeated and his office destroyed, leaving only a few stone columns for people to pay homage to, recounting the storms of a thousand years ago.

大通门、安定门

Datong Gate and Anding Gate
省级 明 城门
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address凉山彝族自治州西昌市涌泉街
类型 Type城门
看点 Highlights: 城墙 城楼 瓮城

中文描述 Description

西昌是凉山彝族自治州的首府，以卫星发射基地而闻名，古称邛都建昌。

明初，建昌卫作为西南重镇，修建城墙城门，历经600余载风雨。

1992年，大通门、安定门被评为省级文保单位，当地于是着手恢复城墙，重建城楼。

大通门包括大通楼和瓮城，现已成为一个景区。

若想登上城墙，非得花一块钱买一张门票不可。

城墙约有10米高，登上城墙，就可以看见整齐结实的女儿墙，应该是经过修缮的。

向下望去，一个四方的瓮城映入眼帘。

瓮城内树木参天，一条道路从中穿过。

路上的行人、车辆安然自得，看起来他们早已习惯了这城门中的生活。

城墙上有一城楼，名为大通楼，重檐歇山顶。

遗憾的是城楼是重建的，许多形制都与古时不同。

大通门东北不远处就是安定门。

相比于大通门来说，安定门就显得简陋一点。

一片低矮的平房中，一段城墙，一个门洞，如此而已。

但那从城墙各处生长出来的杂草树木，似乎更能讲述一段跌宕的历史。

最神奇的是，在城墙紧密的砖石间，一棵大树盘根错节，深深地扎进了城墙之中。

时值夏日，大树枝繁叶茂，让人不得不感慨生命的顽强与自然、历史的造化。

英文翻译 English Translation

Datong Gate and Anding Gate are located on Yongquan Street, Xichang City.

Xichang, capital of Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture, is famous for its satellite launch center; in ancient times it was called Qiongdu and Jianchang.

In early Ming, as a strategic southwestern stronghold, Jianchang Guard built city walls and gates, weathering over 600 years of storms.

In 1992, Datong Gate and Anding Gate were designated provincial cultural relics; the local government then began restoring the walls and rebuilding gate towers.

Datong Gate includes Datong Tower and a barbican, now a scenic area.

To climb the wall costs one yuan for a ticket.

The wall is about 10m high; atop it, one sees neat, solid parapet walls — evidently restored.

Looking down, a square barbican comes into view.

Tall trees fill the barbican, with a road passing through.

Pedestrians and vehicles on the road seem at ease, accustomed to life within the gate.

Atop the wall stands a gate tower named Datong Tower, with double-eave xieshan roof.

Unfortunately, the tower is a reconstruction, with many forms differing from the ancient original.

Not far northeast of Datong Gate is Anding Gate.

Compared to Datong Gate, Anding Gate appears simpler: among low bungalows, a section of wall and a gateway — nothing more.

But the weeds and trees growing from various parts of the wall seem better able to tell a turbulent history.

Most miraculously, between the tight bricks and stones of the wall, a large tree with intertwined roots has deeply embedded itself into the wall.

In summer, the tree is lush with leaves, compelling one to marvel at life's tenacity and the造化 of nature and history.

木里大寺

Muli Great Temple
省级 明 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address凉山彝族自治州木里藏族自治县境内桃坝乡你易店村达尼牙布山麓
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 藏式建筑 土木结构 彩绘

中文描述 Description

木里大寺坐落在凉山州木里藏族自治县桃坝乡你易店村达尼牙布山麓，距离县城约60公里，海拔2637米。

该寺由桑登布佑拉萨哲蚌寺格局奥莫杰主持修建，历时3年，于1656年建成，曾是康巴藏区规模最大的黄教喇嘛寺庙之一，在藏区具有特殊地位。

自建成至今，木里大寺历经300余年的不断扩建维修，成为一个占地面积8万余平方米的宏伟建筑群体。

其中最重要的建筑是措钦(大经堂)，为三楼一底藏式建筑，顶上覆盖汉地重檐歇山顶。

殿内遍布彩绘，极为华丽庄重。

木里大寺是重要的藏传佛教教育中心，寺内有显宗学院，也有密宗进修部，僧人在此可以接受较为完备的佛学教育。

木里大寺曾是当年木里王国的宗教与政治中心，因为美国探险家洛克的到访而举世闻名，不少人认为英国作家詹姆斯·希尔顿的小说《消失的地平线》中所描述的香格里拉就与洛克的游历记载有关。

岁月流转，人去人往，不变的是当地人的宗教虔诚以及寺庙对历史的传承。

英文翻译 English Translation

Muli Great Temple is located at the foot of Dani Yabu Mountain, Niyidian Village, Taoba Township, Muli Tibetan Autonomous County, Liangshan Prefecture, about 60km from the county seat at 2,637m elevation.

The temple was built under the direction of Sengdengbu Youla, following the Drepung Monastery layout pattern by Aomojie, taking 3 years and completed in 1656.

It was once one of the largest Gelug (Yellow Hat) lama monasteries in the Kham Tibetan region, holding special status in Tibetan areas.

Since its completion, Muli Great Temple has undergone over 300 years of continuous expansion and maintenance, becoming a grand architectural complex covering over 80,000 sq m.

Its most important building is the Tsokchen (Great Assembly Hall), a Tibetan-style building with three stories above ground and one below, topped with a Han-style double-eave xieshan roof.

The hall is covered with colorful paintings, extremely ornate and solemn.

Muli Great Temple is an important Tibetan Buddhist education center, with both a Sutra college and a Tantric advanced study department, where monks can receive relatively complete Buddhist education.

Muli Great Temple was once the religious and political center of the former Muli Kingdom, and became world-famous due to the visit of American explorer Joseph Rock.

Many believe the Shangri-La described in British writer James Hilton's novel Lost Horizon is related to Rock's travel accounts.

As years pass and people come and go, what remains unchanged is the local people's religious devotion and the temple's transmission of history.

泸沽湖阿六贡巴经堂

Aliu Gongba Temple at Lugu Lake
省级 清 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address凉山彝族自治州盐源县泸沽湖草海亮
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 苯教 壁画 木构

中文描述 Description

泸沽湖阿六贡巴经堂，当地人亦称黑喇嘛寺，坐落在泸沽湖草海旁走婚桥北一公里处，是藏地最为古老的苯波教派(黑教)的宗教场所，也是泸沽湖周边唯一的黑教寺庙，仅一栋大殿。

泸沽湖摩梭人民信奉自己的原始宗教达巴教。

自从藏地宗教传入泸沽湖地区以后，当地便相继兴修了黑黄两教派的寺庙。

黑教为印度佛教传入西藏前的本地宗教，也称苯教，在四川的左所(泸沽湖镇)一带，至今有不少民众依然信奉苯教。

经堂为三层木构建筑，采用汉地建筑式样，殿内外有丰富的彩绘。

大门前两旁壁上左边绘的是菩提、莲花等主题，颜色鲜艳；

右边是一幅六重天轮回图。

寺里的壁画浓墨重彩，极为绚烂。

殿中供奉热巴佛，是信奉苯教的摩梭人在家里必会供奉的神祇。

英文翻译 English Translation

Aliu Gongba Temple at Lugu Lake, locally also called Black Lama Temple, is located 1km north of the Walking Marriage Bridge beside the Caohai (Grass Sea) of Lugu Lake, Yanyuan County, Liangshan Prefecture.

It is a religious site of the ancient Bonpo (Black Hat) sect — the oldest religion in Tibet — and the only Black Hat temple around Lugu Lake, consisting of just one main hall.

The Mosuo people of Lugu Lake follow their own primitive religion, Dabaism.

Since Tibetan religions were introduced to the Lugu Lake area, both Black and Yellow sect temples were successively built locally.

Black Hat (Bon) was the indigenous religion of Tibet before Indian Buddhism was introduced; in the Zuosuo (Lugu Lake Town) area of Sichuan, many people still follow Bon religion to this day.

The scripture hall is a three-story timber building in Han architectural style, with rich colorful paintings inside and outside.

On the walls flanking the main gate, the left side depicts themes of Bodhi and lotus flowers in vivid colors; the right side shows a Six-Heaven Wheel of Reincarnation.

The temple's murals are heavily pigmented and extremely resplendent.

The hall enshrines the Reba Buddha, a deity that Bon-following Mosuo people invariably enshrine at home.

米易清真寺

Mosque in Miyi County
省级 清 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address攀枝花市米易县
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 伊斯兰文化 楼阁 院落

中文描述 Description

米易县清真寺始建于清康熙四十二年(1703年)，随后在乾隆、嘉庆、道光年间多次维修，近年进行过全面整修，目前清真寺布局完整，占地1200平方米。

虽然是清真寺，但整个建筑仍然在主体上采用了中国传统建筑的形态，是攀西地区伊斯兰教建筑的典型代表。

全寺采用单进四合院布局，主入口在南面轴线上，这里矗立着一座一底二楼三重檐六角形攒尖木质楼阁，名为望月楼，也称邦克楼，是清真寺建筑类型中的重要元素，以往用于登楼召唤教民祈祷。

大门即开在望月楼底层，成为整个清真寺的标志性建筑。

内院由正北面的礼拜堂和两旁的厢房所围合。

礼拜堂面阔五间，进深四间，为抬梁式与穿斗式混合梁架。

其上有驼峰、角背、雀替等雕刻，梁、枋上刻有云纹、象头等图案。

依据清真寺规制，礼拜堂内无神像，仅有圣龛一处用于祈祷。

左、右厢房均面阔三间，进深二间，木结构穿斗式梁架，悬山式小青瓦屋面。

英文翻译 English Translation

Mosque in Miyi County was founded in the 42nd year of Kangxi (1703), subsequently repaired multiple times during Qianlong, Jiaqing, and Daoguang eras, and fully renovated in recent years.

Currently the mosque has a complete layout, covering 1,200 sq m.

Although a mosque, the building overall adopts traditional Chinese architectural forms — a typical representative of Islamic architecture in the Panxi region.

The entire mosque uses a single-courtyard siheyuan layout, with the main entrance on the south axis.

Here stands a three-story (one ground, two upper) triple-eave hexagonal pyramidal timber pavilion called the Moon-Watching Tower (Wangyue Lou), also known as the Bangke Tower — an important element in mosque architecture, traditionally used to climb and call worshippers to prayer.

The main gate opens at the ground floor of the Wangyue Tower, becoming the mosque's landmark building.

The inner courtyard is enclosed by the prayer hall on the north and wing rooms on both sides.

The prayer hall is 5 bays wide, 4 bays deep, with a mixed post-and-lintel and chuan-dou frame.

It features carvings of hump blocks, corner backs, and sparrow brackets; beams and lintels are carved with cloud patterns and elephant-head motifs.

Per mosque regulations, there are no deity images inside the prayer hall, only one mihrab for prayer.

The left and right wing rooms are each 3 bays wide, 2 bays deep, with timber chuan-dou frames and overhanging gable roofs with small gray tiles.

吴氏宅

Wu's Residence
未核定 清 民居
级别 Level未核定
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address攀枝花市西区格里坪镇新庄村一社
类型 Type民居
看点 Highlights: 合院 茶马古道文化

中文描述 Description

四川省攀枝花市地处川滇交界地区，过去是茶马古道(支线)上的重要节点，商贾云集，也在本地建筑文化传统中留下了深刻的印记，吴氏宅就是体现这种影响的典型案例。

吴氏宅始建于清嘉庆年间。

作为民居建筑，吴氏宅采用了传统的合院体系，四周房屋环绕中心的天井，布局紧凑合理。

四周房屋采用斜山式小青瓦屋面，向内院倾斜，取岳朝天四水归堂之意。

天井中有水缸、花台等物极为清幽古朴。

全宅沿轴线对称布置，大门开在南侧正中，厅前东西两侧建有柜台，体现了茶马古道上常见的民宅商铺合二为一的布局特征。

吴氏宅规模虽小，但形制完整，特色鲜明，尤其作为茶马古道文化传统的见证具有极为重要的历史价值。

英文翻译 English Translation

Wu's Residence is located in Panzhihua City, at the Sichuan-Yunnan border.

In the past, this area was an important node on the (branch line of the) Ancient Tea-Horse Road, with merchants gathering, leaving a deep imprint on local architectural culture.

Wu's Residence is a typical case reflecting this influence.

Founded during the Qing Jiaqing era.

As a residential building, it adopts the traditional courtyard system, with houses surrounding a central skywell (tianjing), compact and rationally laid out.

The surrounding houses have sloped small-gray-tile roofs tilting inward toward the courtyard, embodying the meaning of 'four waters returning to the hall.' The skywell contains water vats and flower terraces — extremely serene and antique.

The entire residence is symmetrically arranged along an axis, with the main gate at the center of the south side.

Counters are built on the east and west sides in front of the hall, reflecting the common layout feature of combined residence and shop along the Ancient Tea-Horse Road.

Though small in scale, Wu's Residence has a complete form and distinctive character, especially as a witness to the Ancient Tea-Horse Road cultural tradition, holding extremely important historical value.

豆地贞节牌坊

Doudi Chastity Memorial Archway
市级 清 石坊
级别 Level市级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address攀枝花市仁和区金江镇
类型 Type石坊
看点 Highlights: 比例 石雕 题刻

中文描述 Description

豆地贞节牌坊始建于清道光十七年(1837年)，原为木质，后损毁。

民国十三年(1924年)重建为石质牌坊。

据记载，该坊为纪念曾母毛老太君所立，体现当地民间节孝文化的浓郁传统。

石坊为黄色砂岩质地，为四柱三间，宽6米，高9米，明间、次间高度相似。

明间门洞檐下有石刻匾额，两侧均有题刻，一侧为竹节松心，另一侧为节坊焕彩。

石坊其余各处也均有题刻与浮雕，技艺精湛，内容丰富。

豆地贞节牌坊规模虽不大，但比例匀称，结构紧凑，目前保存状态良好，题刻雕花均清晰可见，黄色石坊在参天古木的映衬下显得更为古朴沉着。

英文翻译 English Translation

Doudi Chastity Memorial Archway was first built in the 17th year of Daoguang (1837), originally wooden, later destroyed.

Rebuilt as a stone archway in the 13th year of the Republic (1924).

According to records, the arch was erected to commemorate Zeng Mu Lao Tai Jun (Madam Mao, mother of the Zeng family), reflecting the strong local tradition of chastity and filial piety culture.

The archway is of yellow sandstone, with four columns and three bays, 6m wide, 9m tall, with similar heights for the central and side bays.

Under the eave of the central gateway is a stone-carved plaque; both sides bear inscriptions — one side reads 'Bamboo Joint Pine Heart' and the other 'Chastity Arch Radiant Splendor.' Other parts of the arch also bear inscriptions and relief carvings, with exquisite craftsmanship and rich content.

Though modest in scale, Doudi Chastity Memorial Archway has well-proportioned ratios and compact structure.

It is currently well preserved, with inscriptions and carvings clearly visible; the yellow stone archway appears even more simple and solemn against the backdrop of towering ancient trees.

西祝寺

Xizhu Temple
区级文物保护单位 明—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level区级文物保护单位
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address攀枝花市仁和区中坝乡
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 规模 梁架

中文描述 Description

西祝寺始建于明洪武年间(1368—1398年)，初为武帝神祠。

清道光五年(1825年)曾重建四大殿，现仅有后殿存留。

后殿面阔三间16米，进深二间7米，通高8米，为单檐硬山式屋顶，穿斗式梁架。

因为发现较晚，西祝寺后殿尚未得到妥善维护，整体结构出现倾斜，亟待整修。

虽地处偏远，但仅从后殿的尺度仍可推测西祝寺当年的庞大规模，在攀西地区较为少见。

有望通过对西祝寺遗存建筑与史料的挖掘进一步了解该地区佛教与民间文化发展的历史信息。

英文翻译 English Translation

Xizhu Temple was founded during the Ming Hongwu era (1368-1398), originally a shrine to Emperor Wu.

In the 5th year of Daoguang (1825), four main halls were rebuilt; currently only the rear hall survives.

The rear hall is 3 bays wide (16m), 2 bays deep (7m), 8m total height, with a single-eave flush-gable roof and chuan-dou frame.

Because it was discovered relatively late, the rear hall has not yet received proper maintenance; the overall structure has developed a tilt and urgently needs repair.

Though located in a remote area, the scale of the rear hall alone suggests the temple's former grandeur — relatively rare in the Panxi region.

It is hoped that further study of the surviving buildings and historical records of Xizhu Temple will reveal more historical information about the development of Buddhism and folk culture in this region.
