处项目

高颐墓阙及石刻

Que (Stone-carved Pillar) and Stone Sculptures of Gao Yi Tomb
国家级 东汉 石雕
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty东汉
地址 Address雅安市雨城区雅州大道
类型 Type石雕
看点 Highlights: 汉阙 雕刻 铭文

中文描述 Description

高颐墓阙位于雅安市雨城区东的雅州大道上，北靠金风山，南依青衣江。

高颐墓阙应该是所有熟悉古建筑的人耳熟能详的一处古迹遗存。

东汉时期，益州汉嘉(四川雅安)人高颐曾担任益州太守，去世后与其弟高实葬于此地。

现存有墓阙、石刻和高颐墓。

其中，高颐墓阙是全国现存最精美最完好的石阙之一。

1961年，被列为全国首批重点文物保护单位，建有保护亭，后逐渐扩建为雅安汉阙博物馆，历经多次维修，最近一次修复于2015年完成。

高颐墓阙分为东、西两阙，形制对称，其中东阙保存较为完好，西阙耳阙已经荡然无存，仅存有汉代主阙的台基和阙身。

主阙自下而上由台基、阙身、楼身、顶盖组成。

阙身四层石层堆积而成，并雕刻出前三后三六柱及阑额，阑额上刻有车骑图样，生动展现了当年官员出行的图景。

在背面的三柱间刻有隶书，西阙为汉故益州太守武阴令上计史举孝廉诸部从事高君字贯方，东阙为汉故益州太守阴平都尉武阳令北府丞举孝廉高君字贯方。

楼身则雕刻出了斗拱和纵横的枋子，枋头、斗拱间还刻有兽头和浮雕，十分精美。

由于东汉时建筑形制并未完全成熟，所以主阙的顶盖采用了最高规格的重檐庑殿顶，屋脊的脊饰比较独特，中间竟是一只老鹰。

耳阙也仿制主阙模样，阙身刻出六柱和阑额，只不过阑额上是卷草纹和击剑的图景。

东西两阙间有两只石兽，分别是天禄和辟邪。

两只石兽皆为虎头狮身，嘴微张，似咆哮状。

四肢呈前进态势，后部抬起，坚实有力。

原有的碑和石刻由于维修的原因皆被统一安放到了室内，包括原有的高君颂碑以及后人所刻的碑文。

高君颂碑碑座刻有二龙相向，碑文300余字，讲述了高颐生平故事。

英文翻译 English Translation

Gao Yi Tomb Que is located on Yazhou Avenue, east of Yucheng District, Ya'an, backed by Jinfeng Mountain to the north and the Qingyi River to the south.

Gao Yi Tomb Que should be a familiar ancient relic to anyone acquainted with ancient architecture.

During the Eastern Han dynasty, Gao Yi, a native of Hanjia (Ya'an, Sichuan) in Yizhou, served as Governor of Yizhou; after his death he was buried here with his brother Gao Shi.

Surviving remains include tomb que, stone carvings, and Gao Yi's tomb.

Among them, Gao Yi Tomb Que is one of the finest and best-preserved stone que in China.

In 1961 it was listed among the first batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units; a protective pavilion was built, later expanded into the Ya'an Han Que Museum, with multiple repairs over the years, the most recent completed in 2015.

Gao Yi Tomb Que consists of east and west que, symmetric in form.

The east que is relatively well preserved; the west que's subsidiary que has completely vanished, leaving only the Han dynasty main que's platform base and shaft.

The main que consists from bottom to top of platform base, shaft, tower body, and roof cap.

The shaft is built of four stacked stone layers, carved with three front and three rear columns plus architraves; the architraves are carved with chariot and cavalry scenes, vividly depicting officials' processions of the era.

Between the three columns on the back are clerical script inscriptions: the west que reads "Han故益州太守武阴令上计史举孝廉诸部从事高君字贯方" and the east que reads "汉故益州太守阴平都尉武阳令北府丞举孝廉高君字贯方".

The tower body is carved with bracket sets and horizontal and vertical lintels; between lintel heads and bracket sets are carved beast heads and reliefs — extremely exquisite.

Since architectural forms were not yet fully mature in Eastern Han, the main que's roof cap adopts the highest-specification double-eave hip roof, with a unique ridge ornament: an eagle in the center.

The subsidiary que also imitates the main que form, with six columns and architraves carved on the shaft, though the architraves show scrolling grass patterns and fencing scenes.

Between the east and west que are two stone beasts: Tianlu and Bixie.

Both have tiger heads and lion bodies, mouths slightly open as if roaring.

Limbs in forward stride, rear raised — solid and powerful.

Due to maintenance, the original steles and stone carvings were all moved indoors, including the original Gao Jun Song stele and later inscriptions.

The stele base is carved with two facing dragons; the inscription of over 300 characters recounts Gao Yi's life story.

樊敏阙及石刻

Fan Min Que (Stone-carved Pillar) and Stone Sculptures
国家级 汉 石雕、石刻
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty汉
地址 Address雅安市芦山县沫东南3公里
类型 Type石雕、石刻
看点 Highlights: 汉阙 雕刻 碑文 诗词

中文描述 Description

到达沫东镇已是下午。

经历了芦山地震，正在修复的石阙显然并没有痊愈，一溜排开的围墙，将古色古香的汉代古建与主干道隔开。

寻了无人看管的后门进去，绕过正在修缮的四川芦山东汉石刻馆，樊敏阙就和我们撞了个满怀。

李白在《忆秦娥》中这样描写汉阙：乐游原上清秋节，咸阳古道音尘绝，音尘绝。

西风残照，汉家陵阙。

此时没有残阳，没有荒原，满身伤痕的汉家陵阙仍有遗世独立之气。

樊敏阙建于东汉建安十年(205年)，为扶壁式红砂石双阙。

北宋崇宁元年(1102年)倾颓，其后阙的构件散逸。

1957年10月参照高颐墓阙整理修复了左阙，左阙高4.99米，宽2.25米，厚0.92米。

樊敏阙是由阙座、阙身、阙盖、阙檐和阙顶组成的仿木结构建筑。

作为中国保存最完整、雕刻最精美的汉代碑阙，它最值得称道与鉴赏的自然是阙上的雕刻了。

雕刻手法简练细致，集汉代雕刻技艺之大成。

雕刻在阙的斗拱层四角上双手托举的力士，颇有力拔山兮气盖世之魄；

主阙正面檐下又细细地刻着浅浮雕，内容取材于云南古哀牢夷族的神话故事龙生十子，以此祭奠曾执此地长吏的樊敏。

虽然大半的浮雕已经被替上用于修补的平石，但依然能从残存的雕纹中窥见曾经的壮美绮丽。

而如今芦山地震又给它的身上添了一道触目惊心的疤，不禁让人惋惜。

樊敏阙背后不远处有一座歇山式碑亭。

碑亭内，巨大的石龟背负着樊敏碑。

整块碑高2.93米，宽1.2米，厚0.26米。

碑上镌刻着双故领校巴郡太守樊府君碑及隶书碑文558字，字迹如今依然清晰可见，为隶书阴刻，主要记述樊敏族系渊源、生平及职官情况。

英文翻译 English Translation

It was already afternoon when we arrived at Modong Town.

Having endured the Lushan earthquake, the stone que under repair clearly had not fully recovered; a row of enclosing walls separated the antique Han dynasty architecture from the main road.

Finding an unattended back entrance, we went in, passing the Sichuan Lushan Eastern Han Stone Carving Museum under repair, and Fan Min Que greeted us squarely.

Li Bai wrote of Han que in "Yi Qin E": "On the pure autumn festival at Leyou Plain, the old Xianyang road falls silent, falls silent.

Western wind and setting sun illuminate the Han dynasty tomb que." There was no setting sun, no wasteland, yet the scarred Han tomb que still retained its aloof, independent spirit.

Fan Min Que was built in the 10th year of Jian'an (205), Eastern Han, as a buttress-type red sandstone double que.

It collapsed in the 1st year of Chongning (1102), Northern Song, and its components were scattered afterward.

In October 1957, the left que was restored following the model of Gao Yi Tomb Que; the left que is 4.99m tall, 2.25m wide, 0.92m thick.

Fan Min Que is a timber-imitating structure composed of que base, shaft, cap, eave, and roof.

As China's most completely preserved and most exquisitely carved Han dynasty stele-que, its most praiseworthy and appreciable feature is naturally the carving on the que.

The carving technique is concise and meticulous, representing the culmination of Han dynasty carving art.

At the four corners of the que's bracket layer are carved muscular figures lifting with both hands, possessing the spirit of "pulling up mountains with overwhelming force"; beneath the main que's front eave are finely carved shallow reliefs,取材 from the mythology of the ancient Ailao Yi people of Yunnan — "Dragon Gives Birth to Ten Sons" — in commemoration of Fan Min, who once served as local magistrate here.

Although most of the reliefs have been replaced with flat stones for repair, one can still glimpse the former magnificence from the surviving carved patterns.

And now the Lushan earthquake has added another shocking scar to its body, which is regrettable.

Not far behind Fan Min Que stands a xieshan-style stele pavilion.

Inside, a giant stone tortoise carries the Fan Min stele.

The entire stele is 2.93m tall, 1.2m wide, 0.26m thick.

It is engraved with "双故领校巴郡太守樊府君碑" and 558 characters of clerical script inscription, still clearly visible today, in intaglio clerical script, mainly recording Fan Min's clan origins, life, and official career.

平襄楼

Pingxiang Building
国家级 宋—清 祠庙
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty宋—清
地址 Address雅安市芦山县城南街
类型 Type祠庙
看点 Highlights: 三国文化 大木结构 彩绘 牌坊

中文描述 Description

提起姜维的名字，人们莫不回想起这位三国时期蜀国的大将。

作为诸葛亮的继任者，他多次北伐，最终也无法挽救昏庸的刘禅，被曹魏所杀。

相传姜维曾在汉嘉郡(今四川雅安)屯兵戍边，后又以此为封地并归葬于此。

汉嘉郡的首府即为现在的芦山县城，因此芦山仍存有姜城、姜维墓等诸多遗迹。

而芦山县据记载，自西魏起就有了祭祀姜维的传统。

尤以相传的姜维殉难之日中秋为甚，全城共搭起48座彩楼，于其上载歌载舞。

北宋年间，平襄楼建成，作为地方官员主持和观看祭祀的场所。

平襄楼高两层，抬梁式梁架，为三重檐歇山顶。

檐下采用五铺作斗拱，正脊、垂脊、戗脊皆有吻兽装饰。

其中正脊立面上雕饰着一列花朵，正吻为鱼龙形，雕刻精美。

建筑木构件皆刷清漆，间以白色的墙面，宁静肃穆。

到了明代，芦山县又在平襄楼临着的县南街修建了牌坊、门楼，并且于平襄楼后新建了大殿，而平襄楼就成为了享殿，楼名也逐渐变成了姜庆楼，整个建筑群成为汉姜侯祠。

其中，汉姜侯祠的牌坊为三间三楼庑殿顶，通体彩绘，单薄的斗拱装饰性极强。

牌坊前额刻有汉姜侯祠，后额为万世忠良。

足见如姜维一般忠于国家，甘于牺牲之伟人必定会被人民、被历史所牢记。

平襄楼后侧的姜公庙大殿为抬梁式歇山顶，内有木刻姜维雕像，供人参拜祭祀。

2013年芦山发生了7.0级地震，汉姜侯祠损失较大，门楼及城墙出现了许多裂纹，姜公庙大殿也有损毁。

与之相邻的文化局大楼已成为危房，汉姜侯祠也被封闭了起来。

希望有关部门能早日完成汉姜侯祠的修复工作，让古建筑能够重获新生。

英文翻译 English Translation

Mentioning the name Jiang Wei, everyone recalls this great general of Shu during the Three Kingdoms period.

As Zhuge Liang's successor, he launched multiple northern expeditions, yet ultimately could not save the incompetent Liu Shan and was killed by Cao Wei.

According to legend, Jiang Wei once stationed troops at Hanjia Commandery (present-day Ya'an, Sichuan) for frontier defense, later took it as his fief and was buried here.

The capital of Hanjia Commandery is today's Lushan County town, so Lushan still preserves many relics such as Jiang City and Jiang Wei's tomb.

Records show that Lushan County has had a tradition of sacrificing to Jiang Wei since the Western Wei dynasty.

Especially on the Mid-Autumn Festival — traditionally the day of Jiang Wei's martyrdom — the entire city erects 48 decorated towers, singing and dancing atop them.

During the Northern Song, Pingxiang Building was constructed as a venue for local officials to preside over and observe sacrifices.

Pingxiang Building is two stories high, with post-and-lintel frame and triple-eave xieshan roof.

Beneath the eaves are five-tier bracket sets; the main, descending, and diagonal ridges all have ornamental beast decorations.

The main ridge facade is carved with a row of flowers, and the main ridge ornament is fish-dragon shaped — exquisitely carved.

Timber components are varnished, interspersed with white walls — serene and solemn.

By the Ming dynasty, Lushan County built an archway and gate tower on South County Street adjacent to Pingxiang Building, and constructed a new main hall behind it; Pingxiang Building then became the offering hall, its name gradually changing to Jiangqing Tower, and the entire complex became the Han Jianghou Shrine.

The shrine's archway is three bays and three stories with hip roof, fully painted, with slender bracket sets of strong decorative quality.

The front plaque reads "Han Jianghou Shrine" and the rear plaque reads "Loyal and Virtuous for Ten Thousand Generations." This shows that great men like Jiang Wei — loyal to the nation and willing to sacrifice — will surely be remembered by the people and by history.

The Jiang Gong Temple main hall behind Pingxiang Building has a post-and-lintel xieshan roof, with a wood-carved statue of Jiang Wei inside for worship.

In 2013, a magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck Lushan; Han Jianghou Shrine suffered heavy damage, with many cracks in the gate tower and city walls, and damage to the Jiang Gong Temple main hall.

The adjacent Cultural Bureau building has become dangerous, and Han Jianghou Shrine has been sealed off.

It is hoped that relevant authorities will complete the restoration of Han Jianghou Shrine soon, allowing the ancient architecture to be reborn.

芦山青龙寺大殿

Main Hall of Qinglong Temple in Lushan
国家级 元 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty元
地址 Address雅安市芦山县龙门乡
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 元代木构 题记 斗拱

中文描述 Description

芦山青龙寺大殿位于芦山县龙门乡政府驻地青龙场村。

周围皆是民房，仅有一道门露在街面上，因而还需要细心观察一番才能找到。

青龙寺大殿现在已经被改造成了一座博物馆，四周皆被围墙围绕，院门和其他辅助用房都仿照着大殿的形制修建。

只是由于雅安地震中就在龙门乡，青龙寺大殿有所损毁，正在修复之中，所以博物馆也并未对外开放。

进入院内，一座古色古香的建筑映入眼帘。

青龙寺大殿为抬梁式歇山顶，平面近似一个正方形。

檐下采用了五铺作斗拱，明间用补间铺作3朵，次间用1朵。

不过青龙寺大殿最为特别的是它的歇山顶，正脊的长度比明间的面阔还要短，以至于整个屋顶上部极为陡峻而下部极为平缓，外形独特，使得整个建筑更显敦实。

建筑的木结构都刷上了清漆，黑黑的，内敛沉稳而有种沧桑之感。

青龙寺大殿始建于元至治三年(1323年)。

但有记载说大殿内有墨书题记，只不过纪年年号无法辨识，曾有人认为所纪的是唐朝年号龙翔。

不过根据大殿屋瓦上至元一年至元六年至正十二壬辰年至正十三等铭文来看，青龙寺大殿应为元代所建。

这一说法在寺内另一处已经被毁坏的关帝殿遗留下来的门枕石上得到了印证，上刻大元至正九年青龙寺等。

到了民国时期，青龙寺被废弃，后作为当地官员(当地人称舵把子)的住宅，1949年后被用作政府办公用地。

再往后整个寺庙被拆掉修了希望小学，仅保留了大殿。

2006年，大殿被评为全国重点文保单位。

到了2010年，政府又决定拆除学校恢复寺庙，并着手修复了大殿。

青龙寺在历史的长河中几经沉浮，而大殿就这样伫立着守望着一切，宠辱不惊，风雨无阻。

英文翻译 English Translation

Main Hall of Qinglong Temple in Lushan is located in Qinglongchang Village, where the Longmen Township government is seated, Lushan County.

Surrounded by folk houses, only a doorway faces the street, so careful observation is needed to find it.

The main hall has now been converted into a museum, enclosed by walls on all sides; the gate and other auxiliary buildings were built following the hall's form.

However, since the Ya'an earthquake struck Longmen Township directly, the main hall sustained damage and is under restoration, so the museum is not open to the public.

Entering the courtyard, an antique building comes into view.

The main hall has a post-and-lintel xieshan roof, with a nearly square plan.

Beneath the eaves are five-tier bracket sets: the central bay has 3 intermediate bracket sets, the side bays have 1 each.

What makes Qinglong Temple Main Hall most special is its xieshan roof: the main ridge is shorter than the central bay's width, making the upper roof extremely steep and the lower part very gentle — a unique exterior that makes the building appear even more solid.

The timber structure is varnished dark, restrained and steady with a sense of vicissitudes.

The main hall was founded in the 3rd year of Zhizhi (1323), Yuan dynasty.

Records mention ink inscriptions inside the hall, though the era name could not be identified; some once thought it recorded the Tang dynasty era name Longxiang.

However, based on inscriptions on the roof tiles such as "Zhiyuan 1st year," "Zhiyuan 6th year," "Zhizheng 12th Renchen year," and "Zhizheng 13th," the hall should be a Yuan dynasty construction.

This theory is corroborated by door sill stones remaining from another destroyed Guandi Hall in the temple, engraved with "Dayuan Zhizheng 9th year Qinglong Temple." During the Republican period, Qinglong Temple was abandoned, later used as the residence of a local official (locally called duobazi), and after 1949 as government office space.

Later the entire temple was demolished to build a Hope Primary School, leaving only the main hall.

In 2006, the hall was designated a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit.

In 2010, the government decided to demolish the school and restore the temple, beginning restoration of the main hall.

Qinglong Temple has experienced many ups and downs through history, while the main hall stands watch over everything — unmoved by honor or disgrace, unstopped by wind or rain.

开善寺正殿

Main Hall of Kaishan Temple
国家级 明 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address雅安市荥经县民主路
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 明代木构 斗拱

中文描述 Description

初探开善寺，原以为寺既然在城内，必然香火会比较旺盛。

但当到达了以后，才发现大门紧闭。

询问旁边屋檐下打着扑克的老爷爷老奶奶，原来开善寺作为佛寺的功用已被废弃，原有的开善寺只剩下了正殿，当地政府于是为此修建成了一个博物馆。

很不幸的是恰好是中午来，得等到下午两点博物馆开门。

进入大门，开善寺大殿就伫立在左手边，整面红色的山墙诉说着大殿的宏伟和曾经的辉煌。

开善寺原来是周围一带善男信女拜佛朝圣地洪雅瓦屋山的主要寺院，大殿建于明成化十七年(1481年)，为抬梁式单檐歇山顶，平面近似正方形。

开善寺大殿最吸引人的特点就是它的复杂精巧的斗拱。

檐下采用六铺作出三跳，出檐深远，将斗拱的结构之美展现得淋漓尽致。

斗拱中运用了许多不常见的曲线元素，特别是下昂向上翘起的头，趣味横生而遒劲有力。

大殿屋顶的翼角高高翘起，似有直入云霄之势，屋顶轻盈，脊饰克制，真乃如翼斯飞。

开善寺大殿前阑额上雕有双凤朝阳、二龙戏珠的图案，极为精美。

大殿现在被用作宗教文化展厅，但由于布展尚未完成，所以笔者去时空空荡荡的。

不过屋内的木结构似乎并未在近期修复过，斑驳的木头诉说了岁月的沧桑。

天花的彩绘已经脱落而难以辨识了，却仍然提醒着人们它当年的繁华。

博物馆占地很小，开善寺正殿委身于周围密密麻麻的民居之间，正殿前两三米远就是围墙，逼仄的有些喘不过气来。

在我参观之时，住在这条街上的小孩跑了进来，在开善寺正殿的内外追逐打闹，脚一遍遍踩过门槛。

想到门口那些打着扑克的老人，开善寺正殿一直都是这里人们的生活所在，是他们的精神寄托。

英文翻译 English Translation

When first visiting Kaishan Temple, I assumed that since it was within the city, its incense must be flourishing.

But upon arrival, I found the main gate tightly closed.

Asking the elderly men and women playing cards under the adjacent eave, I learned that Kaishan Temple's function as a Buddhist temple had been abandoned; only the main hall of the original temple remains, and the local government built a museum around it.

Unfortunately I arrived at noon, having to wait until 2 PM for the museum to open.

Entering the gate, the Kaishan Temple main hall stands on the left; the entire red gable wall speaks of the hall's grandeur and former glory.

Kaishan Temple was originally the main temple for devout men and women from the surrounding area making pilgrimages to Hongya Wawu Mountain.

The main hall was built in the 17th year of Chenghua (1481), Ming dynasty, with a post-and-lintel single-eave xieshan roof and a nearly square plan.

The most attractive feature of Kaishan Temple Main Hall is its complex and exquisite bracket sets.

Beneath the eaves are six-tier bracket sets projecting three tiers, with deep eaves — fully displaying the structural beauty of bracket sets.

The bracket sets employ many uncommon curvilinear elements, especially the upward-curving tips of the lower ang (lever arms), full of playful charm yet powerful.

The roof's wing corners soar high, as if piercing the clouds; the roof is light, ridge ornaments restrained — truly "like wings taking flight." The architrave in front of the hall is carved with patterns of double phoenixes facing the sun and two dragons playing with a pearl — extremely exquisite.

The hall is now used as a religious culture exhibition hall, but since the exhibition installation is incomplete, it was empty when I visited.

However, the interior timber structure does not appear to have been recently restored; the mottled wood recounts the vicissitudes of time.

The ceiling paintings have peeled off and become difficult to discern, yet still remind people of its former prosperity.

The museum occupies a small area; Kaishan Temple Main Hall is nestled among dense surrounding folk houses, with the enclosing wall just 2-3 meters in front — cramped to the point of breathlessness.

During my visit, children living on this street ran in, chasing and playing inside and outside the main hall, their feet stepping over the threshold again and again.

Thinking of the elderly playing cards at the entrance, Kaishan Temple Main Hall has always been part of these people's lives, their spiritual sustenance.

名山文庙

Temple of Confucius in Mingshan
国家级 清 文庙
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address雅安市名山县蒙阳镇北300米名山中学内
类型 Type文庙
看点 Highlights: 儒家文化 轴线

中文描述 Description

名山文庙坐落在月华山上的名山中学里，学校在文庙旁边另起教学楼，与文庙和平地共处着。

由于文庙在中学内部，学校为了不干扰教学秩序拒绝旅游团体进入，所以文庙至今仍然清幽雅静，不染世俗。

文庙，又叫孔庙，是中国特殊的建筑类型，自古便是修建在学院旁用于祭祀孔子的礼制性庙字。

名山文庙修建于清道光二十一年(1841年)，由万仞公墙、棂星门、状元桥、大成门、左右厢房、大成殿、崇圣祠等组成。

万仞公墙已被拆除，沿着长长的石梯上山，穿过名山中学的大门往里走，文庙就豁然眼前。

绿树掩映中，赤红的棂星门首先映入眼帘。

棂星门将灵星之意置于文庙之上，意为要像尊天一样尊孔，上刻月兔金马，日月图，意为孔子的德行与日月同辉。

正对棂星门的是三座架在泮池上的三穿九孔雕龙石桥，被称为状元桥，古时秀才要在这里举行入泮仪式，场面甚为壮观。

继续前行穿过大成门，正对的便是文庙的主要建筑——大成殿。

两棵茂盛粗壮的大榕树簇拥在大殿两侧，正中塑着一尊孔子的雕像，让整个大殿显得气势恢宏。

我们见到孔像前的炉中香火未灭，看来是不久前这里才有学生前来祭拜过。

大概是考试在即，学生们都来拜孔子以祈求自己能有个好成绩。

大成殿为重檐歇山顶，器宇轩昂，上挂万世师表之匾，此四字乃取康熙二十二年(1684年)圣祖仁皇帝亲御书匾额之典故，据记载是大成殿得到的首块赐匾上的内容。

崇圣祠位于大成殿之后，几乎与学校结合到了一起，内供奉着孔子五世的塑像和牌位。

芦山地震后，当地对文庙进行了紧急的加固处理。

棂星门也被木头撑上，大成门部分塌陷的地方也用钢筋暂时加固，虽说浸在书香中少了游人的打扰，可是文庙现在的状况也不由得让人有些担忧。

英文翻译 English Translation

Mingshan Confucian Temple is located within Mingshan Middle School on Yuehua Mountain.

The school built separate teaching buildings beside the temple, coexisting peacefully with it.

Since the temple is inside the middle school, the school refuses tour groups to avoid disrupting classes, so the temple remains serene and secluded, untouched by the secular world.

Confucian temples, also called Confucius temples, are a special Chinese architectural type — ritual temples built beside academies since ancient times for sacrificing to Confucius.

Mingshan Confucian Temple was built in the 21st year of Daoguang (1841), consisting of Wanren Wall, Lingxing Gate, Zhuangyuan Bridge, Dacheng Gate, left and right wing rooms, Dacheng Hall, and Chongsheng Shrine.

The Wanren Wall has been demolished; climbing the long stone stairs, passing through the Mingshan Middle School gate, the temple suddenly appears before you.

Amid green trees, the crimson Lingxing Gate first catches the eye.

The Lingxing Gate places the meaning of "Spirit Star" above the Confucian temple, signifying that Confucius should be revered as heaven is revered; it is carved with moon rabbit and golden horse, sun and moon motifs, meaning Confucius' virtue shines with the sun and moon.

Directly opposite the Lingxing Gate are three nine-hole dragon-carved stone bridges spanning the Pan Pool, called Zhuangyuan (Top Scholar) Bridges, where ancient xiucai (cultivated talents) held the entering-Pan ceremony with spectacular scenes.

Continuing forward through Dacheng Gate, directly opposite is the temple's main building — Dacheng Hall.

Two lush, sturdy banyan trees flank the hall, with a statue of Confucius in the center, making the hall appear imposing.

We saw incense still burning in the brazier before the Confucius statue, apparently students had come to worship not long ago.

Probably with exams approaching, students come to pray to Confucius for good grades.

Dacheng Hall has a double-eave xieshan roof, dignified and imposing, with a plaque reading "Teacher of Ten Thousand Generations" — these four characters derive from the plaque personally inscribed by the Kangxi Emperor in the 22nd year of Kangxi (1684), recorded as the first imperial bestowed plaque received by Dacheng Hall.

Chongsheng Shrine is behind Dacheng Hall, almost integrated with the school, enshrining statues and tablets of Confucius' five generations.

After the Lushan earthquake, local authorities carried out emergency reinforcement of the temple.

The Lingxing Gate was propped up with wood, and partially collapsed areas of Dacheng Gate were temporarily reinforced with steel bars.

Though immersed in scholarly atmosphere and free from tourist disturbance, the temple's current condition is somewhat worrying.

九襄石牌坊

Stone Memorial Archway in Jiuxiang
省级 清 石坊
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address雅安市汉源县九襄镇
类型 Type石坊
看点 Highlights: 石刻 民间故事

中文描述 Description

九襄石牌坊就在雅安市汉源县九襄镇的汉源街尽头。

明清时期南方丝绸之路从九襄经过，石牌坊就位于这远近闻名的茶马古道之上。

据说，清道光二十九年(1849年)，一个名叫黄体诚的人，由于自己父亲早逝，仰仗寡母和嫂嫂养大，如今发迹，便请清溪县令上奏朝廷，希望修建牌坊表彰纪念。

道光帝于是批准在此地修建双节孝石牌坊，即如今的九襄石牌坊。

九襄石牌坊为四层多脊檐，共三门四柱，柱前后均有石狮。

石材直接取自对面南山的青石。

由于檐角翘起夸张，而脊饰又十分夸张，所以远远看去石牌坊就像着了火一般。

石牌坊明间的匾额刻有节孝二字，上方屋脊上为一宝塔，而额枋等处则刻有各种浮雕、圆雕。

据介绍，牌坊下面两层分别按忠、孝、节、义的主题雕刻了48部经典川剧，共计169个场景，包括《三英战吕布》《穆桂英挂帅》等剧作，规模宏大。

曾经有人从整个牌坊上数出了近800个人物，而每个人物都栩栩如生，可见当年精妙的石刻工艺。

据传，石牌坊刚修好不久，就有外来商人被其精美所吸引，遂盗走了一雕像的头颅，最终流落海外。

2005年，石牌坊被评为省级文保单位，修建了护栏，请了当地百姓看护，但实际上并没有得到什么像样的保护。

汶川5·12地震后，汉源损失惨重，幸而基础牢固，石牌坊除了一角掉了下来，并无大碍。

英文翻译 English Translation

Jiuxiang Stone Memorial Archway stands at the end of Hanyuan Street in Jiuxiang Town, Hanyuan County, Ya'an.

During the Ming and Qing dynasties, the Southern Silk Road passed through Jiuxiang, and the archway sits on this well-known Ancient Tea-Horse Road.

According to legend, in the 29th year of Daoguang (1849), a man named Huang Ticheng, whose father died early and who was raised by his widowed mother and sister-in-law, having become prosperous, asked the Qingxi County magistrate to petition the court, hoping to build an archway in commemoration.

The Daoguang Emperor then approved the construction of a Double Chastity and Filial Piety stone archway here — today's Jiuxiang Stone Archway.

Jiuxiang Stone Archway has four stories with multiple ridge eaves, three gateways and four columns, with stone lions in front of and behind the columns.

The stone was quarried directly from Qingshi (blue stone) on the opposite South Mountain.

Because the eave corners curl up exaggeratedly and the ridge ornaments are also very exaggerated, from a distance the archway looks as if it were on fire.

The plaque in the central bay is carved with the characters "Jie Xiao" (Chastity and Filial Piety); above the ridge is a pagoda, and the architraves and other parts are carved with various reliefs and round sculptures.

According to descriptions, the lower two stories of the archway are carved with 48 classic Sichuan operas on the themes of loyalty, filial piety, chastity, and righteousness, totaling 169 scenes, including "Three Heroes Fight Lu Bu" and "Mu Guiying Takes Command" — on a grand scale.

Someone once counted nearly 800 figures across the entire archway, each lifelike, demonstrating the exquisite stone carving craftsmanship of the era.

According to legend, shortly after the archway was completed, a foreign merchant was attracted by its beauty and stole the head of one statue, which eventually ended up overseas.

In 2005, the archway was designated a provincial cultural relic protection unit; guardrails were built and local people hired to watch over it, but in practice it has not received proper protection.

After the Wenchuan 5·12 earthquake, Hanyuan suffered heavy losses; fortunately the foundation was solid, and apart from one corner falling off, the archway was not seriously damaged.

西湖胜境石牌坊

"Splendid Views of West Lake" Stone Memorial Archway
省级 明 牌坊
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address雅安市天全县大坪乡破磷村
类型 Type牌坊
看点 Highlights: 石作 彩绘 土司文化

中文描述 Description

西湖胜境石牌坊处在始阳镇破磷村边。

自始阳镇往天全县城走一公里即可到达连接破磷村与318国道的胜利大桥，在桥上便能遥望石牌坊。

不过要想先一睹石牌坊的真容，得先从村中绕过去。

村口一块碑上赫然写着天全茶马古道石头寨。

经了解，这里原来是土司遗址，而石牌坊正是其中一处。

西湖胜境石牌坊为四柱三间三楼，红砂岩质。

整个牌坊结构较为简单，雕饰俭省，柱下有抱鼓石。

石牌坊前匾额刻有西湖胜境，后匾额为父子忠良，字迹都有些模糊不清。

在匾额上下分别依稀可见双凤朝阳、二龙戏珠的图案，旁边门洞的额枋上还残存有彩绘的痕迹。

由于年久失修的缘故，牌坊其他地方的雕刻就更加难以辨识。

经查阅，牌坊上还题有天全六番招讨使司正招讨使讨将军高继光立书。

据文献记载，西湖胜境石牌坊是天全六番招讨使高继光于明嘉靖二十三年(1544年)为纪念先辈所立。

不同于其他地区，天全古时由汉人担任土司。

唐代黄巢起义发生后，唐僖宗逃往成都，随后便命令江南临江府人高卜锡等人平息雅安一带的叛乱。

叛乱平息后，高卜锡便留下建立了土司，一直沿袭到清朝的改土归流。

西湖胜境石牌坊的前面是一大片的玉米地，周围都是荒地。

斑驳的牌坊，告诉了世人土司的兴衰荣辱。

英文翻译 English Translation

"Splendid Views of West Lake" Stone Memorial Archway is located beside Polin Village, Shiyang Town.

Traveling one kilometer from Shiyang Town toward Tianquan County seat brings you to Shengli Bridge connecting Polin Village with National Highway 318; from the bridge one can see the archway in the distance.

However, to get a close look, one must first detour through the village.

A stele at the village entrance prominently reads "Tianquan Ancient Tea-Horse Road Stone Village." Upon inquiry, this was originally a Tusi (chieftain) site, and the archway is one of its remains.

The archway has four columns, three bays, and three stories, made of red sandstone.

The overall structure is relatively simple, with sparing ornamentation and drum-shaped stone bases under the columns.

The front plaque is carved with "Splendid Views of West Lake," and the rear plaque reads "Father and Son Loyal and Virtuous" — both somewhat blurred.

Above and below the plaques, patterns of double phoenixes facing the sun and two dragons playing with a pearl are faintly visible; traces of colored painting remain on the architraves of the side gateways.

Due to long neglect, carvings elsewhere on the archway are even harder to discern.

Upon research, the archway also bears an inscription: "Erected and inscribed by Gao Jiguang, General and Chief Pacification Commissioner of the Tianquan Liufan Pacification Commission." According to historical records, the archway was erected by Gao Jiguang, Pacification Commissioner of Tianquan Liufan, in the 23rd year of Jiajing (1544), Ming dynasty, to commemorate his ancestors.

Unlike other regions, Tianquan was historically governed by Han Chinese Tusi.

After the Huang Chao Uprising in Tang dynasty, Emperor Xizong fled to Chengdu and then ordered Gao Boxi of Linjiang Prefecture in Jiangnan and others to quell the rebellion in the Ya'an area.

After the rebellion was suppressed, Gao Boxi stayed and established the Tusi system, which persisted until the Qing dynasty's "Gaitu Guiliu" (replacement of Tusi with appointed officials).

In front of the archway is a large cornfield, surrounded by wasteland.

The mottled archway tells the world of the rise and fall, glory and shame of the Tusi.

蒙顶山古建筑群

Ancient Building Complex at Mengding Mountain
省级 明—清 建筑群
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address雅安市名山区
类型 Type建筑群
看点 Highlights: 古寺 石牌坊 茶文化 石梯

中文描述 Description

蒙顶山以茶闻名于世。

自唐代天宝年间开始，就为皇家种植贡茶，沿袭1200余年。

悠久的文化历史，超凡脱俗的环境，使得蒙顶山上逐渐形成了一个古建筑群。

进入景区大门，如果不选择索道的话，便可登天梯上山。

自公路初望天梯，便觉心惊，一列接近70度的台阶似直入云霄。

这一登山梯道自唐时便已存在，千百年来贡茶由这一梯道离开蒙顶，一共1000余级的台阶，承载了不少的风风雨雨。

登上天梯便是天盖寺，天盖寺大殿始建于清乾隆四十三年(1778年)，穿斗式悬山顶，面阔五间，进深四间。

相传此处曾为蒙茶祖师吴理真种茶之地，内供吴理真全身坐像。

天盖寺大殿形制简洁，但它的宝顶却比较独特，弥勒、二龙戏珠等画面一起出现。

大殿后有碑林，以天下大蒙顶山碑为代表。

绕过天盖寺继续上山，不远处就是甘露灵泉院石牌坊。

石牌坊在雅安地震中受损严重，额枋以上几乎全部掉落。

但仍可看出牌坊为四柱三间三楼，额枋上还残存着精致的斗拱。

牌坊上刻有许多花纹，书写的字迹有的已经无法辨识，柱下的抱鼓石近一人高，足见牌坊之前的宏伟。

看着地上堆积起来的残件，只希望早日能够修复牌坊。

蒙顶山景区之外还有一较大的寺庙——永兴寺，位于自景区往雅安的公路边。

永兴寺自外向内依次为石牌坊、山门、白石楼、大雄宝殿、观音殿，之后仍望早日能够修复牌坊。

永兴寺的建筑主要结构皆为石头，十分独特，体量厚重。

寺庙始建于三国时期，相传为天竺僧空定大师所建。

宋代西域僧不动法师在此撰写了《蒙山施食仪》，传遍海内外。

英文翻译 English Translation

Mengding Mountain is world-famous for tea.

Since the Tang Tianbao era, it has grown tribute tea for the imperial court, a tradition lasting over 1,200 years.

Its long cultural history and transcendent environment gradually formed an ancient building complex on Mengding Mountain.

Entering the scenic area gate, if not taking the cable car, one can climb the Heavenly Ladder up the mountain.

Looking up at the ladder from the road, one feels awestruck — a flight of steps at nearly 70 degrees seems to pierce straight into the clouds.

This climbing stairway has existed since Tang dynasty; for a thousand years, tribute tea left Mengding via this stairway.

With over 1,000 steps, it has borne much wind and rain.

At the top of the ladder is Tiangai Temple; its main hall was founded in the 43rd year of Qianlong (1778), with a chuan-dou overhanging gable roof, 5 bays wide, 4 bays deep.

According to legend, this was once the tea-planting site of Wu Lizhen, the founder of Meng tea; inside enshrines a full-body seated statue of Wu Lizhen.

Tiangai Temple Main Hall has a simple form, but its finial is rather unique, with Maitreya and two-dragons-playing-with-a-pearl motifs appearing together.

Behind the hall is a stele forest, represented by the "World's Great Mengding Mountain" stele.

Bypassing Tiangai Temple and continuing uphill, not far away is the Ganlu Lingquan Courtyard Stone Archway.

The archway was severely damaged in the Ya'an earthquake; almost everything above the architrave fell off.

However, one can still see it was a four-column, three-bay, three-story archway, with exquisite bracket sets remaining on the architrave.

The archway is carved with many patterns; some inscriptions are no longer legible, and the drum-shaped stone bases under the columns are nearly a person's height — testifying to the archway's former grandeur.

Looking at the debris piled on the ground, one can only hope the archway will be restored soon.

Outside the Mengding Mountain scenic area is another larger temple — Yongxing Temple, located by the road from the scenic area toward Ya'an.

From outside in, Yongxing Temple consists of stone archway, mountain gate, White Stone Tower, Mahavira Hall, and Guanyin Hall.

The main structural elements of Yongxing Temple are all stone — very unique and massive in volume.

The temple was founded in the Three Kingdoms period, legend says by the Indian monk Master Kongding.

In Song dynasty, the Western Region monk Master Budong wrote the "Mengshan Food Offering Ritual" here, which spread throughout China and abroad.

水月寺

Shuiyue Temple
省级 明—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address雅安市名山区车岭镇
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 明代木构 雕像 庙会

中文描述 Description

在车岭镇中心卫生院下车，向东南走100多米便到了水月寺。

在路边供奉着一尊观音菩萨像，地上的香灰积了不知有多厚。

进入水月寺，一侧简易的棚屋下供奉着两尊塑像，一大一小。

正对的就是水月寺的大雄宝殿，穿斗式重檐歇山顶。

始建于元代，于清乾隆五年(1740年)重建，殿内仍有毛笔书元朝太元正七年觉先禅师重建。

檐下不用斗拱，因而屋顶没有明显的凹曲线，形制简单。

殿前左右各有矮墙，上书南无本师释迦牟尼等字。

进入殿内，三尊佛像居于中央，香气缭绕，金碧辉煌；

两侧有十八罗汉像，姿态各异，神情丰富，栩栩如生。

另一观音殿为抬梁式歇山顶，始建于唐，明成化元年(1465年)复建。

水月寺始建于唐代，最初名为鸟鹫灵祗园，宋更名为水月禅院。

历经千年发展，水月寺曾经与蒙顶山禅寺甘露祖师道场齐名，同为雅安一带的佛教圣地。

寺庙规模宏大，殿宇金碧辉煌，有人曾于距今水月寺一公里多外挖到过之前水月寺的遗物。

后来到了1953年，佛像被毁，接着被改为孤儿院和各类学校，最后仅剩两座大殿得以保存。

千年沧桑，盛极一时的水月寺已经难觅往日的荣光。

去时恰逢农历六月十九，相传这一天是观音菩萨的生日。

镇上的男女老少云集于此，虔诚地拜佛烧香。

水月寺内烟雾缭绕，人声鼎沸，好像千年以来这里从未改变一样。

英文翻译 English Translation

Getting off at the Cheling Town Central Health Center, walking southeast for over 100 meters brings you to Shuiyue Temple.

By the roadside, a statue of Guanyin Bodhisattva is enshrined, with incense ash on the ground accumulated to unknown thickness.

Entering Shuiyue Temple, beneath a simple shed on one side are enshrined two statues, one large and one small.

Directly opposite is Shuiyue Temple's Mahavira Hall, with a chuan-dou double-eave xieshan roof.

Founded in Yuan dynasty, rebuilt in the 5th year of Qianlong (1740); inside the hall still bears a brush inscription: "Reconstructed by Master Juexian in the 7th year of Taiyuan Zheng of the Yuan dynasty." No bracket sets are used beneath the eaves, so the roof has no obvious concave curve, with a simple form.

On the left and right in front of the hall are low walls, inscribed with "Namo Original Teacher Shakyamuni" and other characters.

Entering the hall, three Buddha statues occupy the center, surrounded by incense smoke, resplendent in gold; on both sides are Eighteen Arhat statues, each with different postures, rich expressions, and lifelike appearance.

Another Guanyin Hall has a post-and-lintel xieshan roof, founded in Tang dynasty and rebuilt in the 1st year of Chenghua (1465), Ming.

Shuiyue Temple was founded in Tang dynasty, originally named Niaojiu Lingzhi Garden, renamed Shuiyue Chan Courtyard in Song dynasty.

Through a thousand years of development, Shuiyue Temple was once as famous as the Mengding Mountain Chan Temple Ganlu Patriarch's道场, both being Buddhist holy sites in the Ya'an area.

The temple was large-scale with resplendent halls; someone once dug up relics of the former Shuiyue Temple over a kilometer away from the current site.

Later in 1953, the Buddha statues were destroyed, then the temple was converted into an orphanage and various schools, finally leaving only two main halls preserved.

Through a thousand years of vicissitudes, the once-flourishing Shuiyue Temple can hardly be found in its former glory.

My visit coincided with the 19th day of the 6th lunar month, traditionally the birthday of Guanyin Bodhisattva.

Men and women, old and young from the town gathered here, devoutly worshipping Buddha and burning incense.

Inside Shuiyue Temple, smoke swirled and voices buzzed, as if nothing had changed here for a thousand years.

观音阁

Guanyin Hall
国家级 明—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address雅安市雨城区县前街
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 明代木构 曲线

中文描述 Description

初到雅安城，若问当地人何处有古建筑，当地人十有八九会提及观音阁。

观音阁始建于明代，原名月心阁。

大概是因为后山形如半月，被命名为月心山，就把山下的寺庙取名月心阁。

据当地人说，几十年前观音阁尚存有三重殿和其他几十间房屋，但如今只留下了正殿。

观音阁正殿为抬梁式重檐歇山顶，面阔五间，进深三间。

下昂弯曲上翘，曲线元素的加入，使得清晰理性的结构变得活泼有趣起来。

翼角稍稍翘起，形成十分优美的弧度，建筑体态舒展轻盈。

虽然做工如此精湛，但观音阁终究抵不住岁月的侵袭。

近些年来，观音阁岌岌可危，斑驳的木头开始腐坏，屋瓦大面积脱落，当地文物保护部门不得不用木棍把它各个部分全都支撑起来。

2013年雅安地震发生后，观音阁西北角发生垮塌，建筑也彻底倾斜，百年古建筑风雨飘摇。

幸而2013年8月，当地部门总算开始着手彻底修复观音阁。

一根根脚手架架在了文物上，将行将颓圮的历史守护了起来。

从观音阁出来的街上，是一个菜市场。

菜市场人来人往，观音阁却门可罗雀，希望修缮能够给它带来新生。

英文翻译 English Translation

Upon first arriving in Ya'an city, if you ask locals where there are ancient buildings, nine out of ten will mention Guanyin Hall.

Guanyin Hall was founded in Ming dynasty, originally named Yuexin (Moon Heart) Pavilion.

Probably because the rear mountain was shaped like a half-moon, it was named Yuexin Mountain, and the temple at its foot was named Yuexin Pavilion.

According to locals, decades ago Guanyin Hall still had three main halls and dozens of other rooms, but today only the main hall remains.

Guanyin Hall Main Hall has a post-and-lintel double-eave xieshan roof, 5 bays wide, 3 bays deep.

The lower ang (lever arms) curve upward; the addition of curvilinear elements makes the clear, rational structure lively and interesting.

The wing corners tilt slightly upward, forming a very graceful arc; the building's form is舒展 and light.

Though the craftsmanship is so exquisite, Guanyin Hall ultimately cannot resist the ravages of time.

In recent years, Guanyin Hall has become precarious; mottled wood has begun to rot, roof tiles have fallen off in large areas, and local cultural relics protection authorities had to prop up all its parts with wooden poles.

After the 2013 Ya'an earthquake, the northwest corner of Guanyin Hall collapsed, and the building tilted completely — the century-old ancient building was teetering in the wind and rain.

Fortunately, in August 2013, local authorities finally began thorough restoration of Guanyin Hall.

Scaffolding was erected around the cultural relic, guarding the history on the verge of collapse.

The street outside Guanyin Hall is a vegetable market.

The market is bustling with people coming and going, while Guanyin Hall is deserted.

It is hoped that the restoration will bring it new life.

金凤寺

Jinfeng Temple
省级 明—清 宗教建筑、木结构、石作
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address雅安市雨城区
类型 Type宗教建筑、木结构、石作
看点 Highlights: 木结构 天梯 景观

中文描述 Description

去金凤寺那天正值观音菩萨得道日(农历六月十九)，金凤寺游人如织，慕名前来拜祭的人们买了上好的高香，沿着修整好的长长的石梯涌上金凤寺。

前去拜祭的路绝不轻松，天梯长226米、宽9米，共11梯879阶台阶。

如果腿脚不好或是体力不济，倒也可以选择另一条铺砌好的绕山公路，一路坐车到揽辉亭。

登上山顶极目远眺，蜿蜒的青衣江，绵延的群山，高楼大厦耸立，阡陌田埂紧凑，盛景一览眼底。

金凤寺始建于唐初，兴盛于宋，重建扩建于明清，距今已有600多年的历史了。

金凤寺占地近1万平方米，是典型的川西民居型庭院式群体建筑。

周边的亭、榭、池、坊、廊、园、墓、塔错落有致，天王、弥勒、大雄、观音四殿建筑规模宏大。

殿堂具明清风格，楼雕石缸工艺精湛。

寺内藏经阁内珍藏有经书500多卷，名人匾对100余幅。

最为珍贵的要属幅匾，乃宋朝书法家米芾、黄庭坚所书。

由于节日的缘故，寺里游人熙熙攘攘。

殿前的广场上放满了高香，香烟袅袅让人几乎看不清庙宇的轮廓。

听当地人说，寺院平日里香火便很好，今日更是鼎盛非常。

若是前来游玩，千万别忘了也在这灵验的寺院前点上一炷香，求个平安吉祥。

英文翻译 English Translation

The day I visited Jinfeng Temple coincided with the day Guanyin Bodhisattva attained enlightenment (19th day of the 6th lunar month).

Jinfeng Temple was thronged with visitors; people coming to worship bought fine tall incense and swarmed up the long, well-maintained stone stairs to Jinfeng Temple.

The path to worship is by no means easy: the Heavenly Ladder is 226m long, 9m wide, with 11 flights and 879 steps.

If one has weak legs or lacks stamina, one can choose another paved mountain-circling road, riding all the way to Lanhui Pavilion.

Climbing to the mountain top and looking far into the distance, the winding Qingyi River, rolling mountains, towering high-rises, and compact field paths all come into view — a grand panorama.

Jinfeng Temple was founded in early Tang, flourished in Song, and was rebuilt and expanded in Ming-Qing, with a history of over 600 years.

Jinfeng Temple covers nearly 10,000 sq m, a typical Western Sichuan residential-style courtyard complex.

Surrounding pavilions, terraces, pools, archways, corridors, gardens, tombs, and pagodas are well-arranged; the four halls of Heavenly Kings, Maitreya, Mahavira, and Guanyin are large-scale.

The halls have Ming-Qing style, with exquisitely carved stone vats.

The temple's Scripture Pavilion preserves over 500 volumes of scriptures and over 100 famous calligraphic plaques and couplets.

The most precious are plaques written by Song dynasty calligraphers Mi Fu and Huang Tingjian.

Due to the festival, the temple was crowded with visitors.

The square in front of the hall was filled with tall incense; curling smoke made it almost impossible to see the temple's outline.

Locals say the temple's incense is already good on ordinary days, and today it is especially flourishing.

If you come to visit, be sure to light a stick of incense in front of this efficacious temple, praying for peace and good fortune.

芦山佛图寺

Fotu Temple in Lushan
省级 明—清 宗教建筑、木结构、石作
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address雅安市雨城区
类型 Type宗教建筑、木结构、石作
看点 Highlights: 木结构 天梯 景观

中文描述 Description

佛图寺位于芦山县城西南边的山上。

从芦山老城过河到了西江村，沿着上山的公路走到佛图山的垭口，便来到了佛图寺脚下。

事实上，最初的佛图寺塔即保留了佛图寺塔和摩崖造像。

后来将县城中的古建筑集中搬迁于此，便形成了如今的佛图寺，以至于寺内建筑年代不尽相同，从元代一直延续到清代。

佛图寺内现存有大雄宝殿、祖师殿(原芦山老城南街广福寺大殿)、白塔寺大殿、佛图寺塔等古建筑物。

其中，祖师殿为抬梁式歇山顶，面阔、进深均为三间，据推测是明早期建筑物。

建筑无论内外都保存完好，结构清晰，整体形态厚实威严。

大雄宝殿屋顶为歇山顶，其上的宝塔饰有二龙戏珠的雕刻，十分精美。

白塔寺大殿的壁画在县博物馆展出，惊艳至极。

佛图寺原有的佛图寺塔是楼阁式石塔，六角七层攒尖顶，高约三米。

塔身近白色，每层开假门，某些层还开假窗。

叠涩出檐，塔身砖石分明可见，坚实挺拔。

由于雅安一带终年多雨，天气潮湿，所以塔身遍布苔藓，有的地方还长出了杂草，更为石塔增添了一份历史的沧桑感。

佛图寺历经两次地震，可谓多灾多难。

2008年汶川地震使得佛图寺塔最高一层错位；

2013年雅安地震由于芦山就是震中，所以损失更为惨重。

寺内建筑几乎全部成为危房，佛像损毁严重，而佛图寺塔上部直接断裂。

但僧人们在地震后仍然到芦山县城施粥赈灾，一时传为佳话。

英文翻译 English Translation

Fotu Temple is located on the mountain southwest of Lushan County town.

Crossing the river from old Lushan town to Xijiang Village, following the uphill road to the pass of Fotu Mountain, you arrive at the foot of Fotu Temple.

In fact, the original Fotu Temple Pagoda and cliff carvings were preserved here.

Later, ancient buildings from the county town were relocated and concentrated here, forming today's Fotu Temple — so the buildings within the temple date from different periods, from Yuan to Qing dynasty.

Currently surviving in Fotu Temple are the Mahavira Hall, Zushi Hall (originally the main hall of Guangfu Temple on South Street of old Lushan town), White Pagoda Temple Main Hall, and Fotu Temple Pagoda.

Among them, Zushi Hall has a post-and-lintel xieshan roof, 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep, presumed to be an early Ming building.

The building is well preserved both inside and out, with clear structure and a solid, imposing overall form.

The Mahavira Hall has a xieshan roof, with its pagoda finial carved with two dragons playing with a pearl — very exquisite.

Murals from the White Pagoda Temple Main Hall are exhibited at the county museum, stunningly beautiful.

The original Fotu Temple Pagoda is a pavilion-style stone pagoda, hexagonal with seven stories and a pyramidal roof, about 3m tall.

The pagoda body is nearly white, with false doors on each story and false windows on some.

With corbelled eaves, the brick and stone of the body are clearly visible, solid and upright.

Due to year-round rain and humid weather in the Ya'an area, the pagoda body is covered with moss, and weeds grow in some places, adding a sense of historical vicissitudes to the stone pagoda.

Fotu Temple has endured two earthquakes — truly disaster-prone.

The 2008 Wenchuan earthquake caused the top story of Fotu Temple Pagoda to shift; the 2013 Ya'an earthquake, with Lushan as the epicenter, caused even more severe losses.

Almost all buildings in the temple became dangerous structures, Buddha statues were heavily damaged, and the upper part of Fotu Temple Pagoda broke directly.

However, after the earthquake, monks still went to Lushan County town to distribute porridge for disaster relief, which became a much-told story.

芦山涌泉寺

Yongquan Temple in Lushan
省级 明—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address雅安市芦山县升隆乡五显村东北300米
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 重建

中文描述 Description

芦山地震震中就在涌泉寺附近，这给了这座寺庙几乎是毁灭性的打击。

我们去时已事隔一年，被夷平了后的五星村目前正在重建，路还没有铺完，走到尽头又步行了20分钟，才找到寺院。

据资料说涌泉寺坐北向南，占地面积4242平方米，两进四合院布局，存前殿、大殿、藏经楼及左右厢房。

可如今这里乱石密布，无人看管，一条石子路从寺院的殿旁穿过去，整个寺院已经成了此地居民的暂时安置所。

曾经的前殿，悬山屋顶、穿斗式梁架清晰可辨，只是成了在此地做工的人遮风避雨的场所；

藏经阁重檐歇山顶形制尚存，只是完全成了居民居住之处。

虽说古迹被人胡乱侵占实在令人扼腕，但是强震过后依然坚固不倒的寺庙如今能以这样的方式继续庇护众生，也让人能稍有安慰。

目前五星村重建工作正进行得如火如荼，希望涌泉寺也能早日恢复重建。

英文翻译 English Translation

The epicenter of the Lushan earthquake was right near Yongquan Temple, dealing this temple an almost devastating blow.

When we visited, a year had passed; Wuxing Village, which had been leveled, was currently under reconstruction, with roads not yet fully paved.

Walking to the end and then another 20 minutes on foot, we finally found the temple.

According to资料, Yongquan Temple faces south, covers 4,242 sq m, with a two-courtyard siheyuan layout, preserving the front hall, main hall, scripture library, and left and right wing rooms.

But today the area is densely covered with rubble, unattended; a gravel path passes beside the temple halls, and the entire temple has become a temporary resettlement site for local residents.

The former front hall, with its overhanging gable roof and chuan-dou frame clearly discernible, has simply become a shelter from wind and rain for people working here; the scripture library's double-eave xieshan roof form still survives, but it has completely become residential housing.

Though it is lamentable that ancient relics are being haphazardly occupied, it is somewhat comforting that the temple — still solid and uncollapsed after the strong earthquake — can continue to shelter living beings in this way.

Currently, reconstruction work in Wuxing Village is in full swing; it is hoped that Yongquan Temple can also be restored and rebuilt soon.

飞仙关南界牌坊

Nanjie Stone Memorial Archway in Feixianguan Town
国家级 明—清 牌坊
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address雅安市芦山县飞仙关镇
类型 Type牌坊
看点 Highlights: 石作

中文描述 Description

在2014年年末，飞仙关南界牌坊被选入了全国重点文物保护单位，保护范围为牌坊四周外延20米。

这也算是给了这个隐藏在现代化中的名胜应该有的关注。

南界牌坊是一个城镇边界的标志，也是一段历史的记忆。

随着工业发展，周围修起了高楼、水坝，牌坊就这样被湮没在了机器的丛林之中。

当地的老人说飞仙关分为上关和下关两个部分，其间相距有好几里路，而这牌坊是以前的交通要道，据史料记载，中央红军和红四方面军先后途经飞仙关。

现在由于修起了更加宽大的水泥公路，所以这条古道也算是被废弃了，只是在周围的居民会在这里行走。

牌坊四周是当地人的住宅，那些房子还是比较古老的土房或者红砖房。

由于鲜有行人往来，牌坊周围的楼梯都生了青苔，而牌坊上面布满了灰尘和蛛网。

虽然牌坊保存比较完整，刻的字还比较清楚，但是由于年代久远，牌坊透露着一股沧桑感。

周围满是嘈杂的机器声，而这里还保持着原本的宁静。

老人在阳光下默默晒着太阳，偶尔传出小狗的吠叫，仿佛一切都还处于几十年前。

英文翻译 English Translation

At the end of 2014, Feixianguan Nanjie Stone Memorial Archway was selected as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit, with a protection scope extending 20 meters around the archway.

This can be regarded as giving this famous site hidden in modernization the attention it deserves.

Nanjie Archway is a marker of a town boundary and a memory of history.

With industrial development, high-rises and dams were built around it, and the archway was thus submerged in a jungle of machinery.

Local elders say Feixianguan was divided into Upper Pass and Lower Pass, several li apart; this archway was formerly a major transportation route.

According to historical records, the Central Red Army and the Fourth Front Red Army passed through Feixianguan successively.

Now that a wider cement highway has been built, this ancient road can be considered abandoned, with only surrounding residents walking here.

Around the archway are local residences — still relatively old earthen houses or red brick houses.

With few pedestrians passing by, the stairs around the archway have grown moss, and the archway is covered with dust and cobwebs.

Although the archway is relatively well preserved and its inscriptions are still fairly clear, due to its age it exudes a sense of vicissitudes.

The surroundings are full of noisy machine sounds, while here the original tranquility is maintained.

Elders silently sunbathe in the sunlight, occasionally a puppy barks — as if everything is still as it was decades ago.

名山观音殿

Guanyin Hall in Mingshan
省级 明 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address雅安市名山县马岭镇康乐村东南50米
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 明代木构

中文描述 Description

说名山观音殿是被遗忘的古迹一点也不为过，别说是县城，就是马岭镇上知道这个殿的人也寥寥无几。

拜托了一个摩托车师傅(当地没有出租车，都是靠这样的野摩托代步)将我们载到康乐村，才从村民口中得知了寺庙的存在。

据载，观音殿始建于明代洪武二年(1369年)，坐西向东，面阔三间18米，进深三间11.5米，高二层7米，素面台基高0.28米，重檐歇山顶，抬梁式梁架，具有明代木构建筑特征。

当地村民说此地香火一直不盛，除了本村的人偶尔会前来祭拜以外，几乎没有什么人。

我们到达当日正是观音得道的纪念日(农历六月十九)，但殿前依然香火寥寥，与前几个香火鼎盛的寺庙相比，此殿也确实算得上孤苦伶仃。

省文保的保护范围是外延10米，建筑控制范围是外延20米，但是观音殿现在就挤在一堆民房中间，俨然成了某家住户的小后院了。

紧邻着观音殿旁边正在修新的楼房，对观音殿岌岌可危的状况无疑是雪上加霜。

不过喜欢离市游玩的游客也不妨来看看这古殿，体验一下不为人知的历史记忆。

英文翻译 English Translation

Calling Mingshan Guanyin Hall a forgotten relic is no exaggeration — let alone the county seat, even in Maling Town few people know about this hall.

We asked a motorcycle driver (there are no taxis locally; people rely on such informal motorcycles for transport) to take us to Kangle Village, and only from villagers did we learn of the temple's existence.

According to records, Guanyin Hall was founded in the 2nd year of Hongwu (1369), Ming dynasty, facing east, 3 bays wide (18m), 3 bays deep (11.5m), two stories (7m tall), with a plain platform base 0.28m high, double-eave xieshan roof, and post-and-lintel frame — characteristic of Ming dynasty timber architecture.

Local villagers say the incense here has never been flourishing; apart from occasional worship by villagers of this village, almost no one comes.

The day we arrived was the commemoration day of Guanyin's enlightenment (19th day of the 6th lunar month), but incense in front of the hall was still sparse — compared with the previous several temples with flourishing incense, this hall can indeed be considered lonely and forlorn.

The provincial cultural relic protection scope extends 10 meters outward, and the building control scope extends 20 meters, but Guanyin Hall is now squeezed among a cluster of folk houses, virtually becoming a small backyard of some household.

A new building is being constructed right next to Guanyin Hall, which undoubtedly adds insult to injury to the hall's precarious condition.

However, tourists who like off-the-beaten-path travel might as well come see this ancient hall and experience a little-known historical memory.

名山金刚寺

Jingang Temple in Mingshan
省级 明 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address雅安市名山区车岭镇金刚村三社
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 明代木构

中文描述 Description

到了车岭镇上，向当地人打听到金刚寺的路线。

最后乘上了一辆摩托车，司机便带我们疾驰在乡间的小道上。

开始还是能够通车的水泥路，后来就变成了田埂。

大约10分钟后，司机提醒金刚寺到了。

金刚寺给来者的第一印象是正殿的一面山墙，除了裸露的梁柱之外，实在难以找到完好的墙面。

茅草、竹席等都糊在了墙上，间杂几个孔洞，残破不堪。

进了院子，只有正殿是古物。

金刚寺正殿为抬梁式重檐悬山顶，面阔、进深均为三间。

檐下施五铺作，明间两朵补间铺作，次间各一朵。

殿内除供有佛像外，还供着道家的玉皇大帝和王母的座像，看来是一座佛道共存的寺庙。

据文献记载，金刚寺始建于唐，重修于明正统年间(1436—1449年)。

而到如今，金刚寺已经衰败，几天都难见前来进香的人。

正殿的墙面几乎都有所损毁，屋瓦大面积脱落，木结构损坏，不得不用砖砌着支撑房屋。

据看护寺庙的老奶奶讲，她已经一个人在这儿十几年了。

这么多年老人独自苦苦支撑着这座衰败寺院，这种坚守给我们带来了震撼与崇敬。

老人又说，文保部门前不久已经来调研过，寺庙很快将得到修缮和保护。

2014年8月，金刚寺修缮项目开始招标，老人十几年的使命画上了圆满的句号。

英文翻译 English Translation

Arriving at Cheling Town, we asked locals for directions to Jingang Temple.

Finally we boarded a motorcycle, and the driver sped us along country lanes.

At first it was a passable cement road, then it became field ridges.

About 10 minutes later, the driver alerted us that Jingang Temple had arrived.

Jingang Temple's first impression on visitors is one gable wall of the main hall — apart from exposed beams and columns, it is hard to find an intact wall surface.

Thatch, bamboo mats, and the like are plastered on the wall, interspersed with several holes — dilapidated beyond description.

Entering the courtyard, only the main hall is an ancient relic.

Jingang Temple Main Hall has a post-and-lintel double-eave overhanging gable roof, 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep.

Beneath the eaves are five-tier bracket sets, with two intermediate bracket sets in the central bay and one in each side bay.

Inside the hall, besides Buddha statues, there are also seated statues of the Daoist Jade Emperor and Queen Mother — apparently a temple where Buddhism and Daoism coexist.

According to historical records, Jingang Temple was founded in Tang dynasty and rebuilt during the Ming Zhengtong era (1436-1449).

Today, Jingang Temple has declined, with few worshippers coming for days.

The main hall's walls are almost all damaged, roof tiles have fallen off in large areas, and the timber structure is damaged, forcing the use of brick masonry to support the building.

According to the elderly woman watching over the temple, she has been here alone for over ten years.

For so many years, the old woman has alone struggled to support this declining temple; her perseverance brought us shock and reverence.

The old woman added that the cultural relics protection department had recently come to investigate, and the temple would soon receive repair and protection.

In August 2014, the Jingang Temple repair project began bidding, bringing a successful conclusion to the old woman's mission of over a decade.

云峰寺

Yunfeng Temple
省级 清 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address雅安市荥经县东南4公里处
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 斗拱 千年楠木

中文描述 Description

云峰寺在荥经县可谓是家喻户晓，随便找个人都能热情地对你说个七七八八。

说这里有一块女娲在太湖边炼石补天后不慎遗落的一块石头，所以寺庙叫太湖石云峰寺，简称为太湖寺，最后才更名为云峰寺。

云峰寺始建于唐，赐额于宋，兵毁于元，修复于明，续修于清，自古便是香火旺盛之地。

寺庙重修后大气巍峨，古刹错落有致；

寺内古树参天，绿树成荫，即使是在炎热的夏季也透着丝丝的凉意，真是绝佳的旅游胜地。

据当地人说，这里的桢楠、银杏等珍贵的古树比寺院的年纪还要大。

在这些古树中又要数两株对称的楠木——寺院的镇寺之宝千年楠木——最为名贵。

六个人只能环抱住它的二分之一，盘虬卧龙般的根系牢牢地抓住地面，给了整个寺院千年古刹的气势。

上千年的楠木价值堪比黄金，当地人拍着胸脯说，这参天的古树与精致的寺院给了他足够的底气和信心。

寺院香火从来不断，山间袅袅的雾气还没有散开，炉中袅袅的青烟便已经从寺院里升腾起来。

您如果旅行到了荥经，请一定要来云峰寺走一遭。

英文翻译 English Translation

Yunfeng Temple is a household name in Yingjing County; ask anyone and they will enthusiastically tell you quite a bit about it.

They say there is a stone here that Nüwa accidentally dropped after smelting stones to mend the sky by Taihu Lake, so the temple was called Taihu Stone Yunfeng Temple, abbreviated as Taihu Temple, and finally renamed Yunfeng Temple.

Yunfeng Temple was founded in Tang, received an imperial plaque in Song, was destroyed by war in Yuan, restored in Ming, and continued to be repaired in Qing — since ancient times it has been a place of flourishing incense.

After restoration, the temple is grand and imposing, with the ancient temple complex well-arranged; ancient trees tower inside the temple, green trees form shade, and even in the hot summer there is a hint of coolness — truly an excellent tourist destination.

According to locals, precious ancient trees here such as Zhennan (Phoebe zhennan) and ginkgo are older than the temple itself.

Among these ancient trees, two symmetrical nanmu trees — the temple's treasure, thousand-year-old nanmu — are the most precious.

Six people can only wrap their arms around half of its circumference; its coiled, dragon-like roots firmly grip the ground, giving the entire temple the aura of a thousand-year-old ancient temple.

The value of thousand-year-old nanmu is comparable to gold; locals pat their chests and say these towering ancient trees and the exquisite temple give them enough confidence and assurance.

The temple's incense never ceases; before the curling mountain mist has dispersed, curling blue smoke from the censer has already risen from within the temple.

If you travel to Yingjing, be sure to visit Yunfeng Temple.

处项目

牛角寨石窟

Niujiaozhai Grotto
国家级 唐 石窟
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty唐
地址 Address仁寿县高家镇鹰头村(现称英头村)六组的牛角寨山
类型 Type石窟
看点 Highlights: 石窟 造像 大佛阁

中文描述 Description

牛角寨石窟，位于仁寿县高家镇鹰头村(现称英头村)六组的牛角寨山，距离县城约有35公里。

此地的大佛阁，观音堂和坛神岩上分布有石窟造像101龛，绝大多数为盛唐时期凿刻。

在牛角寨的101龛造像中，佛教教造像并存，其中绝大多数为佛教造像，共计95龛。

其中最为宏伟的是第44龛。

该龛高16米，宽11米，深8.7米，龛内凿刻大佛半身胸像，佛头高6.6米，面部宽4.6米，佛像庄严浑厚，体现强烈的唐代造像特征。

为了保护佛像，后人在龛外建造了大佛阁，更加凸显了人们对大佛的虔诚。

英文翻译 English Translation

Niujiaozhai Grotto is located on Niujiaozhai Mountain in Group 6, Yingtou Village (formerly called Yingtou Village), Gaojia Town, Renshou County, about 35km from the county seat.

Here, the Great Buddha Pavilion, Guanyin Hall, and Tanshen Rock distribute 101 niches of grotto carvings, the vast majority carved during the High Tang period.

Among the 101 niches at Niujiaozhai, Buddhist and Daoist carvings coexist, with the vast majority being Buddhist carvings, totaling 95 niches.

The most magnificent is Niche 44.

This niche is 16m high, 11m wide, 8.7m deep; inside the niche is carved a half-length bust of the Great Buddha, with the Buddha head 6.6m high and face 4.6m wide.

The Buddha statue is solemn and vigorous, embodying strong Tang dynasty carving characteristics.

To protect the Buddha statue, later generations built the Great Buddha Pavilion outside the niche, further highlighting people's devotion to the Great Buddha.

梓潼宫

Zitong Hall
国家级 明—清 礼制建筑 木结构
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address眉山市彭山县江口镇双江村东北20米村
类型 Type礼制建筑 木结构
看点 Highlights: 斗拱 木结构 崖墓 汉代文物

中文描述 Description

梓潼宫相传始建于汉，原本建于梓潼村，是纪念文曲星张亚子的祠堂。

明永乐二年(1404年)进行重修，清嘉庆十一年(1404年)再重修，1985年将仅存的大殿迁移复原于江口汉崖墓内作为这些珍贵文物的陈列室。

进入汉崖墓沿石阶一直往上，或者绕着墓穴边走边往上，就能遇见梓潼宫了。

大殿坐北向南，面阔与进深都为三间，且都为12.1米，为单檐歇山顶，抬梁式屋架，在小山头上显得小巧而精致。

值得注意的是梓潼宫的斗拱，其转角铺作出斜拱，补间铺作斗拱出三跳，用龙头真上昂，攀间铺作斗拱出二跳。

尤其是上昂的应用，是中国古代木结构建筑中是极为少见的。

梓潼宫规模虽不大，但集中展现了元、明、清木构建筑工艺，尤其是独特的斗拱做法，具有极高的历史价值，已被列入国家重点文物保护单位名录。

游人前来时除了游玩梓潼宫外，也别忘了看看梓潼宫的汉墓。

汉墓开放参观的部分很小，但是墓里古朴厚重想象奇幻的汉代文物一定会让你不虚此行。

另外，墓穴的修建十分有技巧，置身墓穴中，即使是盛夏时节也能让人感到丝丝寒意。

英文翻译 English Translation

Zitong Hall is said to have been founded in Han dynasty, originally built in Zitong Village as a shrine commemorating Zhang Yazi, the God of Literature.

It was rebuilt in the 2nd year of Yongle (1404), Ming dynasty, and again in the 11th year of Jiaqing (1806), Qing dynasty.

In 1985, the only surviving main hall was relocated and restored inside the Jiangkou Han Cliff Tombs to serve as a display room for these precious cultural relics.

Entering the Han cliff tombs and climbing straight up the stone stairs, or walking up while circling the tombs, you will encounter Zitong Hall.

The main hall faces south, 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep, both 12.1m, with a single-eave xieshan roof and post-and-lintel frame — appearing small and exquisite on the small hilltop.

Noteworthy are Zitong Hall's bracket sets: the corner bracket sets project diagonal brackets, the intermediate bracket sets project three tiers with dragon-head true ang (lever arms), and the inter-columnar bracket sets project two tiers.

Especially the application of upper ang is extremely rare in ancient Chinese timber architecture.

Though modest in scale, Zitong Hall集中展现了 Yuan, Ming, and Qing timber construction techniques, especially its unique bracket set practice, with极高 historical value, and has been listed in the National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units directory.

When visitors come, besides visiting Zitong Hall, don't forget to see the Han tombs.

The part of the Han tombs open for visitation is small, but the simple,厚重 and imaginatively fantastic Han dynasty cultural relics inside will surely make your trip worthwhile.

Additionally, the tomb construction is very skillful; being inside the tomb, even in midsummer, one can feel a hint of chill.

蟆颐观

Mayi Taoist Temple
国家级 唐—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty唐—清
地址 Address眉山市东坡区崇礼镇蟆颐村蟆颐山上
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 园林 院落 古树

中文描述 Description

昔蜀之眉州有山曰蟆颐，去州七里许。

山腹有龙湫，净深澄碧，白蟹紫芝产于内，有老翁隐现不常，又谓之老人泉。

传记以为轩辕氏之丹室，唐季杨太虚尔朱先生得道之所。

蟆颐观大殿前老人泉边的《重瞳观新修殿宇碑记》上这样记载，蟆颐观的所有传说也都大致来源于此碑文。

蟆颐观又叫作重瞳观，因位于蟆颐山上，故而当地人还是喜欢叫它蟆颐这个土里土气的名字。

蟆颐观始建于唐，重修于明，补建于明，现存山门与大殿。

山门为清代建筑，面阔七间(已拆去左边一间)，进深四间，重檐庑殿顶，檐下施如意斗拱，整个造型错落有致，颇为精巧(图1、图2)。

大殿占地258平方米，木结构，歇山式屋顶，抬梁式梁架。

大殿前有一洞，曰老人泉。

洞口高2.3米，宽1.7米(图3)。

洞口石壁上横镌仙翁胜境。

据说下石梯30级有一清泉，泉水自石罅中流出，涝不溢，旱不枯，汲之不尽，其味甘甜凉爽，沁人肺腑。

只是现在被铁栏杆拴住无法进入，倒是一大憾事。

道观历史悠久，在唐宋时期一直是眉州盛景，文人墨客争相吟咏，鼎盛时期曾是四川三大道观之一。

道观内古树参天，有几棵据说是当年苏洵亲手所植。

踏入道观时一棵巨大的木兰树的花正盛开，其余古树都有三十余米高，浸泡在尚未散去的雾气中，整个道观显得仙气十足。

如今蟆颐观已经鲜有人问津，游人寥寥，倒也让道观清净许多。

不过最近正在进行重修与完善，人们也期待看到它重回生机的时候。

英文翻译 English Translation

"In ancient Meizhou of Shu there was a mountain called Mayi, about seven li from the prefecture.

On the mountainside is a Dragon Pool, clear and deep blue, with white crabs and purple glossy ganoderma growing within; an old man appears and disappears unpredictably, hence it is also called Old Man Spring.

Biographies record it as the alchemy chamber of the Yellow Emperor, and the place where Master Yang Taixu Erzhu attained the Dao in late Tang." This is recorded in the "Stele Record of the Newly Rebuilt Halls of Chongtong Temple" beside the Old Man Spring in front of Mayi Temple's main hall; all legends of Mayi Temple largely derive from this inscription.

Mayi Temple is also called Chongtong Temple; because it is located on Mayi Mountain, locals still prefer to call it by the rustic name Mayi.

Mayi Temple was founded in Tang, rebuilt in Ming, and supplemented in Ming; currently surviving are the mountain gate and main hall.

The mountain gate is a Qing dynasty building, 7 bays wide (the leftmost bay has been removed), 4 bays deep, with a double-eave hip roof and ruyi bracket sets beneath the eaves — the overall form is well-proportioned and quite exquisite.

The main hall covers 258 sq m, timber structure, xieshan roof, post-and-lintel frame.

In front of the main hall is a cave called Old Man Spring.

The cave mouth is 2.3m high, 1.7m wide.

On the stone wall at the cave mouth is horizontally carved "Xianweng Shengjing" (Realm of the Immortal Old Man).

It is said that descending 30 stone steps reveals a clear spring; water flows out from stone crevices, not overflowing in flood, not drying up in drought, inexhaustible when drawn, with a sweet, cool, refreshing taste.

Only now it is blocked by iron railings and cannot be entered — quite a pity.

The Taoist temple has a long history; during Tang and Song it was always a scenic spot of Meizhou, with literati competing to compose poetry about it.

At its peak it was one of Sichuan's three great Taoist temples.

Inside the temple, ancient trees tower to the sky; several are said to have been planted by Su Xun himself.

Upon entering the temple, a giant magnolia tree was in full bloom, and the other ancient trees are all over 30m tall, immersed in lingering mist — the entire temple appears otherworldly.

Today Mayi Temple is rarely visited, with few tourists, which actually makes the temple much more peaceful.

However, restoration and improvement are currently underway, and people look forward to seeing it return to vitality.

三苏祠

Memorial Hall of Three Sus
国家级 清 祠堂
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address眉山市东坡镇纱縠街
类型 Type祠堂
看点 Highlights: 园林 三苏文化 传说 诗文

中文描述 Description

去三苏祠时正关闭修缮，绕着三苏祠的外面围墙走了一圈，往里窥看美景，努力走了一圈依然无法进入，只得悻悻而返。

不过幸而在市区的著名景点还是有不少人熟知的，找了找当地居民，多查找一下资料，也能知道个七七八八。

三苏祠是北宋著名文学家苏洵、苏轼、苏辙父子三人的故居，元代改建为纪念他们的祠堂，毁于战火后，清康熙四年(1665年)重建。

三苏祠占地约6.5万平方米，坐北向南，红墙环抱，绿水萦绕，古木扶疏，翠竹掩映，形成三分水二分竹的岛居格局。

现有建筑约7200平方米，主要由三进四合院组成，主要建筑有正门、前厅、正殿、启贤堂等。

红墙内还有疏竹轩、绿筠轩、式苏轩、来凤轩、披风榭、抱月亭、快雨亭、云屿楼、瑞莲亭、百坡亭、碑亭、景苏楼、绿洲亭、半潭秋水一房山、彩花舫、南堂、西门等楼台亭榭，多建于岸边和池上。

三苏祠的正门有繁茂的古榕树，仿佛代替了门兽，承担起守护大门的任务。

进入大门，可以看见三棵高大挺拔的古树，一棵黄桷树两棵银杏树。

据说这三棵古树象征着三苏父子，苏轼、苏辙是那两棵银杏，苏洵则是那棵黄桷树。

穿过三棵古树间的甬道，就到了前厅。

门楣正中有一匾文献一家，为道光十四年(1834年)眉州知州洪运开所书。

前厅东西耳房现已辟为碑亭，内置南宋孝宗御制碑和明清至民国的建祠记事碑。

穿过前厅，便是正殿。

是供奉、祭祀三苏父子的地方。

殿内供奉三苏父子塑像，均罩以神龛。

正中是苏洵像，东西分别是苏轼、苏辙像。

三苏祠内处处诗词对联，好不甚文雅，又有各种文人吟诗作对的亭台楼榭，流水修竹，文人风雅览尽无余，堪称四川地区建筑与园林天然互成的典范。

英文翻译 English Translation

When I visited the Memorial Hall of Three Sus, it was closed for restoration.

I walked around the outer red wall, peeking at the scenery inside, but after a full circuit I still could not enter, and had to return disappointed.

Fortunately, as a famous scenic spot in the city, it is well known to many; asking local residents and looking up more materials, I could learn most of it.

The Memorial Hall of Three Su was the former residence of the famous Northern Song literary family — Su Xun, Su Shi, and Su Zhe (father and two sons).

In Yuan dynasty it was converted into a shrine commemorating them; after being destroyed in war, it was rebuilt in the 4th year of Kangxi (1665), Qing dynasty.

The memorial hall covers about 65,000 sq m, facing south, surrounded by red walls, encircled by green water, with ancient trees and lush bamboo, forming an island-dwelling pattern of "three parts water, two parts bamboo." Existing buildings total about 7,200 sq m, mainly composed of three-courtyard siheyuan; main buildings include the main gate, front hall, main hall, and Qixian Hall.

Within the red walls are also Shuzhu Pavilion, Lvyun Pavilion, Shisu Pavilion, Laifeng Pavilion, Pifeng Pavilion, Baoyue Pavilion, Kuaiyu Pavilion, Yunyu Tower, Ruilian Pavilion, Baipo Pavilion, Stele Pavilion, Jingsu Tower, Luzhou Pavilion, Bantan Qiushui Yifang Mountain, Caihua Boat, Nan Hall, West Gate, and other pavilions and towers, mostly built on banks and over ponds.

The main gate of the memorial hall has lush ancient banyan trees, as if replacing gate beasts, undertaking the task of guarding the gate.

Entering the gate, one sees three tall, straight ancient trees: one huangjue tree and two ginkgo trees.

It is said these three ancient trees symbolize the Three Su father and sons — Su Shi and Su Zhe are the two ginkgoes, and Su Xun is the huangjue tree.

Passing through the corridor between the three ancient trees, one reaches the front hall.

In the center of the lintel is a plaque reading "One Family of Literature," written by Hong Yunkai, Prefect of Meizhou, in the 14th year of Daoguang (1834).

The east and west side rooms of the front hall have now been converted into stele pavilions, containing the Southern Song Emperor Xiaozong's imperial stele and temple-building record steles from Ming-Qing to Republican period.

Passing through the front hall is the main hall — the place for enshrining and sacrificing to the Three Su father and sons.

Inside the hall are enshrined statues of the Three Su, each covered by a shrine.

In the center is Su Xun's statue; east and west are Su Shi and Su Zhe respectively.

Throughout the Memorial Hall of Three Su there are poetry couplets everywhere, extremely elegant; with various pavilions and towers for literati to compose poetry, flowing water and cultivated bamboo, the literati's refined elegance is fully displayed — truly a model of architecture and gardens naturally complementing each other in Sichuan.

丹棱白塔

Danleng White Pagoda
国家级 宋 砖石塔
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty宋
地址 Address眉山市丹棱县丹棱镇西1公里原白塔寺内村
类型 Type砖石塔
看点 Highlights: 丹棱八景 诗词

中文描述 Description

丹棱白塔位于丹棱城西1千米处。

建于唐大中年间(847—860年)，为方形十四级密檐式砖塔。

据史籍记载，该塔旧名白鹤，宋重修，永乐初改名为丹棱白塔。

白塔通高30米，塔身第一层边长6.1米，其上伸出密檐14层，每层檐之间很密，好似重楼阁式的重檐，故叫作密檐式塔。

与尖塔背要破天的感觉不同，丹棱白塔给人一种轻快柔和温润的感觉。

各层檐的挑出距离随着高度的上升逐渐缓慢内收，使得塔的拥有了柔和的抛物线外廓。

檐与檐之间的矮壁上，每面都砌出棂窗和小孔，作为装饰或内部采光用。

塔底空心，第一、三、四层塔心室均饰有石斗拱，塔内有蹬道可盘旋直达塔顶。

塔檐翼角上原本悬挂了72只铜铃，风过之时清脆的铃声飘向远方，由此得白塔钟声之美名，为丹棱八景之一。

可惜，现在是再也听不到那声音了。

丹棱白塔体现出强烈的唐塔风韵，历代文人墨客在此留下诸多佳作，如明代状元杨慎所作《登丹棱县白塔寺塔与吕竿川同赋》。

古塔在历史的长河中给予了人们以快乐和灵感，现今，它依旧挺立其优美的身姿，诉说那历史的遗痕。

英文翻译 English Translation

Danleng White Pagoda is located 1km west of Danleng County town.

Built during the Tang Dazhong era (847-860), it is a square fourteen-story multi-eaved brick pagoda.

According to historical records, the pagoda was formerly named Baihe (White Crane); it was rebuilt in Song, and in early Yongle renamed Danleng White Pagoda.

The pagoda is 30m tall overall; the first story of the body is 6.1m per side, above which extend 14 layers of dense eaves.

The spacing between each eave layer is very close, resembling the double eaves of a multi-story pavilion, hence called a multi-eaved pagoda.

Unlike the feeling of a spire piercing the sky, Danleng White Pagoda gives people a feeling of lightness, softness, and gentleness.

The projection distance of each eave layer gradually and slowly recedes inward as height increases, giving the pagoda a soft parabolic outline.

On the low walls between eaves, each face is built with lattice windows and small holes, serving as decoration or interior lighting.

The pagoda base is hollow; the first, third, and fourth story chambers are decorated with stone bracket sets, and inside the pagoda a stairway spirals up to the top.

Originally 72 bronze bells hung from the eave wing corners; when the wind blew, clear bell sounds drifted far away, giving the name "White Pagoda Bell Sound," one of the Eight Scenes of Danleng.

Unfortunately, that sound can no longer be heard today.

Danleng White Pagoda embodies a strong Tang pagoda charm; literati through the ages left many excellent works here, such as "Ascending the White Pagoda Temple Pagoda in Danleng County, Composed Together with Lv Ganchuan" by Ming dynasty Zhuangyuan (top scholar) Yang Shen.

The ancient pagoda has given people joy and inspiration through the long river of history; today, it still stands with its graceful form, recounting the traces of history.

能仁寺摩崖造像

Cliffside Statues of Nengren Temple
国家级 唐—宋 摩崖造像
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty唐—宋
地址 Address眉山市仁寿县城东45公里处的中农乡能仁村
类型 Type摩崖造像
看点 Highlights: 石像 佛像 雕刻

中文描述 Description

此地原有能仁寺，自唐以来，不断加建的建筑连绵0.5公里有余，唐宋时期，在寺后两侧岩壁上凿龛100余窟，分布有大量佛像雕刻。

现在，能仁寺不见踪影，不知毁于何时。

1972年，仁寿县修建黑龙滩水库，为建渠道，曾在这里开山取石，能仁寺原有的摩崖造像大部分在这期间被毁损。

能仁是释迦的汉语意译，也就是佛教所说的大慈大悲心。

能仁寺摩崖造像现存28龛，造像270多尊，分布在长29米，高6米的山壁之上。

其中最为重要的是第15号龛。

有专家认为该龛主尊像是弥勒佛；

也有专家认为该龛表现的是迎佛还国佛涅槃等佛经故事；

另有其他人有不同观点，众说纷纭也体现了人们对佛像价值的肯定。

能仁寺摩崖造像，无论其布局设计，造型构图，还是工匠镌刻工艺，对于佛教故事的表现力，都堪称石窟艺术的经典。

它对研究佛教史和佛教艺术都具有很大的价值，对游客来说，浓郁的宗教风格也不会让你失望。

英文翻译 English Translation

This site originally had Nengren Temple; since Tang dynasty, continuously added buildings stretched over 0.5km.

During Tang and Song, over 100 niches were carved into the rock walls on both sides behind the temple, with numerous Buddha carvings distributed.

Today, Nengren Temple has vanished, unknown when destroyed.

In 1972, when Renshou County built the Heilongtan Reservoir, mountain rock was quarried here to build the channel, and most of Nengren Temple's original cliffside carvings were destroyed during this period.

Nengren is the Chinese translation of Shakyamuni, meaning the great compassion and merciful heart in Buddhism.

Nengren Temple Cliffside Statues currently preserve 28 niches with over 270 statues, distributed on a mountain wall 29m long and 6m high.

The most important is Niche 15.

Some experts believe the main statue in this niche is Maitreya Buddha; other experts believe this niche depicts Buddhist stories such as welcoming the Buddha back to the country and the Buddha's nirvana; still others hold different views.

The diverse opinions also reflect people's recognition of the statue's value.

Nengren Temple Cliffside Statues, whether in layout design, modeling composition, or craftsman carving technique, and in their expressive power for Buddhist stories, can be called classics of grotto art.

They have great value for studying Buddhist history and Buddhist art; for tourists, the rich religious style will not disappoint.

眉山报恩寺

Bao'en Temple in Meishan
国家级 元—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty元—清
地址 Address眉山市罗平乡高峰村北150米
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 元代木构 题记

中文描述 Description

位于眉山市东坡区永寿镇高丰村五组的报恩寺，始建于唐，几经损毁，在元泰定四年(1327年)重修，清乾隆二十六年(1761年)补修。

改革开放以后，政府多次拨出专款进行抢救性维修，已被列入国家重点文物保护单位。

报恩寺坐北朝南，占地635平方米，早期建筑仅存大殿及右厢房。

大殿面阔三间13.65米，进深三间13.45米，高8.3米，歇山顶，抬梁式梁架。

殿内采用减柱造，而且在许多营造手法上保留了宋元的建筑风格，梁上存有元泰定四年题记。

大殿正中，供奉着道家三清——元始天尊、灵宝天尊、道德天尊。

殿中左右两边还有两根柱子，上面各盘踞着一条飞龙。

寺院周围是一片农田，寺院里面也是郁郁葱葱的。

逢年过节也还有不少人来上香，香火很旺。

去的时候，恰好赶上寺院的维护加固，墙全被拆掉，只看到了木结构的架子。

抬梁式构架体系展露无遗，倒是能给人相当大的震撼。

尽管报恩寺正在修缮，但仍然有不少善男信女前来上香。

(这次虽然没看到报恩寺的真容，但是它带给我的宁静确实一点不少。

我想，中华民族千年的知恩图报品德，或许是它宁静的原因吧。

)

英文翻译 English Translation

Bao'en Temple, located in Group 5, Gaofeng Village, Yongshou Town, Dongpo District, Meishan City, was founded in Tang dynasty, damaged several times, rebuilt in the 4th year of Taiding (1327), Yuan dynasty, and repaired in the 26th year of Qianlong (1761), Qing dynasty.

After the Reform and Opening Up, the government allocated special funds multiple times for emergency rescue repairs, and it has been listed as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit.

Bao'en Temple faces south, covering 635 sq m; of the early buildings only the main hall and right wing room survive.

The main hall is 3 bays wide (13.65m), 3 bays deep (13.45m), 8.3m tall, with xieshan roof and post-and-lintel frame.

The hall uses column-reduction construction, and retains Song-Yuan architectural style in many construction techniques; the beams bear an inscription from the 4th year of Taiding of Yuan.

In the center of the main hall are enshrined the Daoist Three Purities — Yuanshi Tianzun (Primordial Heavenly Venerable), Lingbao Tianzun (Numinous Treasure Heavenly Venerable), and Daode Tianzun (Moral Heavenly Venerable).

On the left and right sides of the hall are two columns, each coiled with a flying dragon.

The temple is surrounded by farmland, and inside the temple it is also lush and green.

During festivals, many people still come to burn incense, and the incense is flourishing.

When I visited, it happened to coincide with the temple's maintenance and reinforcement; the walls were all removed, and I only saw the timber frame.

The post-and-lintel frame system was fully exposed, which was quite震撼.

Although Bao'en Temple is under repair, many devout men and women still come to burn incense.

(Though I didn't see Bao'en Temple's true appearance this time, the tranquility it brought me was no less.

I think the Chinese nation's thousand-year-old virtue of repaying kindness may be the reason for its tranquility.)

双堡牌坊

Shuangbao Memorial Archways
国家级 清 石牌坊
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address眉山市仁寿县双堡乡牌坊村东700米
类型 Type石牌坊
看点 Highlights: 孝节文化 雕刻 双坊

中文描述 Description

双堡牌坊位于仁寿县双堡乡牌坊村。

双坊分别建于光绪七年(1882年)和光绪八年(1883年)，用以表彰徐母杨氏和徐母余老太君的夫死从子和敬老孝翁的品格。

双堡牌坊南北相对上下相列，相距44.5米，一条石板路连接两坊。

双堡牌坊建筑风格相似，四柱三开，仿木五层结构。

1号坊是清廷表彰徐母杨氏所建，坊面阔三间6.66米，通高11.47米。

明间正楼檐下竖板刻圣旨二字，字匾处刻徐母杨老孺人节孝坊。

坊正、背两面刻有大量浮雕戏文及民间故事，雕刻精美，保存完好。

2号坊面阔6.66米，通高12.53米，明间正楼檐下南面刻圣旨竖板，北面刻族表竖板。

字匾处刻节孝坊，并有序、文各一，记录了徐母余老太君守寡30余年，上事翁姑，下养孤子的故事。

坊上同样遍布精美雕刻，各式民间故事令人应接不暇。

双堡牌坊规制严谨，工艺精湛，经百余年风雨仍保有雕刻栩栩如生，展现了四川地区高超的石刻技艺与民间传统孝节文化，于2006年列入第六批全国重点文物保护单位名单。

英文翻译 English Translation

Shuangbao Memorial Archways are located in Paifang Village, Shuangbao Township, Renshou County.

The two archways were built in the 7th year of Guangxu (1882) and the 8th year of Guangxu (1883) respectively, to commend the character of Madam Yang (mother of the Xu family) and Madam Yu (elder lady of the Xu family) — following their sons after their husbands' deaths and respecting and caring for their parents-in-law.

The two archways face each other north-south in a vertical arrangement, 44.5m apart, with a stone slab road connecting them.

The two archways have similar architectural styles: four columns, three openings, imitating a five-story timber structure.

Archway No.

1 was built by the Qing court to commend Madam Yang.

It is 3 bays wide (6.66m), 11.47m total height.

Under the eave of the central bay's main tower, a vertical plaque is carved with "Sacred Decree"; the character plaque reads "Chastity and Filial Piety Archway of the Venerable Madam Yang, Mother of the Xu Family." Both front and back faces of the archway are carved with numerous reliefs of theatrical scenes and folk stories, exquisitely carved and well preserved.

Archway No.

2 is 6.66m wide, 12.53m total height.

Under the eave of the central bay's main tower, the south face is carved with a "Sacred Decree" vertical plaque, and the north face with a "Clan Commendation" vertical plaque.

The character plaque reads "Chastity and Filial Piety Archway," with a preface and text recording the story of the Venerable Madam Yu, mother of the Xu family, who was widowed for over 30 years, serving her parents-in-law above and raising her orphaned son below.

The archway is likewise covered with exquisite carvings, with various folk stories overwhelming the viewer.

Shuangbao Memorial Archways have rigorous regulations and exquisite craftsmanship; after over a century of wind and rain they still retain lifelike carvings, demonstrating Sichuan region's superb stone carving technique and traditional folk chastity-filial piety culture.

They were listed in the 6th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units in 2006.

甘泉寺

Ganquan Temple
国家级 明—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address眉山市仁寿县禾加镇楠木村西北20米
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 明代木构 壁画

中文描述 Description

甘泉寺位于仁寿县禾加镇楠木村八组，2013年新近成为国家重点文物保护单位。

据说原有大片的楠木林，现在换成了一片楠竹林。

甘泉寺始建于明宣德九年(1434年)，建成之初规模宏大，但几经战乱损毁，原有建筑仅存大雄宝殿一幢，即部分附属设施。

大雄宝殿，坐东南向西北，面阔三间12.45米，进深三间12.62米，高9.2米，歇山顶，穿斗式梁架，四周檐下遍施斗拱。

殿内原有彩绘《西游记》等20余幅，后不幸损毁，现有彩绘均为补修里面雕梁画栋，仍然让人不禁想象当年完好时的盛况。

甘泉寺虽小，但大雄宝殿较为完整地保留了明代建筑的原有结构，斗拱精美，状况良好，部分壁画虽有损伤仍然呈现出明清原迹的风韵，是四川境内不可多得的明代建筑范例。

英文翻译 English Translation

Ganquan Temple is located in Group 8, Nanmu Village, Hejia Town, Renshou County, newly becoming a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit in 2013.

It is said there was originally a large nanmu (Phoebe zhennan) forest, now replaced by a bamboo forest.

Ganquan Temple was founded in the 9th year of Xuande (1434), Ming dynasty.

At its completion it was large-scale, but after several wars and destruction, only the Mahavira Hall and some auxiliary facilities survive from the original buildings.

The Mahavira Hall faces northwest from southeast, 3 bays wide (12.45m), 3 bays deep (12.62m), 9.2m tall, with xieshan roof and chuan-dou frame, with bracket sets installed all around under the eaves.

Inside the hall there were originally over 20 colored paintings including "Journey to the West," later unfortunately destroyed; existing colored paintings are all supplementary repairs.

The carved beams and painted pillars inside still make one imagine the grand spectacle when intact.

Though small, Ganquan Temple's Mahavira Hall relatively completely preserves the original structure of Ming dynasty architecture, with exquisite bracket sets in good condition.

Although some murals are damaged, they still present the charm of Ming-Qing original traces — a rare example of Ming dynasty architecture within Sichuan.

中岩寺摩崖造像

Cliffside Statues of Zhongyan Temple
国家级 唐—清 摩崖造像
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty唐—清
地址 Address眉山市青神县
类型 Type摩崖造像
看点 Highlights: 石窟 佛像 鱼池

中文描述 Description

中岩寺摩崖造像位于四川省眉山市青神县，山清水秀、翠竹摇曳、山路蜿蜒。

这里有一个非常吸引人们关注的地方——唤鱼池，据说，这里是东坡初恋的地方，小小的雕塑伫立在湖畔，池边人们拍拍掌，红的黑的锦鲤便应声聚集，好不热闹，而摩崖造像则是这里的另一大看点。

自唐宋以来，中岩寺便是川西南佛门圣地，享有川南第一山西川林泉最佳处之美誉。

20世纪80年代初期，四川省考古方面的专家和学者在入口约半里地的唤鱼池畔发现了那些修凿在唤鱼池畔的岩壁上的一个个佛龛。

站在唤鱼池畔，看着对岸岩壁上棱角分明、美轮美奂的经幢，依然可以想象得到它们当年的美丽与辉煌。

这些大唐时代就开始流传下来的精美浮雕从中岩山下一直延伸到山上，接着，还有千佛长廊，大大小小的佛像以唐宋风格的居多，姿态各异，但却都是刀工有力，部分上面的彩绘仍在娓娓道来那当年的繁华与美丽。

山上的石板路不是很难走，走走停停曲折折，走累了便选一个路边或新或旧的佛龛拜一拜。

经历文革骚乱后，绝大多数佛像都丢了脑袋，只有几组高居峭壁的佛像还保存完好，但也由于太过崎岖，游人也只能远远地在下方遥望，无法近看细玩。

英文翻译 English Translation

Cliffside Statues of Zhongyan Temple are located in Qingshen County, Meishan City, Sichuan Province, with beautiful mountains and waters, swaying green bamboo, and winding mountain paths.

Here there is a place that greatly attracts people's attention — Huanyu Pond (Call-Fish Pond).

It is said this is where Su Dongpo had his first love.

A small sculpture stands by the lake; when people clap their hands by the pond, red and black koi gather in response — quite lively.

The cliffside statues are another major attraction here.

Since Tang and Song dynasties, Zhongyan Temple has been a Buddhist holy land in southwestern Sichuan, enjoying the reputation of "the first mountain in southern Sichuan" and "the best place for forests and springs in western Sichuan." In the early 1980s, Sichuan archaeological experts and scholars discovered the Buddhist niches carved into the rock wall beside Huanyu Pond, about half a li from the entrance.

Standing by Huanyu Pond, looking at the sharply angled, magnificent stone pillars (jingchuang) on the opposite rock wall, one can still imagine their beauty and glory in those days.

These exquisite reliefs, passed down since the Great Tang era, extend from the foot of Zhongyan Mountain up to the mountaintop; then there is the Thousand-Buddha Corridor, with large and small Buddha statues mostly in Tang-Song style, each with different postures, but all powerfully carved; some colored paintings on them still softly recount the prosperity and beauty of those days.

The stone slab path on the mountain is not hard to walk; walking and stopping along winding turns, when tired one can choose a new or old Buddhist niche by the road to worship.

After the turmoil of the Cultural Revolution, the vast majority of Buddha statues lost their heads; only a few groups of Buddha statues high on the cliffs remain well preserved, but due to the rugged terrain, tourists can only gaze from far below, unable to approach and examine closely.
