慧严寺

Huiyan Temple
国家级 明 宗教寺庙
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address遂宁市蓬溪县金桥乡过军坝村
类型 Type宗教寺庙
看点 Highlights: 大殿 壁画 明代木构

中文描述 Description

慧严寺位于遂宁市蓬溪县金桥乡过军坝村，现仅存大雄殿和左厢房等古建筑和大雄殿壁画。

慧严寺的大雄殿建于明正统十二年(1447年)，面阔三间，进深三间，为单檐歇山顶，抬梁式木结构建筑。

大殿制作细致，驼峰、雀替等构建无一不是精心设计和制作，样式精美，保存完好，较好地保存了历史风貌，实属难得。

慧严寺精妙之处不只在于建筑本身，更在于大雄殿内的壁画。

大殿东西两壁上共绘有五幅壁画，总计17.4平方米，属于供奉朝觐的尊像画，是运用白地素描淡彩画法的精品，名为《朝天朝贡》。

壁画带有浓郁的民俗风味，所绘天王、龙神等仙佛人物生动形象且不失乡野匠气，是遂宁市内仅存的少量古代壁画之一，十分珍贵，代表着一种民间仙佛画卷的风格，具有很高的艺术价值。

英文翻译 English Translation

Huiyan Temple is located in Guojunba Village, Jinqiao Township, Pengxi County, Suining City.

Currently only ancient buildings such as the Mahavira Hall and left wing room, as well as the murals in the Mahavira Hall, survive.

The Mahavira Hall of Huiyan Temple was built in the 12th year of Zhengtong (1447), Ming dynasty; it is 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep, a single-eave xieshan roof, post-and-lintel timber structure building.

The main hall is meticulously crafted; components such as humpbacks and sparrow brackets are all carefully designed and made, with exquisite styles and well preserved,较好 preserving the historical appearance — truly rare.

The exquisite aspect of Huiyan Temple lies not only in the building itself, but even more in the murals inside the Mahavira Hall.

On the east and west walls of the main hall there are a total of five murals, totaling 17.4 sq m; they belong to the category of venerable image paintings for worship and audience, and are masterpieces using the white-ground sketch light-color painting method, named Paying Tribute to Heaven.

The murals have a strong folk flavor; the depicted heavenly kings, dragon gods, and other immortal and Buddha figures are vivid and yet retain the rustic artisan style.

They are one of the few surviving ancient murals in Suining City, very precious, representing a style of folk immortal-Buddha scroll paintings, with high artistic value.

宝梵寺

Baofan Temple
国家级 明—清 宗教建筑 壁画
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address遂宁市蓬溪县宝梵镇宝梵村
类型 Type宗教建筑 壁画
看点 Highlights: 壁画 斗拱 明代木构

中文描述 Description

宝梵寺位于遂宁市蓬溪县宝梵镇宝梵村，地处偏僻、交通不便，虽有精美壁画，却仍旧鲜为人知。

宝梵寺始建于北宋，时称罗汉院。

治平元年改称宝梵寺，意为佛中之圣，梵中之宝。

宝梵寺坐北朝南，占地面积约1.4万平方米，为四进院落布局。

中轴线现存天王殿、大雄殿和毗卢殿，两侧为左右厢房。

宝梵寺的大雄殿建于明朝景泰元年(1450年)。

面阔三间，进深三间，歇山顶形制，抬梁式构架。

建筑本身并没有什么特别突出的地方，但是绘制其内的精美壁画却不得不提。

宝梵壁画存于大雄殿之内，共87幅，近200平方米。

这些壁画均以佛教故事为题，所绘佛像无一不栩栩如生，有的念经说法，有的窃窃私语，各具神态。

壁画色彩鲜艳明丽，虽经500多年，壁画和颜色毫无损伤，经久不衰。

除了不褪色外，壁画具有很高的艺术造诣，被宗教界誉为禅宗秀迹，《中国绘画史》更是称其可与敦煌壁画相媲美。

我国地大物博，瑰宝更是数不胜数。

还有像宝梵寺一样深藏不露的宝藏需要我们去发掘、继承。

英文翻译 English Translation

Baofan Temple is located in Baofan Village, Baofan Town, Pengxi County, Suining City.

It is situated in a remote area with inconvenient transportation; although it has exquisite murals, it is still little known.

Baofan Temple was first built in Northern Song, then called Luohan Courtyard.

In the 1st year of Zhiping it was renamed Baofan Temple, meaning the sage among Buddhas, the treasure among Brahma.

Baofan Temple faces south, covering about 14,000 sq m, with a four-courtyard layout.

On the central axis currently survive the Heavenly Kings Hall, Mahavira Hall, and Pilu Hall, with left and right wing rooms on both sides.

The Mahavira Hall of Baofan Temple was built in the 1st year of Jingtai (1450), Ming dynasty.

It is 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep, in xieshan roof form, with a post-and-lintel frame.

The building itself has nothing particularly outstanding, but the exquisite murals painted inside cannot go unmentioned.

Baofan murals are stored inside the Mahavira Hall, totaling 87 pieces, nearly 200 sq m.

These murals all take Buddhist stories as their theme; the painted Buddha figures are all without exception lifelike — some chanting sutras and preaching, some whispering, each with its own expression.

The murals have bright and vivid colors; although over 500 years have passed, the murals and colors show no damage, enduring without fading.

Besides not fading, the murals have high artistic attainment, praised by religious circles as Chan sect traces; the History of Chinese Painting even says they can rival Dunhuang murals.

Our country is vast and rich in resources, and treasures are even more countless.

There are still hidden treasures like Baofan Temple that need us to discover and inherit.

常乐寺

Changle Temple
省级 明—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address遂宁市蓬溪县常乐镇炮台村
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 院落 木构

中文描述 Description

在四川省遂宁市蓬溪县常乐镇炮台村的黄龙山麓，坐落这一座精美的古代建筑——常乐寺。

由于位于黄龙山麓，常乐寺又名黄龙禅院。

寺庙始建于唐代，因为兵祸被毁。

明清时期重建之后形成了今天前后两院的平面格局。

进入山门，映入眼帘的是天王殿。

天王殿面阔三间，进深三间，采用抬梁式梁架和歇山顶的形制。

天王殿的轴线较山门有一些偏移，颇有一些小趣味。

前院的大雄殿面阔三间，进深三间，是一个方形平面的建筑。

与天王殿相同，采用的是抬梁式梁架和歇山顶的形制。

与其他建筑相比，前院的大雄殿并没有显现出高人一等的体量和气势。

无量殿面阔七间，进深三间，为穿斗式梁架，悬山顶形制。

在无量殿与藏经阁之间，有一个下沉的庭院。

中间由一座三孔桥相连。

走进中间的庭院，便立刻感受到了安详静谧的气氛，仿佛进入了另一个世界。

与前院的大雄殿的低调不同，后院的大雄殿采用了更高一级的形制。

后院的大雄殿建于民国十年(1921年)，面阔五间，进深三间，为重檐歇山顶。

无论在体量、高度还是屋顶上，都显现出它的中心地位。

梁上的题字使我们知道它具体的建造时间。

常乐寺依山傍水而建，层层院落，极具趣味性，值得一去。

英文翻译 English Translation

At the foot of Huanglong (Yellow Dragon) Mountain in Paotai Village, Changle Town, Pengxi County, Suining City, Sichuan Province, stands this exquisite ancient building — Changle Temple.

Because it is located at the foot of Huanglong Mountain, Changle Temple is also called Huanglong Chan Courtyard.

The temple was first built in Tang dynasty, destroyed due to war disasters.

After reconstruction during Ming-Qing period, it formed today's planar layout of front and rear courtyards.

Entering the mountain gate, what comes into view is the Heavenly Kings Hall.

The Heavenly Kings Hall is 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep, adopting a post-and-lintel beam frame and xieshan roof form.

The axis of the Heavenly Kings Hall has some offset compared to the mountain gate, quite a bit of small interest.

The Mahavira Hall in the front courtyard is 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep, a building with a square plan.

Same as the Heavenly Kings Hall, it adopts a post-and-lintel beam frame and xieshan roof form.

Compared with other buildings, the Mahavira Hall in the front courtyard does not show a superior volume and momentum.

The Wuliang (Boundless) Hall is 7 bays wide and 3 bays deep, with a chuan-dou beam frame and overhanging gable roof form.

Between the Wuliang Hall and the Scripture Library, there is a sunken courtyard.

In the middle they are connected by a three-arch bridge.

Walking into the middle courtyard, one immediately feels a serene and tranquil atmosphere, as if entering another world.

Unlike the low-key Mahavira Hall in the front courtyard, the Mahavira Hall in the rear courtyard adopts a higher-level form.

The Mahavira Hall in the rear courtyard was built in the 10th year of the Republic (1921), 5 bays wide and 3 bays deep, with a double-eave xieshan roof.

Whether in volume, height, or roof, it shows its central position.

The inscriptions on the beams let us know its specific construction time.

Changle Temple is built against the mountain and beside the water, with layered courtyards, extremely interesting, and worth a visit.

陈子昂读书台

Studying Pavilion of Chen Zi'ang
国家级 清 建筑群
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address遂宁市射洪县金华山
类型 Type建筑群
看点 Highlights: 院落 园林 陈子昂

中文描述 Description

陈子昂读书台位于遂宁市射洪县的金华山上，是初唐著名诗人陈子昂年轻时读书的地方。

陈子昂读书台始建于唐朝，至清初，原有建筑已经坍塌殆尽，现有的建筑都是清代修葺的。

陈子昂读书台占地面积约2700平方米，由前、中、后三院以及玉虚阁组成，院外绿树成荫，院内游廊环绕，景致清幽。

读书台的山门为木石结构，歇山顶形制，门额上写着古读书台四个大字。

前院由门坊、感遇亭以及左、中、右三条廊道组成；

中院主体建筑为拾遗亭，屋顶为重檐六角攒尖顶；

后院的主体建筑为留云仙馆，北边还立有明远亭。

陈子昂读书台虽然年代不甚久远，但是并不能掩盖其丰厚的文化底蕴。

读书台内有大量匾对，皆为古今名家手迹，以木刻《感遇三十首》与《陈伯玉先生别传》等最为珍贵。

留云仙馆内亦有大量关于陈子昂的文献资料，都使得这座建筑有着与其年代不符合的丰厚底蕴和文化气质，真是缅怀陈子昂的圣地。

2006年5月，作为清代古建筑，陈子昂读书台凭借其带给后人的丰厚文化遗产，被列入全国重点文物保护单位名单之内。

英文翻译 English Translation

The Studying Pavilion of Chen Zi'ang is located on Jinhua Mountain, Shehong County, Suining City.

It is the place where Chen Zi'ang, a famous poet of the early Tang dynasty, studied in his youth.

The Studying Pavilion of Chen Zi'ang was first built in Tang dynasty; by the early Qing, the original buildings had completely collapsed, and the existing buildings were all renovated in Qing.

The Studying Pavilion of Chen Zi'ang covers about 2,700 sq m, composed of front, middle, and rear courtyards as well as the Yuxu Pavilion; outside the courtyard green trees form shade, and inside the courtyard verandas wind around, with serene and quiet scenery.

The mountain gate of the studying pavilion is of timber-stone structure, in xieshan roof form; on the door lintel are written the four large characters Ancient Studying Pavilion.

The front courtyard consists of the gate archway, Ganyu Pavilion, and left, middle, and right corridors; the main building of the middle courtyard is the Shiyi Pavilion, with a double-eave hexagonal pyramidal roof; the main building of the rear courtyard is the Liuyun Immortal Hall, and to the north stands the Mingyuan Pavilion.

Although the Studying Pavilion of Chen Zi'ang is not very old, it cannot conceal its rich cultural heritage.

Inside the studying pavilion there are numerous plaques and couplets, all handwritings of famous scholars past and present; the woodcarvings of Thirty Poems of Ganyu and Biography of Mr.

Chen Boyu are the most precious.

Inside the Liuyun Immortal Hall there are also numerous documentary materials about Chen Zi'ang, all of which give this building a rich heritage and cultural temperament inconsistent with its age — truly a sacred place for cherishing the memory of Chen Zi'ang.

In May 2006, as a Qing dynasty ancient building, the Studying Pavilion of Chen Zi'ang, by virtue of the rich cultural heritage it brings to later generations, was included in the list of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units.

高峰山古建筑群

Ancient Building Complex at Gaofeng Mountain
国家级 清 宗教建筑 建筑群
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address遂宁市蓬溪县高峰山
类型 Type宗教建筑 建筑群
看点 Highlights: 规模 院落 建筑群布局 老子塑像

中文描述 Description

遂宁市蓬溪县高峰山风景宜人，自然朴素而又灵气宜人。

高峰山古建筑群就位于这一片葱茏树木之中，是清至民国年间的建筑群。

建筑群的年代虽然不甚久远，但是它布局奇特，是依靠周易八卦结构布局，是国内寺观建筑中的一个另类，一朵奇葩。

高峰山古建筑群建筑面积达到5200余平方米，主要有四大部分，分布在高峰山的山顶和山腰。

分别为：主庙、王源清墓及碑亭、范云峰墓及碑亭、寨垣及宅门。

沿着山路登至山顶，便可看见环绕山顶而建的神奇的主庙。

主庙是木结构八卦式建筑群，庙内甬道纵横，楼阁环绕，飞檐交错，还有许多天桥、楼梯，重重叠叠，错综复杂，十分壮观。

除此之外，建筑内还有许多暗室、暗道，共同组成一个令人眼花缭乱的行走路线，果然不愧川北迷宫的称号。

王源清是高峰山道观的开山祖师，范云峰则是二代祖师。

高峰山建筑群就是在两位祖师的努力之下促成的。

两位的碑亭皆是民国建筑，雕刻精美，保存也十分完好。

寨垣和寨门位于山腰，依山势而建，根据方位建立东、西、南、北四道寨门，寨门坚固，如同堡垒，具有极佳的防卫功能。

因年代久远，只剩下南寨门和北寨门，不能不说是一个遗憾。

高峰山建筑群自从清末起建之后，并没有什么改动，是研究清末、民国建筑的极佳资料。

同时，建筑群独特的布局，具有重要的堪舆学研究价值，其中的碑刻文存更是研究当地历史的重要资料。

英文翻译 English Translation

Gaofeng Mountain in Pengxi County, Suining City, has pleasant scenery, natural and simple yet with spiritual charm.

The Ancient Building Complex at Gaofeng Mountain is located within this lush expanse of trees; it is a building complex from the Qing to Republican period.

Although the age of the building complex is not very old, its layout is peculiar — it relies on the Zhouyi (I Ching) Eight Trigrams structural layout, an alternative among domestic temple and Taoist temple architecture, a wonderful flower.

The building area of the Ancient Building Complex at Gaofeng Mountain reaches over 5,200 sq m, mainly with four major parts, distributed on the mountain top and mountainside of Gaofeng Mountain.

They are respectively: the main temple, Wang Yuanqing's tomb and stele pavilion, Fan Yunfeng's tomb and stele pavilion, and the fortress wall and gate.

Climbing along the mountain road to the summit, one can see the magical main temple built encircling the mountain top.

The main temple is a timber-structure Eight-Trigrams-style building complex; inside the temple, corridors crisscross, pavilions encircle, flying eaves interlock, and there are also many sky bridges and staircases, layer upon layer, intricate and complex, very spectacular.

In addition, inside the building there are many dark rooms and secret passages, together forming a dazzling walking route — truly worthy of the title Maze of Northern Sichuan.

Wang Yuanqing was the founding patriarch of the Gaofeng Mountain Taoist temple, and Fan Yunfeng was the second-generation patriarch.

The Gaofeng Mountain building complex was brought into being through the efforts of the two patriarchs.

Both of their stele pavilions are Republican-era buildings, with exquisite carvings and very well preserved.

The fortress wall and gates are located on the mountainside, built according to the mountain terrain; according to the directions, four fortress gates were established in the east, west, south, and north.

The fortress gates are sturdy, like fortresses, with excellent defensive functions.

Due to the passage of time, only the south and north fortress gates remain — which cannot but be said to be a regret.

Since its construction began in the late Qing, the Gaofeng Mountain building complex has not undergone any changes, making it excellent material for studying late Qing and Republican architecture.

At the same time, the unique layout of the building complex has important value for the study of fengshui (kanyu); among them, the stele inscriptions and documents are even more important materials for studying local history.

广德寺

Guangde Temple
国家级 明—清 宗教建筑 建筑群
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address遂宁市城西卧龙山麓
类型 Type宗教建筑 建筑群
看点 Highlights: 石作 木构 院落

中文描述 Description

遂宁广德寺，位于遂宁市城西的卧龙山麓。

始建于唐开元年间。

于明洪武至宣德年间重修，清康熙年间维修并且扩建。

广德寺占地面积约8350平方米，园林面积更是有18万平方米，规模宏伟，素有西来第一禅林的美称。

广德寺建于卧龙山首，依山势建寺。

建筑主次分明，左右对称，自山麓至山顶呈现三列纵向布局。

中轴线上，殿宇七重，哼哈殿、圣旨坊、碑亭、天王殿、大雄宝殿等建筑依次排列，层层迭起。

大雄宝殿庄重而不失飘逸，殿前香雾袅袅升起，不愧为佛家圣地。

历史上，广德寺香火旺盛，在唐、宋、明朝受到十一次敕封。

敕赐广德禅寺坊雕刻精美，颇具历史沧桑感，让人感到广德寺在历史上的地位。

迈入广德寺，映入眼帘的便是圣旨坊。

圣旨坊初建于宋，现存的圣旨坊是在明代改建而成的。

横匾上书写着敕赐禅林四个金字，横匾之上还有一块书写着圣旨的牌匾，凸显其庄重威严。

牌坊为木质结构，重檐歇山顶的形制更显示出其地位之高。

这是国内唯一一个建于寺庙之内的圣旨牌坊，足以显示广德寺尊贵地位。

说起广德寺的尊贵地位，就不得不说另一处镇寺之宝。

那就是善济塔。

广德寺千百年历史中，高僧辈出。

最出名的莫过于克幽禅师。

他也是广德寺历代不衰的一个重要原因。

克幽禅师拥有高超的德行，被香客们视为观音的化身，还两次被皇帝请入宫内说法。

克幽禅师圆寂之后，门徒奉命建塔以葬金身。

这座塔就是现在大雄宝殿西边的善济塔。

此塔为方形砖石结构，高七层，保存十分完整。

漫步广德寺之内，感受它的古朴、庄重，不由抛弃杂念，内心平静起来。

英文翻译 English Translation

Suining Guangde Temple is located at the foot of Wolong (Crouching Dragon) Mountain, west of Suining City.

It was first built during the Tang Kaiyuan era.

Rebuilt from Ming Hongwu to Xuande eras, and repaired and expanded during the Qing Kangxi era.

Guangde Temple covers about 8,350 sq m, and its garden area is even 180,000 sq m, with a grand scale, known as the First Chan Forest Coming from the West.

Guangde Temple was built at the head of Wolong Mountain, with the temple built according to the mountain terrain.

The buildings have clear primary and secondary distinctions, symmetrical left and right, presenting three longitudinal rows from the foot to the top of the mountain.

On the central axis, there are seven layers of halls; the Hengha Hall, Shengzhi (Imperial Decree) Archway, Stele Pavilion, Heavenly Kings Hall, Mahavira Hall, and other buildings are arranged in sequence, rising layer by layer.

The Mahavira Hall is dignified yet without losing elegance; in front of the hall, incense smoke curls up — truly worthy of being a Buddhist sacred place.

Historically, Guangde Temple had flourishing incense, and received imperial enfeoffment eleven times in Tang, Song, and Ming dynasties.

The Archway of Imperially Bestowed Guangde Chan Temple is exquisitely carved, quite full of historical vicissitudes, making one feel Guangde Temple's position in history.

Entering Guangde Temple, what comes into view is the Shengzhi Archway.

The Shengzhi Archway was first built in Song; the existing Shengzhi Archway was rebuilt in Ming.

On the horizontal plaque are written the four golden characters Imperially Bestowed Chan Forest; above the horizontal plaque there is another plaque writing Imperial Decree, highlighting its solemnity and majesty.

The archway is of timber structure, and the double-eave xieshan roof form further shows its high status.

This is the only imperial-decree archway built within a temple in China, sufficient to show Guangde Temple's noble status.

Speaking of Guangde Temple's noble status, one must mention another town-protecting treasure.

That is the Shanji (Good Salvation) Pagoda.

In Guangde Temple's thousands of years of history, eminent monks have emerged in large numbers.

The most famous is none other than Master Keyou.

He is also an important reason for Guangde Temple's enduring prosperity through the dynasties.

Master Keyou possessed superb virtue, regarded by pilgrims as the incarnation of Guanyin, and was twice invited by the emperor to enter the palace to preach the Dharma.

After Master Keyou passed away, his disciples, by order, built a pagoda to bury his golden body.

This pagoda is the current Shanji Pagoda west of the Mahavira Hall.

This pagoda is of square brick-stone structure, seven stories high, very completely preserved.

Strolling within Guangde Temple, feeling its simplicity and solemnity, one cannot help but cast aside distracting thoughts and become calm inside.

灵泉寺

Lingquan Temple
省级 明 宗教寺庙
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address遂宁市城东灵泉山
类型 Type宗教寺庙
看点 Highlights: 泉水 山势 楼阁

中文描述 Description

灵泉寺位于遂宁市城东的灵泉山，与广德寺隔着涪江相望。

寺庙依山势而建，绿树成荫。

因为山中有一泉水，色碧而味甘，终年不溢不涸，名曰灵泉，故最终将寺命名为灵泉寺。

据记载，灵泉寺始建于隋文帝开皇年间，最初寺号并非灵泉寺而是圣佛寺。

明孝宗弘治三年(1490年)重建之后，改名为灵泉寺。

在鼎盛时期，灵泉寺香火极旺，被誉为灵泉圣境，几乎能与南海普陀山齐名。

今天的灵泉山依旧是川中的佛教活动中心，每年重要节日都会吸引各方信徒云集，热闹非凡。

走过售票处，经过一段让人凝神静心的长长的林荫道之后，我们便到达一处空旷的广场。

在这里，我们可以看到灵泉寺的牌匾。

建筑庄严肃穆，牌匾上的字也是沉郁顿挫，无一不显示出这座千年古刹的风范。

哪怕只看一眼也会让人心底充满敬意，内心平静地走向寺院深处。

灵泉寺的大雄宝殿面阔三间，进深三间。

采用重檐歇山顶的形制，抬梁式构架，庄严而不失飘逸。

观音阁位于灵泉山主峰观音顶上，是整个景区的最高点。

琉璃瓦，高飞檐，气势恢宏。

置身于幽静的灵泉圣境，不禁让人生出向善之心，抛却心中杂念。

英文翻译 English Translation

Lingquan Temple is located on Lingquan Mountain, east of Suining City, facing Guangde Temple across the Fu River.

The temple is built according to the mountain terrain, with green trees forming shade.

Because there is a spring in the mountain, green in color and sweet in taste, neither overflowing nor drying up year-round, named Lingquan (Spirit Spring), hence the temple was finally named Lingquan Temple.

According to records, Lingquan Temple was first built during the Sui Wendi Kaihuang era; originally the temple name was not Lingquan Temple but Shengfo (Holy Buddha) Temple.

After reconstruction in the 3rd year of Hongzhi of Ming Xiaozong (1490), it was renamed Lingquan Temple.

In its heyday, Lingquan Temple had extremely flourishing incense, praised as the Lingquan Sacred Realm, almost on par with Putuo Mountain in the South Sea.

Today's Lingquan Mountain is still the Buddhist activity center of central Sichuan; every important festival it attracts believers from all sides gathering together, bustling and extraordinary.

Passing the ticket office, after a long tree-lined path that makes one focus and calm the mind, we arrive at an open square.

Here, we can see the plaque of Lingquan Temple.

The building is solemn and majestic, and the characters on the plaque are also deep and forceful, all without exception showing the demeanor of this thousand-year-old ancient temple.

Even just one glance fills one's heart with respect, walking calmly toward the depths of the temple.

The Mahavira Hall of Lingquan Temple is 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep.

It adopts a double-eave xieshan roof form, with a post-and-lintel frame, dignified yet without losing elegance.

The Guanyin Pavilion is located on Guanyin Peak, the main peak of Lingquan Mountain, and is the highest point of the entire scenic area.

Glazed tiles, high flying eaves, with grand momentum.

Being in the serene Lingquan Sacred Realm, one cannot help but develop a heart toward goodness and cast aside distracting thoughts in the mind.

饶益寺

Raoyi Temple
国家级 明 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address遂宁市射洪县柳树镇南两公里处通济山
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 木构 壁画 明代木构

中文描述 Description

饶益寺坐落在遂宁市射洪县柳树镇南两公里处的通济山上，为四合院布局，结构严谨、条理有序。

现存有山门、天王殿、大雄宝殿、地藏王殿、观音殿、厢房和后山门等古代建筑，保存状况较好。

寺庙依地势而建，寺内古木森森，曲径通幽，一院连一院，趣味十足。

由山门进入寺庙，经过天王殿，便来到了饶益寺的主体建筑——大雄宝殿。

饶益寺的大雄宝殿始建于唐朝，于明代永乐九年(1411年)和明万历二年(1574年)两次维修，我们现在看到的大雄宝殿应该就是明代遗留下来的模样。

大雄宝殿面阔三间，进深三间，是抬梁式梁架单檐歇山顶建筑，屋顶造型古朴美观，经历数百年风吹雨打依旧安然无恙。

殿内供有大佛三尊，左右森然排列十八罗汉。

大雄宝殿左右墙壁存在精彩壁画，可惜毁于十年浩劫，无法再使后人欣赏。

所幸在其余殿内还有幸存一部分壁画，也让我们能够大饱眼福，少些遗憾。

英文翻译 English Translation

Raoyi Temple is located on Tongji Mountain, two kilometers south of Liushu Town, Shehong County, Suining City.

It has a siheyuan layout, with rigorous structure and orderly arrangement.

Currently surviving ancient buildings include the mountain gate, Heavenly Kings Hall, Mahavira Hall, Ksitigarbha Hall, Guanyin Hall, wing rooms, and rear mountain gate, etc., in relatively good preservation condition.

The temple is built according to the terrain; inside the temple ancient trees are dense, winding paths lead to secluded places, one courtyard connects to another, full of interest.

Entering the temple from the mountain gate, passing the Heavenly Kings Hall, one arrives at the main building of Raoyi Temple — the Mahavira Hall.

The Mahavira Hall of Raoyi Temple was first built in Tang dynasty, and underwent two repairs in the 9th year of Yongle (1411) and the 2nd year of Wanli (1574) of Ming; the Mahavira Hall we see now should be the appearance left from Ming dynasty.

The Mahavira Hall is 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep, a single-eave xieshan roof building with a post-and-lintel beam frame; the roof shape is simple and beautiful, having experienced hundreds of years of wind and rain still safe and sound.

Inside the hall there are three large Buddha statues enshrined, with Eighteen Arhats solemnly arranged on the left and right.

There are wonderful murals on the left and right walls of the Mahavira Hall; unfortunately they were destroyed in the ten-year catastrophe, and can no longer be appreciated by later generations.

Fortunately, in the remaining halls there is still a surviving part of the murals, which also allows us to feast our eyes and have fewer regrets.

蓬溪奎塔

Kui Pagoda in Pengxi
国家级 清 古塔
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address遂宁市蓬溪县赤城镇奎阁公园
类型 Type古塔
看点 Highlights: 木构 石作

中文描述 Description

蓬溪奎塔，又名鳌峙阁，位于遂宁市蓬溪县赤城镇奎阁公园内，建于清嘉庆六年(1801年)，总占地面积约220平方米，通高约26米。

奎塔坐北朝南，五重檐八角攒尖屋顶，是穿斗式与抬梁式结构混合的木结构建筑。

奎塔由塔基与塔身组成。

塔身呈八边形，层层内收并出檐，角檐翘起。

底层对开门，内有楼梯可攀至顶层。

宝顶由束腰须弥座形刹座和葫芦形刹尖组成，制作精美。

塔基为条石砌筑而成，南北均为垂带踏道，共13级。

奎塔内拥有许多精美的雕刻，底层的柱础、各层撑拱，雀替均为圆雕或者浮雕，人物、瑞兽、花草无一不是造型精美，显示出极高的工艺水平，古朴而不失秀气。

奎塔所在处是节日里居民喝茶聊天的胜地，场面热闹非凡，极其壮观。

虽然奎塔被围栏围住，让人无法靠近，但它依旧能在日常生活中给当地人民以文化熏陶，真正融入百姓生活之中，真是让人倍感欣慰。

英文翻译 English Translation

Kui Pagoda in Pengxi, also known as Aozhi Pavilion, is located in Kuige Park, Chicheng Town, Pengxi County, Suining City.

It was built in the 6th year of Jiaqing (1801), Qing dynasty, with a total site area of about 220 sq m and a total height of about 26m.

Kui Pagoda faces south, with a five-eave octagonal pyramidal roof; it is a timber structure building with a mixed chuan-dou and post-and-lintel structure.

Kui Pagoda consists of a pagoda base and pagoda body.

The pagoda body is octagonal, tapering inward layer by layer with eaves extending out, and the corner eaves curl upward.

The bottom layer has opposite doors, with stairs inside that can climb to the top layer.

The precious top consists of a waisted xumi-seat-style finial base and a gourd-shaped finial tip, exquisitely made.

The pagoda base is built of dressed stones, with垂带-style steps on both north and south, totaling 13 levels.

Inside Kui Pagoda there are many exquisite carvings; the column bases of the bottom layer, the supporting brackets of each layer, and the sparrow brackets are all round carvings or reliefs; figures, auspicious beasts, flowers and plants are all without exception exquisitely shaped, showing an extremely high level of craftsmanship, simple yet without losing elegance.

The place where Kui Pagoda is located is a popular spot for residents to drink tea and chat during festivals, with a bustling and extraordinary scene, extremely spectacular.

Although Kui Pagoda is surrounded by a fence, making it impossible for people to approach, it can still give local people cultural edification in daily life, truly integrating into the lives of the common people — really making one feel gratified.

寂光寺

Jiguang Temple
省级 明—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address遂宁市大英县蓬莱镇古井村
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 院落 山势 轴线

中文描述 Description

寂光寺位于四川省遂宁市大英县蓬莱镇古井村。

寂光寺为四合院布局，因为寺内有一座古井，井水甘甜，故又被称作古井寺。

这口古井也是古井村地名的由来。

寂光寺始建于隋大业年间，后因兵火而毁。

明清年间，寺庙进行重修，留下了今天的格局。

寂光寺沿着中轴线布局，沿山势向上递升，由山门、弥勒殿、大雄殿和转轮殿形成三进院落的布局形式。

寂光寺的山门又称魁星楼，共两层。

面阔三间，进深三间，重檐歇山顶形制。

门前有小溪穿过，一道石拱桥横跨小溪，增强了纵向的轴线序列。

寂光寺的大雄宝殿位于高高的台基之上，强调了大殿的地位之高。

宽阔的台阶上长着低矮的草本，两旁绿树成荫，建筑与自然相得益彰。

寂光寺布局严谨，建筑虽不是很多，但是气势宏伟。

茂密的古树林更是给建筑增添了几分幽静。

英文翻译 English Translation

Jiguang Temple is located in Gujing (Ancient Well) Village, Penglai Town, Daying County, Suining City, Sichuan Province.

Jiguang Temple has a siheyuan layout; because there is an ancient well inside the temple with sweet well water, it is also called Ancient Well Temple.

This ancient well is also the origin of the place name Gujing Village.

Jiguang Temple was first built during the Sui Daye era, later destroyed due to war and fire.

During Ming-Qing period, the temple was rebuilt, leaving today's layout.

Jiguang Temple is laid out along the central axis, ascending upward along the mountain terrain; from the mountain gate, Maitreya Hall, Mahavira Hall, and Zhuanlun (Wheel) Hall, it forms a three-courtyard layout form.

The mountain gate of Jiguang Temple is also called Kuixing (Star of Literature) Tower, with two stories.

It is 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep, in double-eave xieshan roof form.

In front of the gate a small stream passes through, and a stone arch bridge spans the small stream, enhancing the longitudinal axis sequence.

The Mahavira Hall of Jiguang Temple is located on a high platform base, emphasizing the high status of the main hall.

On the broad steps grow low herbs, and on both sides green trees form shade; architecture and nature complement each other.

Jiguang Temple has a rigorous layout; although there are not many buildings, the momentum is grand.

The dense ancient forest even adds a touch of serenity to the buildings.

金仙寺

Jinxian Temple
省级 元 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty元
地址 Address遂宁市蓬溪县赤脚镇金仙村
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 元代木构 题记

中文描述 Description

金仙寺建于元代，位于遂宁市蓬溪县赤脚镇金仙村，交通较为不便，属于四川省第八批省级重点文物保护单位。

金仙寺大殿原面阔三间，进深三间，单檐歇山顶，青瓦素屋面，朴素却又不失飘逸沉稳。

大殿用料较为随意，多为天然弯木，不失元代粗犷之感。

梁上刻有题记，记录了大殿于何时由何人所建，何人捐赠多少银两木料等等，丰富的题记包含了大量信息，具有一定的研究价值。

同时，梁架上原绘有彩画，由于年代久远，痕迹已经不明显了。

经历了无情岁月鞭挞之后，曾经拥有辉煌的金仙寺已经荒草丛生，只剩下一座破旧的大殿摇摇欲坠。

由于当地人曾经将大殿当作学校，所以殿内的佛龛全部都被移走，只剩下四面漏风墙壁，空空如也，保存状况令人担忧。

金仙寺是2008年才被遂宁市文物普查队发现的。

不知在四川某个偏远的山沟中，是否还有一些古代瑰宝，等待着人们去发现、去保护呢？

英文翻译 English Translation

Jinxian Temple was built in Yuan dynasty, located in Jinxian Village, Chijiao Town, Pengxi County, Suining City, with relatively inconvenient transportation.

It belongs to the 8th batch of Sichuan Provincial Key Cultural Relics Protection Units.

The main hall of Jinxian Temple was originally 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep, with a single-eave xieshan roof and grey tile plain roof surface — simple yet without losing elegance and steadiness.

The materials used in the main hall are relatively casual, mostly naturally curved timber, without losing the rough feeling of Yuan dynasty.

On the beams there are carved inscriptions, recording when and by whom the main hall was built, who donated how much silver and timber, etc.; the rich inscriptions contain a large amount of information, with certain research value.

At the same time, the beam frame was originally painted with colored paintings; due to the passage of time, the traces are no longer obvious.

After being whipped by the merciless years, Jinxian Temple, which once had glory, has become overgrown with weeds, leaving only a dilapidated main hall crumbling.

Because local people once used the main hall as a school, all the Buddhist shrines inside the hall were removed, leaving only walls leaking wind on all four sides, empty as can be; the preservation condition is worrying.

Jinxian Temple was only discovered by the Suining Cultural Relics Survey Team in 2008.

I wonder whether in some remote mountain valley in Sichuan there are still some ancient treasures waiting for people to discover and protect?

百福院

Baifu Hall
省级 明—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address遂宁市船山区天上街百福巷
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 木构

中文描述 Description

百福院位于四川省遂宁市船山区天上街百福巷，地处一片较为繁华的闹市区，其破旧与周围的繁华显得格格不入。

百福院原为四合院布局，分为前殿和后殿，占地面积947平方米。

前殿建于明洪武年间，后院建于清乾隆年间。

2002年，后殿以及右厢房被拆除，故现仅存前殿。

百福院前殿面阔三间，进深三间，采用抬梁式梁架，单檐歇山顶形制，飘逸庄重，斑驳的青瓦屋面更让人感到建筑年代之久远。

百福院是研究元末明初古建筑的重要实例，也是遂宁现存最早的木结构建筑物，具有重要文物价值，民间甚至有先有百福院，后有遂宁县的说法。

遗憾的是，百福院的现状并不乐观。

因为历史久远，前殿已经破败不堪，墙体也是四面破洞、布满各种补丁。

一座历经沧桑的建筑现在已经是破破烂烂，看上去危在旦夕，实在让人心痛。

英文翻译 English Translation

Baifu Hall is located in Baifu Alley, Tianshang Street, Chuanshan District, Suining City, Sichuan Province.

It is situated in a relatively bustling downtown area, and its dilapidation seems out of place with the surrounding prosperity.

Baifu Hall originally had a siheyuan layout, divided into a front hall and a rear hall, covering 947 sq m.

The front hall was built during the Ming Hongwu era, and the rear courtyard was built during the Qing Qianlong era.

In 2002, the rear hall and right wing room were demolished, hence currently only the front hall survives.

The front hall of Baifu Hall is 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep, adopting a post-and-lintel beam frame, in single-eave xieshan roof form — elegant and dignified; the mottled grey tile roof surface makes one feel even more the long age of the building.

Baifu Hall is an important example for studying ancient buildings of the late Yuan and early Ming, and is also the earliest surviving timber structure building in Suining, with important cultural relic value; among the people there is even a saying that first there was Baifu Hall, then there was Suining County.

Unfortunately, the current state of Baifu Hall is not optimistic.

Because of its long history, the front hall has already fallen into disrepair, and the walls are also full of holes on all four sides, covered with various patches.

A building that has experienced vicissitudes is now in tatters, looking as if it is in imminent danger — truly heart-wrenching.

大安寺

Da'an Temple
省级 明 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address广元市朝天区小安乡云雾山
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 明代木构 铁碑

中文描述 Description

大安寺在广元市朝天区小安乡内，地处偏僻的云雾山。

这里交通不便，进山的巴士次数较少，也非正规，加之路崎岖而无护栏，若非经验丰富的司机带路，上山非常危险。

大安寺为千年古寺，具有珍贵的文化艺术价值，于2007年成为四川省省级重点文物保护单位。

大安寺始建于东汉末年，本名为圆通观，为雄踞汉中的军阀、五斗米道天师张鲁所建。

唐初由尉迟敬德重修改名圆通寺。

明崇祯年间，由于圆通寺住持率领弟子与张献忠军队抗争，保护了寺庙与周围地区的安宁和平，故改名为大安寺。

大安寺的寺庙外围经过修复粉饰，恢复了往日的恢宏面貌，与苍木翠林，显得安详而肃穆。

可惜寺内貌似多年未曾打理维护，显得残破不堪，与外墙形成鲜明的对比。

殿内有一座记载着捐献寺庙重修事宜的民国石碑。

此外，还有一口铁碑，据说重达千斤，是大安寺的镇寺之宝。

铁碑铸于明朝，碑上镌刻有铭文《建立观音寺记》，记载圆通寺维修事宜，虽通身铁锈但保存完好，铭文依旧清晰可见。

放眼望去，荒无人烟的寺内院落显得古旧而凄清，残砖破瓦随意地堆砌在房梁之上。

殿内的佛像虽然庄严依旧，却也经不住岁月摧残，落满了灰尘，凄冷孤寂异常。

英文翻译 English Translation

Da'an Temple is located in Xiao'an Township, Chaotian District, Guangyuan City, on the remote Yunwu (Cloud-Mist) Mountain.

Transportation here is inconvenient; there are few buses going into the mountain, and they are not regular; plus the road is rugged with no guardrails — unless guided by an experienced driver, going up the mountain is very dangerous.

Da'an Temple is a thousand-year-old ancient temple with precious cultural and artistic value, and became a Sichuan Provincial Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit in 2007.

Da'an Temple was first built in the late Eastern Han dynasty, originally named Yuantong Daoist Temple, built by Zhang Lu, the warlord dominating Hanzhong and the Celestial Master of the Five Pecks of Rice Dao.

In early Tang it was rebuilt by Yuchi Jingde and renamed Yuantong Temple.

During the Ming Chongzhen era, because the abbot of Yuantong Temple led his disciples to resist Zhang Xianzhong's army, protecting the temple and the peace of the surrounding area, it was renamed Da'an (Great Peace) Temple.

The outer perimeter of Da'an Temple has been repaired and whitewashed, restoring its former grand appearance; with the verdant trees and forests, it appears serene and solemn.

Unfortunately, the inside of the temple seems not to have been maintained for many years, appearing dilapidated, in stark contrast to the outer walls.

Inside the hall there is a Republican-era stone stele recording the donation for the temple's reconstruction.

In addition, there is an iron stele, said to weigh a thousand jin, the town-protecting treasure of Da'an Temple.

The iron stele was cast in Ming dynasty; on the stele is engraved the inscription Record of the Establishment of Guanyin Temple, recording the maintenance of Yuantong Temple.

Although covered in rust all over, it is well preserved, and the inscription is still clearly visible.

Looking around, the desolate temple courtyard appears old and desolate; broken bricks and tiles are casually piled on the beams.

Although the Buddha statues inside the hall are still solemn, they cannot withstand the ravages of time, covered in dust, extremely cold and lonely.

广元千佛崖摩崖造像

Cliffside Statues of Qianfo Cliff in Guangyuan
国家级 北魏晚期—宋 摩崖造像
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty北魏晚期—宋
地址 Address广元城北嘉陵江东岸
类型 Type摩崖造像
看点 Highlights: 佛像 规模 武则天

中文描述 Description

广元千佛崖是与皇泽寺齐名的一处文化圣地，坐落于广元城北的嘉陵江东岸。

崖上保存着数百米长的石窟群，宏伟的规模冠绝四川地区。

虽由于1935年修建川陕公路，使得造像损毁过半以上，但崖上现今仍存在造像7000余尊，龛窟1192个，题刻118条，可想当年千佛崖规模何其壮观。

1961年，千佛崖摩崖造像当之无愧地被国务院列为首批全国重点文物保护单位。

造像始雕刻于北魏晚期，在唐代和五代时期兴盛异常。

历经千年岁月的更迭，峭壁上重龛窟满布，并分为南北两段，以规模最大的大云洞为中心。

千佛崖上最早开凿的洞窟为大佛窟，始凿于北魏时期。

龛中现存一尊佛与两尊菩萨三尊大像，其衣饰飘逸，面相庄严，为典型的南北朝的风格，可惜的是这些造像曾经受到了不同程度的破坏，多不完整。

此外，莲花洞窟龛造像为唐代雕刻艺术的珍品，开凿于武则天称帝时期。

莲花洞因洞顶的莲花而得名，洞前介绍上说，洞内雕刻着三世佛造像，分别为阿弥陀佛、释迦佛和弥勒佛，弥勒佛居中，神态庄严安详，面容栩栩如生。

据说，武则天称帝时，有白马寺12名和尚撰写《大云经》对其歌功颂德，称之为弥勒佛转世，取李唐而代之实为天命。

武皇非常高兴，便下令全国兴建大云寺，普及《大云经》。

从千佛崖前的大云寺，规模最大的大云洞龛窟，及大云洞正中的弥勒佛大佛像便可见一斑。

千佛崖石窟规模宏大，造像精美，历史悠久，临江而建气势非凡，是四川省内必去的旅游景点之一。

英文翻译 English Translation

Qianfo (Thousand-Buddha) Cliff in Guangyuan is a cultural sacred place on par with Huangze Temple, located on the east bank of the Jialing River north of Guangyuan city.

On the cliff there are preserved grotto groups several hundred meters long, with a grand scale unmatched in Sichuan.

Although due to the construction of the Sichuan-Shaanxi Highway in 1935, over half of the statues were damaged, today there still exist over 7,000 statues, 1,192 niches and caves, and 118 inscriptions on the cliff — one can imagine how spectacular the scale of Qianfo Cliff was in those days.

In 1961, the Cliffside Statues of Qianfo Cliff were deservedly listed by the State Council as one of the first batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units.

The statues were first carved in the late Northern Wei, and flourished extraordinarily in Tang and Five Dynasties periods.

After a thousand years of changes, the steep cliff is densely covered with niches and caves, divided into north and south sections, centered on the largest-scale Dayun (Great Cloud) Cave.

The earliest excavated cave on Qianfo Cliff is the Great Buddha Cave, first excavated in the Northern Wei period.

In the niche there currently survive three large statues — one Buddha and two Bodhisattvas; their garments are elegant, their faces solemn, a typical Northern and Southern Dynasties style.

Unfortunately these statues have suffered varying degrees of damage and are mostly incomplete.

In addition, the statues in the Lotus Flower Cave niche are treasures of Tang dynasty carving art, excavated during the period when Wu Zetian proclaimed herself emperor.

The Lotus Flower Cave is named after the lotus flower on the cave ceiling; according to the introduction in front of the cave, inside the cave are carved statues of the Buddhas of Three Ages, respectively Amitabha Buddha, Shakyamuni Buddha, and Maitreya Buddha; Maitreya Buddha is in the center, with a solemn and serene expression, and a lifelike face.

It is said that when Wu Zetian proclaimed herself emperor, 12 monks from Baima Temple wrote the Great Cloud Sutra to sing her praises, calling her the reincarnation of Maitreya Buddha, and that replacing the Li Tang was indeed the Mandate of Heaven.

Empress Wu was very pleased, and ordered the construction of Great Cloud Temples nationwide to popularize the Great Cloud Sutra.

This can be seen from the Great Cloud Temple in front of Qianfo Cliff, the largest-scale Dayun Cave niche, and the large Maitreya Buddha statue in the center of Dayun Cave.

The Qianfo Cliff grottoes have a grand scale, exquisite statues, and a long history; built facing the river with extraordinary momentum, they are one of the must-visit tourist attractions in Sichuan Province.

皇泽寺

Cliffside Statues of Huangze Temple
国家级 唐—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty唐—清
地址 Address广元市利州区嘉陵江西岸
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 武则天 造像

中文描述 Description

广元最负盛名的旅游景点之一应该就是皇泽寺了。

这座供奉着女皇武则天的祀庙，恢宏壮阔，气宇轩昂。

皇泽寺是全国唯一的一座武则天祀庙，且寺内留存着从北魏至明清的摩崖造像、碑刻，具有浓厚的历史底蕴和珍贵的文化价值。

于1961年成为了国务院批准的第一批全国重点文物保护单位。

皇泽寺坐落于广元城西的嘉陵江西岸，隔江呼应着广元城区。

寺庙始建于北魏，原为纪念李冰及其子二郎所建，名为乌奴寺，又名川主庙。

后武则天称帝，为福泽故里广元（时名利州），出资粉饰川主庙，并取皇恩浩荡，泽及故里之意，将寺庙改名为皇泽寺。

走进华丽庄严的皇泽寺，迎面便是供奉着武则天与唐高宗李治的二圣殿，大殿中央，武则天与李治的塑像庄严而坐，两边站立着高宗、武周时期的九位名臣。

二圣殿后为皇泽寺主殿则天殿。

则天殿为整个寺庙中心，殿中矗立着全国唯一的一座武则天真容石刻塑像，石像是由整块的砂岩雕饰琢磨而成，高约1.8米。

只见女皇头戴法冠，身披法衣，手结法印，佛法庄严，慈悲之像可谓是巧夺天工。

在皇泽寺的庙堂之中，还保存着另一千古奇珍，这便是皇泽寺的石刻造像。

皇泽寺有着1203身分布于中心塔柱窟、大佛楼、则天殿等处的摩崖造像，50个窟龛。

始开凿于北魏，经过北周、隋、唐、明、清等朝代的持续雕琢，终有今日之规模。

则天殿之上的中心柱窟造像开凿于北魏晚期，是皇泽寺造像之中历史最为悠久的一处，可谓冠绝全蜀。

中心柱为一根雕琢成经塔状的方柱，支撑起整个窟龛，窟中三面壁墙龛中均刻有佛像，温润质朴，肃穆庄严。

皇泽寺最大的一龛造像则为初唐年代建成的大佛窟，龛内佛像众多，壁饰精美。

主佛、弟子、观音等造像展现出各异的神态与肢体语言，形象生动，令人惊异于唐代造像的高超造诣。

皇泽寺近年来经过全面整修，原有古建筑已经修整为典型的唐代风格，与皇泽寺主题以及历史相互映衬。

英文翻译 English Translation

One of Guangyuan's most famous tourist attractions should be Huangze Temple.

This temple enshrining Empress Wu Zetian is grand and magnificent, with imposing dignity.

Huangze Temple is the only Wu Zetian temple in the country, and inside the temple there are preserved cliffside statues and stele carvings from Northern Wei to Ming-Qing, with a strong historical heritage and precious cultural value.

In 1961 it became one of the first batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units approved by the State Council.

Huangze Temple is located on the west bank of the Jialing River, west of Guangyuan city, echoing the Guangyuan urban area across the river.

The temple was first built in Northern Wei, originally built to commemorate Li Bing and his son Erlang, named Wunu Temple, also known as Chuanzhu (Sichuan Master) Temple.

Later, when Wu Zetian proclaimed herself emperor, to bless her hometown Guangyuan (then called Lizhou), she funded the whitewashing of Chuanzhu Temple, and taking the meaning of imperial grace vast and benefiting the hometown, renamed the temple Huangze (Imperial Grace) Temple.

Walking into the gorgeous and solemn Huangze Temple, facing you is the Two Sages Hall enshrining Wu Zetian and Emperor Gaozong Li Zhi of Tang; in the center of the hall, the statues of Wu Zetian and Li Zhi sit solemnly, and on both sides stand nine famous ministers of the Gaozong and Wu Zhou periods.

Behind the Two Sages Hall is the main hall of Huangze Temple, the Zetian Hall.

The Zetian Hall is the center of the entire temple; in the hall stands the only stone-carved statue of Wu Zetian's true appearance in the country; the stone statue is carved and polished from a whole block of sandstone, about 1.8m high.

The empress wears a ceremonial crown, a ceremonial robe, and forms a mudra with her hands; the Dharma is solemn, and the compassionate appearance can be said to be a marvel of craftsmanship.

In the halls of Huangze Temple, another eternal treasure is preserved — the stone-carved statues of Huangze Temple.

Huangze Temple has 1,203 cliffside statues distributed in the Central Pillar Cave, Great Buddha Tower, Zetian Hall, etc., and 50 caves and niches.

First excavated in Northern Wei, through continuous carving in Northern Zhou, Sui, Tang, Ming, Qing and other dynasties, it finally reached today's scale.

The statues in the Central Pillar Cave above the Zetian Hall were excavated in the late Northern Wei, the oldest among Huangze Temple's statues, truly unmatched in all of Sichuan.

The central pillar is a square pillar carved into a scripture-tower shape, supporting the entire cave niche; in the niches on the three wall surfaces of the cave there are carved Buddha statues, warm and simple, solemn and dignified.

The largest niche of statues in Huangze Temple is the Great Buddha Cave built in the early Tang period; inside the niche there are numerous Buddha statues, with exquisite wall decorations.

The statues of the main Buddha, disciples, Guanyin, etc.

show various expressions and body language, vivid in image, making one marvel at the superb attainment of Tang dynasty statue carving.

In recent years Huangze Temple has undergone comprehensive renovation; the original ancient buildings have been restored to a typical Tang dynasty style, complementing the theme and history of Huangze Temple.

昭化古城

Zhaohua Ancient City
国家级 蜀汉—清 古城、古建筑群
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty蜀汉—清
地址 Address广元市苍溪县嘉陵江西畔
类型 Type古城、古建筑群
看点 Highlights: 三国文化 石坊 城墙 城门

中文描述 Description

昭化古城位于广元市昭化区昭化镇，距离广元市区较远。

昭化古城古名葭萌，即《三国演义》中张飞与马超大战一天一夜的战场，也是中国唯一一处保存完整的三国古城。

古城是剑门蜀道遗址群的重要组成部分，而剑门蜀道遗址群于2006年被国务院列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。

昭化古城位于连接巴蜀和中原的剑门蜀道之上，历来便是蜀地军事要冲。

进入景区，沿桔柏渡街行走便可看到一座书写着葭萌二字的牌坊，上刻楹联天下第一太极；

蜀道三国重镇，巍峨高大，古韵十足。

昭化古城有东西南北四个城门，分别名为瞻凤临清临江拱极。

古城门建于明朝正德年间，除南门因防洪于清代被封闭以外，东、西、北门皆保存得较为完好，现皆为省级文化保护单位。

古城之内的遗址丰富，留存有县衙、考棚、文庙等建筑，较为完好地记录了古人在城内的生活形式。

此外，古城周边还有丰富的三国历史遗迹，如牛头山、姜维井、战胜坝等，见证了三国蜀汉政权的兴亡。

英文翻译 English Translation

Zhaohua Ancient City is located in Zhaohua Town, Zhaohua District, Guangyuan City, relatively far from the Guangyuan urban area.

Zhaohua Ancient City was anciently called Jiameng, the battlefield where Zhang Fei and Ma Chao fought for a day and a night in Romance of the Three Kingdoms, and is also the only completely preserved Three Kingdoms ancient city in China.

The ancient city is an important component of the Jianmen Shu Road site group, and the Jianmen Shu Road site group was listed by the State Council as the 6th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units in 2006.

Zhaohua Ancient City is located on the Jianmen Shu Road connecting Bashu (Sichuan) with the Central Plains, and has historically been a military strategic point in Shu.

Entering the scenic area, walking along Jubaidu Street, one can see an archway with the two characters Jiameng written on it; on it are carved the couplet The First Taiji Under Heaven; A Three Kingdoms Strategic Town on the Shu Road — towering and tall, full of ancient charm.

Zhaohua Ancient City has four city gates in the east, west, south, and north, respectively named Zhanfeng, Linqing, Linjiang, and Gongji.

The ancient city gates were built during the Ming Zhengde era; except for the south gate which was closed in Qing for flood control, the east, west, and north gates are all relatively well preserved, and are now all provincial cultural protection units.

The sites inside the ancient city are rich, with surviving buildings such as the county yamen, examination shed, and Confucian temple, relatively completely recording the lifestyle of ancient people in the city.

In addition, around the ancient city there are also rich Three Kingdoms historical relics, such as Niutou Mountain, Jiang Wei Well, and Zhansheng Dam, witnessing the rise and fall of the Shu Han regime of the Three Kingdoms.

剑溪桥

Jianxi Bridge
省级 明 桥梁
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address广元市剑阁县剑门关外
类型 Type桥梁
看点 Highlights: 四川北部唯一的明石拱桥 结构

中文描述 Description

从剑门关向外找寻，不过两公里左右，便可寻觅坐落于大剑溪上的剑溪桥。

剑溪桥是四川省第八批重点文物保护单位，也是四川北部现存的唯一一座明代石拱桥。

桥的对面是志公寺，漫步古桥，潺潺江水与婆娑的树影相伴，越发显得清幽静谧。

桥旁有省保碑与介绍牌，据介绍牌所述，这座明代的石拱桥建于明弘治年间，长18.8米，宽4米，高7米，为剑门蜀道上极其重要的古桥梁。

桥有三孔，皆为两半拱圈拼合而成。

桥面由板石铺就而成，历经数百年依旧稳固如初。

桥头雕有石狮，精致而富有生趣。

支撑着桥的四个桥墩坚固厚实地屹立江中，侧面铺筑的青砖颜色因岁月流逝而斑驳陆离，沧桑而不失凝重。

据说，剑门山区时有山洪暴涨，水却从未漫过桥面，当地人因此敬畏此桥，认为桥在修建时藏有法术，以保卫剑阁这一方净土。

可见，这幽静深沉的剑溪桥，不仅方便着人们的交通往来，也默默承载着这沧桑的历史与人文情怀。

英文翻译 English Translation

Searching outward from Jianmen Pass, only about two kilometers away, one can find Jianxi Bridge located on the Dajian Stream.

Jianxi Bridge is the 8th batch of key cultural relic protection units in Sichuan Province, and is also the only surviving Ming dynasty stone arch bridge in northern Sichuan.

Opposite the bridge is Zhigong Temple; strolling on the ancient bridge, the gurgling river water is accompanied by the dancing shadows of trees, making it even more serene and quiet.

Beside the bridge there is a provincial protection stele and an introduction sign; according to the introduction sign, this Ming dynasty stone arch bridge was built during the Ming Hongzhi era, 18.8m long, 4m wide, and 7m high — an extremely important ancient bridge on the Jianmen Shu Road.

The bridge has three arches, all formed by the joining of two half-arch rings.

The bridge deck is paved with slab stones, and after hundreds of years is still as stable as when first built.

At the bridgehead there are carved stone lions, exquisite and full of vitality.

The four bridge piers supporting the bridge stand firmly and solidly in the river; the grey bricks paved on the sides are mottled due to the passage of time, weathered yet without losing their gravity.

It is said that in the Jianmen mountain area flash floods sometimes surge, but the water has never overflowed the bridge deck; local people therefore revere this bridge, believing that when the bridge was built, magic was hidden in it to protect this pure land of Jiange.

It can be seen that this serene and deep Jianxi Bridge not only facilitates people's transportation and exchanges, but also silently carries this weathered history and humanistic sentiment.

剑门蜀道

Site of Jianmen Shu Road
国家级 战国—清 古道
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty战国—清
地址 Address广元市剑阁县
类型 Type古道
看点 Highlights: 蜀道文化 关楼

中文描述 Description

剑门蜀道，南起绵阳市演武镇，北至广元市朝天镇。

整段蜀道环绕古城剑阁约200公里，在沟通蜀地与外界的交通上起到了非凡的作用。

蜀道修建工程始于西周，其后一直默默造福着蜀地人民，直至民国时期仍在使用。

现剑门蜀道处于剑门蜀道风景名胜区内，是国务院批准的首批国家级风景名胜区之一。

在剑门关最初设计之时，考虑到蜀地险峻，易守难攻，因而蜀地工匠依照山势，建造出了这一防守型的军事要塞。

由于此处为蜀地咽喉，历来是兵家必争之地，因而时至今日，峡谷关口上仍留存有丰富的军事相关的历史遗迹。

以剑门关楼为例，作为军事防守的要塞，雄踞蜀道之上，坚韧挺拔，关楼上布置有箭楼，高达三层，飞檐翘角上装饰有精美的雕塑，关楼之上旌旗卷舒，猎猎作响，使人回想昔时一夫当关万夫莫开的战时情景。

蜀地自古物华天宝，人杰地灵，从不乏古迹名胜、福地洞天，这其中更是有四绝——剑门之险、九寨之奇、青城之幽、峨眉之秀。

置身于剑门关隘，只觉崇山峻岭、气势磅礴，借用昔日范仲淹句：则有心旷神怡，宠辱偕忘，把酒临风，其喜洋洋者矣。

英文翻译 English Translation

The Jianmen Shu Road starts from Yanwu Town, Mianyang City in the south, and reaches Chaotian Town, Guangyuan City in the north.

The entire section of the Shu Road encircles the ancient city of Jiange for about 200 km, and played an extraordinary role in communicating transportation between Shu and the outside world.

The construction project of the Shu Road began in Western Zhou, and thereafter silently benefited the people of Shu, still in use until the Republican period.

Currently the Jianmen Shu Road is within the Jianmen Shu Road Scenic Area, one of the first batch of national-level scenic areas approved by the State Council.

When Jianmen Pass was first designed, considering the steepness of Shu, easy to defend and hard to attack, Shu craftsmen built this defensive military fortress according to the mountain terrain.

Because this place is the throat of Shu, it has historically been a contested military point; hence to this day, rich military-related historical relics still remain at the canyon pass.

Taking the Jianmen Pass Tower as an example, as a military defensive fortress, it dominates the Shu Road, tough and upright; on the pass tower there are arranged arrow towers, up to three stories high, with exquisite sculptures decorating the flying eaves and upturned corners; above the pass tower banners flutter and rustle, making one recall the wartime scene of one man guarding the pass and ten thousand unable to pass in old times.

Since ancient times Shu has been a land of natural treasures and outstanding people, never lacking in historic sites and famous scenic spots, blessed caves and heavens — among them there are even four wonders — the danger of Jianmen, the wonder of Jiuzhai, the seclusion of Qingcheng, and the elegance of Emei.

Being in the Jianmen Pass, one only feels the lofty mountains and majestic momentum; borrowing the words of Fan Zhongyan of old: then one feels carefree and joyful, forgetting both favor and disgrace, holding wine to the wind, filled with delight.

钟鼓楼建筑区

Bell Tower, Drum Tower and Surrounding Ancient Buildings
省级 明—民国 古建筑群
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明—民国
地址 Address广元市剑阁县普安镇
类型 Type古建筑群
看点 Highlights: 城墙 钟楼

中文描述 Description

钟鼓楼建筑区位于广元市剑阁县普安镇，始于明代正德年间，由剑州知州李璧主持修建，在明末由于战乱被毁，现在所见到的钟鼓楼古建筑是民国时期原址上重建的。

钟鼓楼古建筑区在1991年被四川省政府列为省级重点文物保护单位。

钟鼓楼建筑区包括南城门、钟鼓楼、火神庙以及南门的明代城墙。

据相关资料记载，南城门门高3.5米，宽3.4米，门上有箭楼，高8米，城门处的木门仍然保存完好，两侧石柱上雕有野鹿衔花与吉祥如意的图纹，门洞上方题有秀分阆苑四字。

钟鼓楼坐北朝南，整栋楼由木、石柱支撑，分为3层，屋内铺筒瓦，各层均有花草雕饰。

火神庙位于钟鼓楼北侧，庙两侧有配殿。

南门的明代城墙外侧由石条修砌，墙心用土夯实，总长约500米，这些城墙距今已有将近500年的历史，现在仍然保存完好。

现在钟鼓楼周围居民底层均开有店铺，古老的建筑区与现代城市的气息交相辉映。

英文翻译 English Translation

The Bell Tower, Drum Tower and Surrounding Ancient Buildings area is located in Pu'an Town, Jiange County, Guangyuan City.

It began in the Ming Zhengde era, presided over and built by Li Bi, the prefect of Jianzhou; it was destroyed at the end of Ming due to war, and the ancient bell and drum tower buildings seen today were rebuilt on the original site during the Republican period.

The ancient building area of the bell and drum tower was listed as a provincial key cultural relic protection unit by the Sichuan Provincial Government in 1991.

The building area includes the South City Gate, Bell and Drum Tower, Fire God Temple, and the Ming dynasty city wall of the South Gate.

According to relevant records, the South City Gate is 3.5m high and 3.4m wide; above the gate there is an arrow tower, 8m high; the wooden door at the city gate is still well preserved; on the stone pillars on both sides there are carved patterns of wild deer holding flowers and auspiciousness; above the gate opening there is an inscription of the four characters Xiu Fen Lang Yuan.

The Bell and Drum Tower faces south; the entire building is supported by wooden and stone pillars, divided into 3 stories; inside the house there are tubular tiles, and each story has flower and plant carvings.

The Fire God Temple is located on the north side of the Bell and Drum Tower, with side halls on both sides of the temple.

The outer side of the Ming dynasty city wall at the South Gate is built with stone strips, and the wall core is rammed with earth, with a total length of about 500m; these city walls have a history of nearly 500 years, and are still well preserved today.

Now around the Bell and Drum Tower, residents have opened shops on the ground floor, and the ancient building area echoes with the atmosphere of the modern city.

鹤鸣山道教石窟石刻

Taoist Grottoes and Stone Sculptures at Mount Heming
国家级 南北朝—唐 石窟石刻
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty南北朝—唐
地址 Address广元剑阁县普安镇鹤鸣山
类型 Type石窟石刻
看点 Highlights: 造像 石刻

中文描述 Description

鹤鸣山道教石窟及石刻位于广元剑阁县普安镇城东的鹤鸣山。

鹤鸣山是中国道教四大名山之一，山上保存着自东汉以来建造的道教石窟石刻以及始于北魏的道教造像。

由于丰富的历史内涵与精美的石刻造像艺术，鹤鸣山道教石窟石刻由国务院列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。

我们所到的时间为下午五时左右，守门的老大爷本已关门，但见我们从北京不远千里而来，向我们行了个方便，使我们有幸能够在静谧的山野之中瞻仰这片珍贵的历史遗存。

进门迎首便能看见一尊仪态超凡的老君塑像，彰显着道教的文化底蕴。

顺着廊道向内，依次可以看到鹤鸣山石刻中的唐代三绝：李商隐的《剑州重阳亭铭》碑，颜真卿的《大唐中兴颂》以及重阳亭中的道教石刻造像。

这些出于唐代的石刻与造像，自有唐代的风骨与大气。

李商隐所撰《剑州重阳亭铭》以小篆为书写字体，笔力遒劲；

颜真卿所书《大唐中兴颂》，笔力丰满，大气磅礴，无怪乎世人赞誉颜筋柳骨；

造像现存有五个龛窟，可惜其中的造像多有被盗，剩余的几尊主像如一号龛的长生大帝，与三号龛的长生保命天尊，皆面容丰腴而仪态庄严，线条流畅飘逸，为唐代造像之中的珍品。

英文翻译 English Translation

The Taoist Grottoes and Stone Sculptures at Mount Heming are located on Mount Heming, east of Pu'an Town, Jiange County, Guangyuan.

Mount Heming is one of the four famous Taoist mountains in China; on the mountain there are preserved Taoist grotto stone carvings built since the Eastern Han dynasty and Taoist statues beginning in the Northern Wei.

Due to its rich historical connotation and exquisite stone carving statue art, the Taoist Grottoes and Stone Sculptures at Mount Heming were listed by the State Council as the 7th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units.

The time we arrived was around five in the afternoon; the old gatekeeper had already closed the door, but seeing that we had come all the way from Beijing, he did us a favor, allowing us the honor of viewing this precious historical relic in the quiet mountain wilderness.

Upon entering, one can immediately see a statue of Lord Lao Zi with extraordinary bearing, manifesting the cultural heritage of Taoism.

Following the corridor inward, one can sequentially see the Three Wonders of Tang in the Heming Mountain stone carvings: the Stele of Inscription on the Chongyang Pavilion of Jianzhou by Li Shangyin, the Ode to the Resurgence of the Great Tang by Yan Zhenqing, and the Taoist stone-carved statues in the Chongyang Pavilion.

These stone carvings and statues from Tang dynasty naturally have the character and grandeur of Tang.

The Inscription on the Chongyang Pavilion of Jianzhou written by Li Shangyin uses small seal script as the writing font, with powerful brushstrokes; the Ode to the Resurgence of the Great Tang written by Yan Zhenqing has full and powerful brushstrokes, grand and majestic — no wonder the world praises Yan's muscles and Liu's bones.

There are currently five niches and caves of statues; unfortunately many of the statues inside have been stolen; the remaining few main statues, such as the Longevity Great Emperor in Niche No.

1 and the Longevity-Preserving Heavenly Venerable in Niche No.

3, all have plump faces and solemn bearing, with smooth and elegant lines — treasures among Tang dynasty statues.

觉苑寺

Jueyuan Temple
国家级 明 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address广元市剑阁县武连镇
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 壁画 明代木构

中文描述 Description

觉苑寺位于广元剑阁县武连镇，寺庙始建于唐代，据说是一代名臣魏征的家庙，后经历代重修重建，现存为明代风格建筑。

觉苑寺内的佛传壁画精美瑰丽，享负盛名。

觉苑寺在2001年被国务院确立为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。

觉苑寺由三座大殿及东西对称的两座配殿所组成。

其中三座大殿依次为天王殿、大雄宝殿以及观音殿。

大雄宝殿为明代所建，殿内两根立柱上各雕塑着巨龙盘踞其上，气势恢宏。

殿内供有三尊如来佛像，寓意为佛家佛、法、僧一体三宝。

三尊佛像造型一致，唯手势不一。

中间象征着佛的造像双手合十，说法入定，神态安详而慈悲。

侍立在如来造像左右的为阿楠、迦叶两位尊者。

佛龛后还有一尊阿弥陀佛的立像，神态端庄威严。

在大雄宝殿的内壁上，留存着200多幅精致珍贵的《佛传》故事壁画。

在传说中，这些壁画是在唐代建庙时，由画圣吴道子一夜之间绘制完成。

虽只是传说，但也反映了觉苑寺壁画的绘画精美，艺术高超。

壁画故事内容广博而生动，且皆书有四字标题。

据说是由于壁画绘就之时采用了特殊的技法，虽已经数百年岁月的流逝，这些壁画却仍旧绚烂多彩，令人叫绝。

英文翻译 English Translation

Jueyuan Temple is located in Wulian Town, Jiange County, Guangyuan.

The temple was first built in Tang dynasty, said to be the family temple of the famous minister Wei Zheng, later rebuilt and reconstructed through the dynasties; the existing buildings are in Ming dynasty style.

The Buddha-life murals inside Jueyuan Temple are exquisite and magnificent, enjoying a great reputation.

Jueyuan Temple was established by the State Council as the 5th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units in 2001.

Jueyuan Temple consists of three main halls and two symmetric side halls on the east and west.

Among them, the three main halls are sequentially the Heavenly Kings Hall, Mahavira Hall, and Guanyin Hall.

The Mahavira Hall was built in Ming dynasty; on the two columns inside the hall there are each sculpted giant dragons coiling upon them, with grand momentum.

Inside the hall there are enshrined three Tathagata Buddha statues, symbolizing the Three Treasures of Buddhism — Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha as one.

The three Buddha statues have the same form, only differing in hand gestures.

The statue in the center symbolizing the Buddha has hands joined in prayer, preaching and entering meditation, with a serene and compassionate expression.

Attending on the left and right of the Tathagata statue are the two venerable Ananda and Mahakasyapa.

Behind the Buddhist niche there is also a standing statue of Amitabha Buddha, with a dignified and majestic bearing.

On the inner walls of the Mahavira Hall, there are preserved over 200 exquisite and precious murals of the Buddha-life story.

According to legend, these murals were painted overnight by the Painting Sage Wu Daozi when the temple was built in Tang.

Although only a legend, it also reflects the exquisite painting and superb artistry of the Jueyuan Temple murals.

The mural story content is broad and vivid, and all are inscribed with four-character titles.

It is said that because special techniques were used when the murals were painted, although hundreds of years have passed, these murals are still brilliant and colorful, amazing to behold.

临江寺

Linjiang Temple
省级 清 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address广元市苍溪县嘉陵江西畔
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 江边古寺 诗词 山势

中文描述 Description

临江寺位于苍溪县城城西的嘉陵江西畔，古朴沧桑的寺庙因靠临江古渡而获名。

临江寺一带人烟较为稀少，寺庙里面也鲜有人踏足，远离尘世的喧嚣的临江古寺显得幽深而静谧。

寺庙始建于乾隆二十六年(1771年)，经过道光、同治年间的扩建，已成现有规模。

2006年临江寺被四川省人民政府正式确认为省级文物保护单位。

临江寺的格局依山傍水，兼有两只石狮守于寺前，气势很是恢宏壮阔。

拾级而上，可见寺中矗立着一座送客亭，碑上所刻铭文为唐杜少陵送客至此。

杜甫当年旅居阆中期间，曾送客至临江渡，客人的名字现今不可考，却有一首杜甫诗文传世。

这便是《送客至苍溪放船归阆》：送客苍溪县，山寒雨不开。

直愁骑马滑，故作放船回。

青惜峰峦过，黄知橘柚来。

江流大自在，稳坐兴悠哉。

杜甫一生坎坷，却在临江古渡的嘉陵江这大自在江流中，感觉到少有的兴悠哉，这也是临江渡和杜少陵的缘分吧。

送客亭也因其独有的人文情怀，被后人所瞻仰铭记。

除历史人文情怀以外，临江寺独有的特色便是所有的佛像皆在石洞之中，石洞沿山势而凿，殿、楼、廊、径依峭壁而设。

寺庙在峭壁之上，与山势配合巧妙，不得不令人佩服古人高超的建筑智慧。

漫步古寺之内，古朴沧桑的建筑令人流连，石凿的古寺所承载的浓厚历史底蕴也令人神往。

英文翻译 English Translation

Linjiang Temple is located on the west bank of the Jialing River, west of Cangxi County town.

The simple and weathered temple got its name because it relies on the ancient Linjiang Ferry.

The area around Linjiang Temple is relatively sparsely populated, and few people set foot inside the temple; the ancient Linjiang Temple, far from the hustle and bustle of the world, appears deep and quiet.

The temple was first built in the 26th year of Qianlong (1771), and after expansion during the Daoguang and Tongzhi eras, it reached its current scale.

In 2006 Linjiang Temple was officially confirmed as a provincial cultural relic protection unit by the Sichuan Provincial People's Government.

The layout of Linjiang Temple is against the mountain and beside the water, with two stone lions guarding in front of the temple, with a grand and magnificent momentum.

Ascending the steps, one can see a Send-off Pavilion standing in the temple; the inscription carved on the stele reads Tang Du Shaoling sent guests here.

During Du Fu's stay in Langzhong, he once saw guests off to the Linjiang Ferry; the guest's name is now unverifiable, but a poem by Du Fu has been handed down.

This is Seeing Guests Off to Cangxi and Returning by Boat to Lang: Seeing guests off at Cangxi County, the mountain is cold and rain does not clear.

Only worrying about slipping on horseback, so I return by boat.

Green regrets the peaks passing by, yellow knows the oranges and pomelos coming.

The great river flows in great freedom, sitting steadily with leisurely delight.

Du Fu had a rough life, but in the great free-flowing Jialing River at the ancient Linjiang Ferry, he felt a rare leisurely delight — this is also the fate between Linjiang Ferry and Du Shaoling.

The Send-off Pavilion, due to its unique humanistic sentiment, has been admired and remembered by later generations.

Besides historical and humanistic sentiment, the unique feature of Linjiang Temple is that all the Buddha statues are in stone caves; the stone caves are chiseled along the mountain terrain, and halls, towers, corridors, and paths are set according to the steep cliff.

The temple is on the steep cliff, cleverly coordinated with the mountain terrain, making one不得不 admire the superb architectural wisdom of the ancients.

Strolling inside the ancient temple, the simple and weathered buildings make one linger; the rich historical heritage carried by the stone-carved ancient temple is also fascinating.

崇霞宝塔

Chongxia Pagoda
省级 明 砖石塔
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address广元苍溪县城东文焕村宝塔山
类型 Type砖石塔
看点 Highlights: 明代宝塔 形态

中文描述 Description

崇霞宝塔位于广元苍溪县城东文焕村宝塔山，在绿树丛生的山顶一枝独秀。

崇霞宝塔始建于天启六年(1626年)，即木匠皇帝朱由校在位年间。

先后因年久失修及汶川地震而两次重建粉饰。

作为4A级景区红军渡·西武当山风景区的三景之一，容貌一新的崇霞宝塔在苍溪享有盛名，并于2007年被列为四川省省级文化保护单位。

前往崇霞宝塔的路比较漫长，塔前近乎接天的石阶也令人生畏。

经过近百级石阶的攀登，我们已经大汗淋漓，不过看到眼前的宝塔还是令人震撼。

崇霞宝塔是楼阁式砖塔，外檐逐层内缩，整体呈锥状，着实巍峨挺拔，塔尖直指苍穹，庄严肃穆。

塔座和底层由石料修建，其余塔身每层皆由六棱形砖堆叠而成，工艺巧妙。

塔身雪白，故当地人称之为白塔。

塔内有环梯，顺梯而上，可以看到塔身各层皆开有壁窗。

透过壁窗，凭借塔势，可以观赏宝塔山四周开阔的盛景。

举目四望，苍山翠林，着实令人心旷神怡。

英文翻译 English Translation

Chongxia Pagoda is located on Baota (Pagoda) Mountain, Wenhuan Village, east of Cangxi County town, Guangyuan, standing out alone on the tree-covered mountain top.

Chongxia Pagoda was first built in the 6th year of Tianqi (1626), during the reign of the Carpenter Emperor Zhu Youxiao.

It was twice rebuilt and whitewashed due to long-term disrepair and the Wenchuan earthquake.

As one of the three scenic spots of the 4A-level scenic area Hongjun Ferry · West Wudang Mountain Scenic Area, the refreshed Chongxia Pagoda enjoys great fame in Cangxi, and was listed as a Sichuan Provincial Cultural Protection Unit in 2007.

The road to Chongxia Pagoda is relatively long, and the stone steps in front of the pagoda, almost reaching the sky, are also daunting.

After climbing nearly a hundred stone steps, we were already sweating profusely, but seeing the pagoda before us was still shocking.

Chongxia Pagoda is a pavilion-style brick pagoda; the outer eaves taper inward layer by layer, the whole is conical, truly towering and upright, with the pagoda tip pointing straight at the sky, solemn and dignified.

The pagoda base and bottom layer are built of stone; the rest of the pagoda body, each layer, is stacked with hexagonal bricks, with ingenious craftsmanship.

The pagoda body is snow-white, hence local people call it the White Pagoda.

Inside the pagoda there is a circular staircase; ascending the staircase, one can see that each layer of the pagoda body has wall windows opened.

Through the wall windows, by virtue of the pagoda's position, one can view the broad and magnificent scenery around Baota Mountain.

Looking around, the green mountains and forests are truly refreshing and delightful.
