无量宝塔

White Pagoda in Nanchong
国家级 宋 砖塔
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty宋
地址 Address南充市高坪区嘉陵江畔鹤鸣山
类型 Type砖塔
看点 Highlights: 砖塔 临江而立

中文描述 Description

无量宝塔又名南充白塔，位于南充市高坪区鹤鸣山风景区，嘉陵江大桥东端。

宝塔凭借山势，俯瞰嘉陵江水，气势恢宏，是南充市的重要历史与旅游景观。

无量宝塔始建于北宋建隆年间(960—963年)，明崇祯十四年(1641年)修补，近年也有进一步维修。

此塔为方形十三层楼阁式砖石塔，通高37.1米。

塔基为条石砌筑，塔身为砖砌，每层均以砖叠涩挑出，形成檐口。

塔身每层每面均饰为四柱三间格局，圆柱顶部施斗拱，各间均设有壁龛或窗口。

塔身第一层四面设拱门，但仅有西门可供人出入，内部第一层至十层设有塔心室，第十一层至第十三层皆实心。

游客可沿蹬道登至第四层，远眺南充市景。

塔外表面主要以白色粉刷，柱、枋及斗拱全施土黄色染料，在阳光照耀下尤为鲜艳夺目。

塔身内外仿照木结构，工艺细腻精湛。

白塔虽然历经1000多年风雨和多次地震，至今只有75厘米角度的倾斜，基本保持了原样。

有关专家认为南充白塔是具有唐塔风格的五代至宋初砖构建筑，年代在四川宋塔中最早，体量较大，为四川宋代第一塔，是研究唐塔向宋塔过渡的珍贵遗产。

2006年，无量宝塔被国务院列为全国重点文物保护单位。

英文翻译 English Translation

Wuliang (Boundless) Pagoda, also known as Nanchong White Pagoda, is located in the Heming Mountain Scenic Area, Gaoping District, Nanchong City, at the east end of the Jialing River Bridge.

Relying on the mountain terrain, the pagoda overlooks the Jialing River water, with grand momentum, and is an important historical and tourist landscape of Nanchong City.

Wuliang Pagoda was first built during the Northern Song Jianlong era (960-963), repaired in the 14th year of Chongzhen (1641), Ming, and has undergone further maintenance in recent years.

This pagoda is a square thirteen-story pavilion-style brick-stone pagoda, with a total height of 37.1m.

The pagoda base is built of dressed stones, the pagoda body is brick-built, and each layer is projected out with corbelled bricks to form the eave opening.

Each face of each layer of the pagoda body is decorated in a four-column three-bay pattern; at the top of the cylindrical columns there are bracket sets, and each bay is equipped with a wall niche or window.

The first layer of the pagoda body has arched doors on all four sides, but only the west door is accessible; inside, from the first to the tenth layer there are pagoda chambers, and from the eleventh to the thirteenth layer they are all solid.

Tourists can climb along the stairway to the fourth layer to overlook the Nanchong cityscape.

The outer surface of the pagoda is mainly whitewashed; columns, lintels, and bracket sets are all applied with earth-yellow dye, particularly vivid and eye-catching under the sunlight.

The inside and outside of the pagoda body imitate timber structure, with exquisite and meticulous craftsmanship.

Although the White Pagoda has experienced over 1,000 years of wind and rain and multiple earthquakes, to this day it only has a 75cm tilt, basically maintaining its original appearance.

Relevant experts believe that the Nanchong White Pagoda is a brick structure building from the Five Dynasties to early Song with Tang pagoda style; its age is the earliest among Song pagodas in Sichuan, and its volume is relatively large, making it the No.

1 Song pagoda in Sichuan, a precious heritage for studying the transition from Tang to Song pagodas.

In 2006, Wuliang Pagoda was listed by the State Council as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit.

大通梓潼庙

Zitong Shrine in Datong
省级 清 宗教寺庙
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address南充市嘉陵区大通镇梓潼庙村
类型 Type宗教寺庙
看点 Highlights: 多层木构 内院 穿斗结构

中文描述 Description

梓潼庙位于四川省南充市嘉陵区大通镇梓潼庙村二社，是一座佛道合一的宗教建筑，同时供奉道家文昌君以及佛家观音的佛像。

此庙兴建于清乾隆四十九年(1784年)，后代进行过多次维修，但原始结构保留较为完整，古朴之风令人侧目。

梓潼庙建在一座小山丘之上，占地1205平方米，有建筑面积700平方米，主要由文昌殿、观音殿、佛殿以及左右两侧的厢房组成。

文昌殿面阔三间12米，进深15米，抬梁穿斗混合式梁架，单檐悬山顶，内部采用减柱造。

下金檩上有楷体墨书知南充县邑侯觉斋高先知顺庆府总宪大夫承等字样。

观音殿位于寺庙中央，为三层楼阁式建筑，底层面阔三间9米，进深8米，通高12.15米。

楼内各层有梯道相连，重檐歇山顶，屋面铺小青瓦，檐角高翘。

佛殿规模最大，面阔三间16米，进深13.4米，穿斗式结构，歇山顶。

梓潼庙虽仅有三殿，但殿宇之间布局紧凑，起伏强烈，营造出极为丰富的建筑形态。

虽经近200年风雨，木结构仍保存完好，充分展现了川东北民间建筑传统的活力与丰富性，非常值得寻古探幽的人们前往游览。

英文翻译 English Translation

Zitong Shrine is located in Zitongmiao Village, Datong Town, Jialing District, Nanchong City, Sichuan Province.

It is a religious building integrating Buddhism and Daoism, simultaneously enshrining the Daoist Wenchang Lord and the Buddhist Guanyin statue.

This shrine was built in the 49th year of Qianlong (1784), Qing, and has undergone multiple repairs in later generations, but the original structure is relatively completely preserved, with an ancient style that catches the eye.

Zitong Shrine is built on a small hill, covering 1,205 sq m, with a building area of 700 sq m, mainly composed of the Wenchang Hall, Guanyin Hall, Buddha Hall, and wing rooms on the left and right sides.

The Wenchang Hall is 3 bays wide (12m) and 15m deep, with a mixed post-and-lintel and chuan-dou beam frame, single-eave overhanging gable roof, and internally adopts column-reduction construction.

On the lower gold purlin there are regular-script ink inscriptions such as Knowing Nanchong County Magistrate Juezhai Gao, Knowing Shunqing Prefecture Chief Official Cheng, etc.

The Guanyin Hall is located in the center of the temple, a three-story pavilion-style building; the bottom layer is 3 bays wide (9m), 8m deep, with a total height of 12.15m.

Inside the building, each layer is connected by stairways, with a double-eave xieshan roof, the roof surface paved with small grey tiles, and the eave corners high and upturned.

The Buddha Hall is the largest in scale, 3 bays wide (16m), 13.4m deep, with a chuan-dou structure and xieshan roof.

Although Zitong Shrine has only three halls, the layout between the halls is compact, with strong undulations, creating an extremely rich architectural form.

Although having experienced nearly 200 years of wind and rain, the timber structure is still well preserved, fully demonstrating the vitality and richness of folk architectural traditions in northeastern Sichuan, very worthy of visit by people seeking ancient traces and exploring secluded places.

五台山石塔

Stone Pagoda at Yutai Mountain
国家级 唐 石塔
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty唐
地址 Address阆中市保宁镇沙溪街道滕王阁村
类型 Type石塔
看点 Highlights: 轮廓 雕刻 唐风

中文描述 Description

五台山石塔又名滕王亭子石塔，位于阆中市保宁镇北的五台山山腰，是全国重点文物保护单位。

此塔始建于唐初，系唐高祖李渊第22子滕王李元婴被贬作隆州刺史迁阆中时，游玩此地建亭纪念而得名。

五台山石塔所在地现在已经是一个景点，叫滕王阁风景区，周边景致优美。

五台山石塔为覆钵式喇嘛塔，整个石塔坐北向南，通高8.6米，分为塔基、塔身和塔刹三个部分。

塔基为方形，其上建四瓣梅花状须弥座。

塔身以巨石雕刻而成，呈覆钵状，上大下小，正中向南辟由一龛，内塑佛像坐一尊，但面部风化严重。

塔刹基座是圆形莲盘，其上雕刻有石雕八力士承托刹身，刹身为六角柱形，向上收分，各面均刻有佛像，最顶部是火焰宝珠。

五台山石塔的人物造型、装饰及塔身造型带有明显的唐代特征，是研究佛塔式石构建筑的重要资料。

2006年五台山石塔被列为全国重点文物保护单位。

在汶川5·12地震中，塔巅坠地，2011年经专家修复，新建木亭保护古塔。

英文翻译 English Translation

The Stone Pagoda at Yutai Mountain, also known as the Stone Pagoda of Prince Teng's Pavilion, is located on the mountainside of Yutai Mountain, north of Baoning Town, Langzhong City, and is a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit.

This pagoda was first built in the early Tang; it got its name when Li Yuanying, Prince Teng, the 22nd son of Tang Gaozu Li Yuan, was demoted to be the prefect of Longzhou and moved to Langzhong, and visited this place to build a pavilion for commemoration.

The place where the Stone Pagoda at Yutai Mountain is located is now already a scenic spot, called the Tengwang Pavilion Scenic Area, with beautiful surrounding scenery.

The Stone Pagoda at Yutai Mountain is an overturned-bowl-style Lama pagoda; the entire stone pagoda faces south, with a total height of 8.6m, divided into three parts: pagoda base, pagoda body, and pagoda finial.

The pagoda base is square, on which a four-petal plum-blossom-shaped xumi seat is built.

The pagoda body is carved from a giant stone, in an overturned-bowl shape, large at the top and small at the bottom; in the center facing south there is a niche opened, inside which a seated Buddha statue is molded, but the face is severely weathered.

The base of the pagoda finial is a circular lotus disk, on which are carved eight stone-carved strongmen supporting the finial body; the finial body is hexagonal-column-shaped, tapering upward, with Buddha statues carved on each face, and at the very top is a flame jewel.

The figure modeling, decoration, and pagoda body shape of the Stone Pagoda at Yutai Mountain have obvious Tang dynasty characteristics, and are important materials for studying Buddha-pagoda-style stone structure architecture.

In 2006 the Stone Pagoda at Yutai Mountain was listed as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit.

In the Wenchuan 5·12 earthquake, the top of the pagoda fell to the ground; in 2011 it was restored by experts, and a new wooden pavilion was built to protect the ancient pagoda.

巴巴寺

Baba Mosque
国家级 清 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address南充市阆中市保宁镇
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 清真寺 装饰 墓葬 园林

中文描述 Description

巴巴寺始建于清康熙三十二年(1693年)，后经维修，是一组传统伊斯兰教宗教建筑，占地2.18万平方米，总建筑面积1520平方米。

巴巴是阿拉伯语祖先的译音简化，此地是伊斯兰教嘎德忍耶教派第一位来我国传教的祖师华哲·阿卜董拉希(又称西来上人)的墓地，因此是我国伊斯兰教重要圣地；

每年吸引来自陕西、甘肃、宁夏、四川等地穆斯林前来朝圣。

巴巴寺位于南充市阆中市保宁镇，寺庙坐北朝南，由前门、照壁、牌坊、墓殿、井亭与园林等部分组成。

巴巴寺的前门系木石结构牌坊式建筑。

照壁及内围墙由砖建造，有仿木作斗拱。

牌坊四柱三间三楼，木结构，檐下施如意斗拱。

寺中最为重要的是墓殿，也是阿卜董拉希拱北(墓祠)所在地。

大殿平面呈回字形，面阔、进深各三间11.7米，抬梁式结构，局部采用抹角梁做法，屋顶为三重檐盔式顶，屋面施灰筒瓦，檐下施斗拱。

殿内外均有精美浮雕装饰，伊斯兰风格浓郁。

墓殿东侧为花厅，是一处四合院小花园，遍植名花，景致宜人。

寺庙周边空地也被用作教徒墓地，丧葬习俗遵循伊斯兰教传统。

巴巴寺规模宏大，建筑造型独特，结合了汉地传统建筑与伊斯兰建筑特征，具有极高的文物价值。

作为中国伊斯兰教圣地之一，至今仍发挥着重要的宗教作用。

英文翻译 English Translation

Baba Mosque was first built in the 32nd year of Kangxi (1693), Qing, and later underwent maintenance.

It is a group of traditional Islamic religious buildings, covering 21,800 sq m, with a total building area of 1,520 sq m.

Baba is the transliteration simplification of the Arabic word for ancestor; this place is the tomb of Huajie Abdong Laxi (also called the West-Coming Venerable), the first patriarch of the Islamic Qadiriyya sect who came to China to preach, hence it is an important Islamic holy land in China; every year it attracts Muslims from Shaanxi, Gansu, Ningxia, Sichuan and other places to come on pilgrimage.

Baba Mosque is located in Baoning Town, Langzhong City, Nanchong City; the temple faces south, composed of the front gate, screen wall, archway, tomb hall, well pavilion, and garden, etc.

The front gate of Baba Mosque is a timber-stone structure archway-style building.

The screen wall and inner enclosure wall are built of brick, with imitation-timber bracket sets.

The archway has four columns, three bays, and three stories, of timber structure, with ruyi bracket sets under the eaves.

The most important in the temple is the tomb hall, also the location of Abdong Laxi's gongbei (tomb shrine).

The main hall has a hui (回)-shaped plan, 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep (11.7m each), with a post-and-lintel structure, locally adopting beveled beam construction; the roof is a triple-eave helmet-style roof, the roof surface is applied with grey tubular tiles, and bracket sets are applied under the eaves.

Inside and outside the hall there are exquisite relief decorations, with a strong Islamic style.

East of the tomb hall is the flower hall, a small siheyuan garden, planted with famous flowers everywhere, with pleasant scenery.

The open space around the temple is also used as a believer cemetery, and funeral customs follow Islamic traditions.

Baba Mosque has a grand scale and unique architectural form, combining Han traditional architecture with Islamic architectural features, with extremely high cultural relic value.

As one of the Islamic holy lands in China, it still plays an important religious role to this day.

张桓侯祠

Zhang Huanhou's Shrine
国家级 明—清 祠庙
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address南充市阆中市区
类型 Type祠庙
看点 Highlights: 三国历史 碑帖 张飞墓 古树

中文描述 Description

张桓侯祠，也称汉桓侯祠，是纪念三国名将张飞的祠庙，俗称张飞庙。

因张飞死后，追谥为桓侯，因而得名。

张桓侯祠位于全国历史文化名城四川省阆中市古城区西街，1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。

张桓侯祠始建于唐代，历代均有维修，现存建筑为明清重修。

建筑群坐北向南，四合院布局，占地10余亩，建筑面积约2500平方米，由山门、敌万楼、左右牌坊、大殿、后殿、墓亭等组成。

张桓侯祠主体建筑均沿中轴线布局。

山门建于明代，五开间，悬山顶，檐下施六铺作计心斗拱11朵，两侧各有长9米的琉璃照壁。

跨过山门，立于眼前的是明代所建敌万楼，面阔进深均为三间10米，楼高10余米，抬梁式梁架，重檐歇山式屋顶，上覆琉璃瓦，极为华丽。

穿过敌万楼后30多米的小广场，面阔五间、宽22米的大殿矗立在两米高的石砌台基之上，气势雄伟。

大殿后有廊道与后殿，墓亭相连。

墓亭前两根浮雕云龙石柱工艺精美，栩栩如生。

亭内有《张桓侯神道碑》一通。

亭后即为张飞墓，墓坐北向南，呈椭圆形，东西宽22米，南北长32米，封土堆高8米，冢上古木参天，幽古之情极盛。

祠内还有众多的历代名人碑刻匾联，展现了三国历史文化的深厚积淀。

作为川内最为重要的三国文化遗迹之一，张桓侯祠已经成为四川历史文化传统中具有重要意义的一环。

英文翻译 English Translation

Zhang Huanhou's Shrine, also called Han Huanhou Shrine, is a shrine commemorating Zhang Fei, a famous general of the Three Kingdoms, commonly known as Zhang Fei Temple.

Because after Zhang Fei's death, he was posthumously honored as Huanhou, hence the name.

Zhang Huanhou's Shrine is located on West Street, the ancient city area of Langzhong City, Sichuan Province, a national historical and cultural city, and was listed as the 4th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units in 1996.

Zhang Huanhou's Shrine was first built in Tang dynasty, with maintenance in all dynasties; the existing buildings were rebuilt in Ming-Qing.

The building complex faces south, with a siheyuan layout, covering over 10 mu, with a building area of about 2,500 sq m, composed of the mountain gate, Diwan (Ten-Thousand-Enemy) Tower, left and right archways, main hall, rear hall, tomb pavilion, etc.

The main buildings of Zhang Huanhou's Shrine are all laid out along the central axis.

The mountain gate was built in Ming dynasty, 5 bays wide, with overhanging gable roof, and 11 six-set jiuxin bracket sets under the eaves; on both sides there are each 9m-long glazed screen walls.

Crossing the mountain gate, standing before the eyes is the Diwan Tower built in Ming dynasty, 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep (10m each), the tower is over 10m high, with a post-and-lintel beam frame and double-eave xieshan roof, covered with glazed tiles, extremely gorgeous.

Passing through the small square over 30m behind the Diwan Tower, the main hall, 5 bays wide and 22m wide, stands on a 2m-high stone platform base, with majestic momentum.

Behind the main hall there is a corridor connecting to the rear hall and tomb pavilion.

In front of the tomb pavilion there are two relief cloud-dragon stone columns with exquisite craftsmanship, lifelike.

Inside the pavilion there is one stele of the Spirit Path Stele of Zhang Huanhou.

Behind the pavilion is Zhang Fei's tomb; the tomb faces south, in an oval shape, 22m wide east-west, 32m long north-south, with an 8m-high earth mound; ancient trees tower on the tomb, with an extremely strong ancient and secluded feeling.

Inside the shrine there are also numerous stele carvings, plaques, and couplets by famous people of various dynasties, showing the deep accumulation of Three Kingdoms historical culture.

As one of the most important Three Kingdoms cultural relics in Sichuan, Zhang Huanhou's Shrine has already become a significant link in Sichuan's historical and cultural tradition.

川北道贡院

Chuanbeidao Examination Hall
国家级 清 古代教育建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address南充市阆中市保宁镇学道街中段
类型 Type古代教育建筑
看点 Highlights: 科举制度 合院 考棚

中文描述 Description

阆中川北道贡院位于阆中市保宁镇学道街中段，是清代科举考试中举行乡试的地方，也称阆中贡院四川贡院。

川北道贡院始建于清顺治九年(1652年)，嘉庆二十二年(1817年)川北道黎学锦率众重修，以此地位乡学，宣统二年(1910年)再次进行维修。

现在所能看到的阆中清代考棚为长方形四合院，院中十字形甬道连通四方，临学道街一面是为一长排平房，中间是考生入口，俗称龙门。

从龙门进去，左边是门禁(以前这里叫议察厅)右边是传达室，和它们紧连着的是号舍，也就是考生应试的地方。

号舍每间约10余平方米，分为六格，每格坐一人，仅正南面出入，其他三面均被隔断。

从龙门一直往前走是十字字形廊道，廊道两边设置有木椅供考生休息使用。

廊道末端是殿堂(致公堂)与正厅。

殿堂是临考官办公处，两侧正厅均面阔13米，进深11米，为监临、监试、巡察、同考、执调、执事等考务用房。

乡试时，考官高坐殿中，四周情况可一览无余，建筑格局与考试制度相互应承，是我国古代官方制度性建筑的宝贵案例。

川北道贡院曾先后举行过四次乡试，是目前全国保存最为完好的，能够看到全貌的乡试贡院，对于研究了解古代科举制度有极高的历史价值。

英文翻译 English Translation

The Chuanbeidao Examination Hall in Langzhong is located in the middle section of Xuedao Street, Baoning Town, Langzhong City.

It was the place where provincial examinations (xiangshi) were held in the Qing imperial examination system, also called Langzhong Examination Hall or Sichuan Examination Hall.

The Chuanbeidao Examination Hall was first built in the 9th year of Shunzhi (1652), Qing; in the 22nd year of Jiaqing (1817), Li Xuejin, the Chuanbei Circuit Intendant, led the people to rebuild it, using this place as a township school; in the 2nd year of Xuantong (1910) it underwent maintenance again.

The Langzhong Qing dynasty examination shed that can be seen now is a rectangular siheyuan; in the courtyard, a cross-shaped corridor connects all four directions; the side facing Xuedao Street is a long row of bungalows, in the middle is the examinee entrance, commonly called Dragon Gate.

Entering from the Dragon Gate, on the left is the access control (formerly called the Yicha Hall here) and on the right is the reception room; closely connected to them are the numbered sheds, that is, the places where examinees took the exams.

Each numbered shed is about 10+ sq m, divided into six compartments, each compartment seats one person, with only the south side for entry and exit, and the other three sides all partitioned.

Walking straight ahead from the Dragon Gate is a cross-shaped corridor; on both sides of the corridor there are wooden chairs for examinees to rest.

At the end of the corridor are the hall (Zhigong Hall) and the main hall.

The hall is the office of the chief examiner; the main halls on both sides are each 13m wide and 11m deep, serving as examination affairs rooms for the supervisor, monitor, inspector, co-examiner, coordinator, and attendant, etc.

During the provincial examination, the examiner sits high in the hall, with a clear view of the surroundings; the architectural layout and the examination system correspond to each other, making it a precious case of official institutional architecture in ancient China.

The Chuanbeidao Examination Hall has successively held four provincial examinations, and is currently the best-preserved provincial examination hall in the country where the full picture can be seen, with extremely high historical value for researching and understanding the ancient imperial examination system.

华光楼

Huaguang Tower
省级 清 楼阁
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address南充市阆中市
类型 Type楼阁
看点 Highlights: 跨街楼 标志性 登高远眺

中文描述 Description

阆中华光楼又称古镇江楼，通高36米，是阆中古城楼阁中建造最早，气势最宏伟的，因此又被称作阆苑第一楼。

华光楼坐落在阆中市古城区中，建筑横跨大东街南头，位于上、下华街之间，建筑面积150平方米。

楼阁始建于唐，清道光年间毁于火灾，同治年间重建。

华光楼底层高5米为条石砌筑，中心为横跨街道的拱券，供人车穿行之用。

拱门上至今仍留有当年红四方面军粉刷的宣传标语。

底座之上是三层木结构阁楼，每层均有楼梯可达，楼阁外沿均有廊道，供人们观瞻停歇。

屋面采用绿色琉璃瓦铺就，三重檐，歇山顶，配有大量脊饰，屋角高翘，极为灵动。

华光楼地处古城核心地带，体量高耸轻盈，作为标志性建筑给予古城强烈的可识别性与丰富的空间与形态变化，人们可以登楼一览，古城风景与山光水色尽收眼底，是古城游览的必去之处。

自古以来这里就是城中最具人气的地方，金玉麟《夜登华楼》诗写道：春城天不夜，人语市如潮。

就是描写华光楼附近的繁华景象。

英文翻译 English Translation

Langzhong Huaguang Tower, also called Ancient Zhenjiang Tower, has a total height of 36m.

It is the earliest built and most grandly imposing among the pavilions and towers in the ancient city of Langzhong, hence it is also called the First Tower of Langyuan.

Huaguang Tower is located in the ancient city area of Langzhong City; the building spans the south end of Dadong Street, situated between Upper and Lower Hua Streets, with a building area of 150 sq m.

The pavilion was first built in Tang, destroyed by fire during the Qing Daoguang era, and rebuilt during the Tongzhi era.

The bottom layer of Huaguang Tower is 5m high, built of dressed stones; in the center is an arch spanning the street, for the passage of people and vehicles.

On the arch there still remain the propaganda slogans whitewashed by the Red Fourth Front Army in those days.

Above the base is a three-story timber-structure attic; each layer has stairs accessible, and the outer edge of the attic has corridors for people to view and rest.

The roof surface is paved with green glazed tiles, with triple eaves and xieshan roof, equipped with numerous ridge ornaments, and the roof corners are high and upturned, extremely agile.

Huaguang Tower is located in the core area of the ancient city, with a tall and light volume; as a landmark building, it gives the ancient city strong recognizability and rich spatial and morphological changes.

People can climb the tower for a panoramic view, taking in the ancient city scenery and mountain light and water color at a glance; it is a must-visit place for ancient city tours.

Since ancient times this has been the most popular place in the city; Jin Yulin's poem Climbing Huaguang Tower at Night writes: The spring city has no night, human voices and markets are like the tide.

This describes the bustling scene near Huaguang Tower.

文笔塔

Wenbi Pagoda
国家级 明 石塔
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address南充市阆中市
类型 Type石塔
看点 Highlights: 形态 修复 风水

中文描述 Description

阆中文笔塔，又名阆中白塔，坐落在号称天下第一江山——四川阆中市城东嘉陵江外侧的白塔山上。

此塔建于明代末期，是一座八边密檐十三层砖石塔，通高29米。

塔身以白色粉刷，在郁郁葱葱的山丘之上极为醒目。

文笔塔是一座风水塔，借着山势巍然耸立，意在震慑嘉陵江水。

而也正是蜿蜒回转的嘉陵江培育了阆中古城的人文历史与大量古建筑遗迹。

在2008年5月12日发生的汶川大地震中，阆中受到波及，白塔六层以上均坍塌，经认真修复，2009年已经恢复如前，重新成为阆中城的标志性建筑，继续守护着一方水土。

英文翻译 English Translation

Langzhong Wenbi (Writing Brush) Pagoda, also known as Langzhong White Pagoda, is located on White Pagoda Mountain, outside the Jialing River east of Langzhong City, Sichuan, known as the No.

1 River and Mountain Under Heaven.

This pagoda was built in the late Ming dynasty; it is an octagonal dense-eave thirteen-story brick-stone pagoda, with a total height of 29m.

The pagoda body is whitewashed, extremely eye-catching above the lush green hills.

Wenbi Pagoda is a fengshui pagoda, standing majestically by virtue of the mountain terrain, intended to subdue the Jialing River water.

And it is precisely the winding and turning Jialing River that cultivated the humanistic history and numerous ancient architectural relics of the ancient city of Langzhong.

In the Wenchuan earthquake that occurred on May 12, 2008, Langzhong was affected; above the sixth story of the White Pagoda all collapsed; after careful restoration, in 2009 it had been restored as before, once again becoming the landmark building of Langzhong City, continuing to guard this land and water.

五龙庙文昌阁

Wulong Shrine and Wenchang pavilion
国家级 元 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty元
地址 Address阆中市思依镇河楼乡白虎村
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 元代遗构 斗拱 比例

中文描述 Description

五龙庙文昌阁，位于阆中河楼乡白虎村五龙山麓。

寺庙始建于唐代，元至正三年(1343年)重修。

原有山门、戏楼、文昌阁、左右厢房等设施，现仅存文昌阁，所以并没有被列为景点，前往的人很少。

文昌阁坐北向南，面阔及进深均为三间10米，高7米，抬梁式梁架，单檐歇山顶，顶覆筒瓦。

大殿结构宋元特征强烈，檐柱侧脚明显，前檐下施六铺作斗拱5朵，第一跳瓜子拱作翼形拱，第二跳华拱左右出斜拱。

后檐及山墙面施四铺作斗拱9朵。

斗拱用料粗大，形制完整，面貌古朴。

殿内采用减柱造，为元代木结构的特征。

文昌阁规模虽不大，但较好保存了元代遗构，即使在四川全省境内也并不多见，具备极高的历史价值。

2001年6月，被国务院列为全国重点文物保护单位。

英文翻译 English Translation

Wulong Shrine Wenchang Pavilion is located at the foot of Wulong Mountain, Baihu Village, Helou Township, Siyi Town, Langzhong.

The temple was first built in Tang dynasty, and rebuilt in the 3rd year of Zhizheng (1343), Yuan.

Originally it had facilities such as the mountain gate, theater tower, Wenchang Pavilion, and left and right wing rooms; currently only the Wenchang Pavilion survives, hence it has not been listed as a scenic spot, and few people visit.

Wenchang Pavilion faces south, 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep (10m each), 7m high, with a post-and-lintel beam frame, single-eave xieshan roof, and the roof covered with tubular tiles.

The main hall structure has strong Song-Yuan characteristics; the eave columns have obvious lateral inclination; under the front eave there are 5 six-set bracket sets, with the first-tiao guazi bracket as a wing-shaped bracket, and the second-tiao hua bracket emitting diagonal brackets left and right.

The rear eave and gable wall surfaces have 9 four-set bracket sets.

The bracket sets use thick and large materials, with complete form and ancient appearance.

Inside the hall, column-reduction construction is adopted, a characteristic of Yuan dynasty timber structure.

Although the scale of Wenchang Pavilion is not large, it relatively well preserves Yuan dynasty surviving structure, which is rare even within the entire Sichuan Province, with extremely high historical value.

In June 2001, it was listed by the State Council as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit.

圆觉寺

Yuanjue Temple
省级 明 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address南充市阆中市彭城镇圆觉寺村
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 大殿 结构 壁画

中文描述 Description

圆觉寺坐落在嘉陵江畔彭城镇圆觉村，青山相拥，距阆中城约15公里。

圆觉寺又名显法寺，建于唐代，是李淳风为唐太宗镇压西南王气而修建，后损毁。

明洪武七年(1374年)重建，成时赐名法显寺，清乾隆年间又有扩建，是四川省级重点文物保护单位。

圆觉寺原有山门、藏经楼、中殿、厢房、禅房等建筑，构成了圆觉十八殿，凤凰生九庵、站立凤凰头、望到南部县的胜景。

但现在仅存大殿和禅房。

殿坐西向东，面阔五间23.3米，进深四间15.8米，高13米，抬梁式梁架，重檐歇山顶，上覆灰色筒瓦。

檐下遍施斗拱，上檐施六铺作斗拱50朵，下檐施六铺作斗拱32朵，并出斜拱。

圆觉寺过去规模宏大，历代文人墨客留下了许多墨宝，在现在还能在圆觉寺的大殿的右侧看到多幅古代画师用矿物质颜料所作的壁画，虽然很多壁画已经残缺不全，但是从这些残余中，还是能感受到历代画师高超的技艺，细微的线条勾勒出栩栩如生的人物、山水、花草。

英文翻译 English Translation

Yuanjue Temple is located in Yuanjue Village, Pengcheng Town, on the banks of the Jialing River, embraced by green mountains, about 15km from Langzhong city.

Yuanjue Temple, also known as Xianfa Temple, was built in Tang dynasty; it was built by Li Chunfeng for Tang Taizong to suppress the southwest king qi (aura), and was later damaged.

It was rebuilt in the 7th year of Hongwu (1374), Ming, and upon completion was bestowed the name Faxian Temple; during the Qing Qianlong era it was further expanded, and is a Sichuan Provincial Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit.

Yuanjue Temple originally had buildings such as the mountain gate, Scripture Library, middle hall, wing rooms, and meditation rooms, constituting the scenery of Eighteen Halls of Yuanjue, Phoenix Giving Birth to Nine Nunneries, Standing at the Phoenix Head, Seeing Southern County.

But now only the main hall and meditation rooms survive.

The hall faces east, 5 bays wide (23.3m), 4 bays deep (15.8m), 13m high, with a post-and-lintel beam frame, double-eave xieshan roof, covered with grey tubular tiles.

Bracket sets are applied everywhere under the eaves; the upper eave has 50 six-set bracket sets, and the lower eave has 32 six-set bracket sets, with diagonal brackets emitted.

Yuanjue Temple had a grand scale in the past; literati and scholars of various dynasties left many calligraphic treasures.

Even now, on the right side of the main hall of Yuanjue Temple, one can see multiple murals made by ancient painters with mineral pigments.

Although many murals are already incomplete, from these remnants one can still feel the superb skills of painters of various dynasties; fine lines outline lifelike figures, landscapes, flowers, and plants.

永安寺

Yong'an Temple
国家级 元—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty元—清
地址 Address阆中市水观镇永安寺村
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 元代木构 壁画 院落

中文描述 Description

永安寺位于水观镇东北5公里群山环抱的黄泥岗上，距阆中城约40公里。

寺庙始建于唐代，宋治平年间(1064—1067年)维修，元至顺四年(1333年)重建，明洪武年间(1368—1398年)嘉靖年间(1522—1566年)维修，是国家级文物保护单位。

永安寺坐北向南，由三进四合院组成，主要建筑由山门、观音殿、大殿及左右厢房组成，占地面积约1.3万平方米，建筑面积1700平方米。

其中大殿建于元顺四年(1333年)，山门、观音殿及左右厢房均为清代重建。

永安寺大殿面阔三间14米，进深三间14米，高11.7米，歇山顶，抬梁式梁架。

前檐下施六铺作斗拱6朵，山墙面檐柱柱头施五铺作斗拱2朵，经考证，部分为元代遗构。

殿内采用减柱造，柱梁用材粗大，结构组合方式相对自由，体现了管式手法与民间传统的相互融合。

大殿墙壁上原绘有壁画彩绘天龙八部图，并有元至正戊子的题记。

虽已损毁，但从早期拍摄的照片上可以看到壁画线条明晰，形象生动，技法高超，是元代壁画珍品，历史与艺术价值极高。

近年来有关部门又将壁画临摹复制与修整的墙面上，使大殿重复辉煌。

因此极高的建筑与艺术价值，2001年永安寺被列入全国重点文物保护单位名录。

英文翻译 English Translation

Yong'an Temple is located on Huangni Ridge, surrounded by mountains, 5km northeast of Shuiguan Town, about 40km from Langzhong city.

The temple was first built in Tang dynasty, maintained during the Song Zhiping era (1064-1067), rebuilt in the 4th year of Zhishun (1333), Yuan, and maintained during the Ming Hongwu era (1368-1398) and Jiajing era (1522-1566); it is a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit.

Yong'an Temple faces south, composed of three siheyuan courtyards; the main buildings consist of the mountain gate, Guanyin Hall, main hall, and left and right wing rooms, covering about 13,000 sq m, with a building area of 1,700 sq m.

Among them, the main hall was built in the 4th year of Zhishun (1333), Yuan; the mountain gate, Guanyin Hall, and left and right wing rooms were all rebuilt in Qing.

The main hall of Yong'an Temple is 3 bays wide (14m), 3 bays deep (14m), 11.7m high, with xieshan roof and post-and-lintel beam frame.

Under the front eave there are 6 six-set bracket sets; on the eave column capitals of the gable wall surface there are 2 five-set bracket sets; after research, part of them are Yuan dynasty surviving structures.

Inside the hall, column-reduction construction is adopted; the columns and beams use thick and large materials, and the structural combination method is relatively free, reflecting the mutual integration of tubular techniques and folk traditions.

On the walls of the main hall there were originally painted murals of the Color Painting of the Eight Legions of Heavenly Dragons, with an inscription of Yuan Zhizheng Wuzi.

Although already damaged, from early photographs one can see that the murals have clear lines, vivid images, and superb techniques; they are Yuan dynasty mural treasures, with extremely high historical and artistic value.

In recent years, relevant departments have copied and reproduced the murals on the restored wall surfaces, making the main hall regain its brilliance.

Due to its extremely high architectural and artistic value, in 2001 Yong'an Temple was included in the list of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units.

天宫院

Tiangong Hall
省级 明—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address南充市阆中市天宫乡
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 风水 天文历法 明代建筑

中文描述 Description

天宫院位于四川省阆中市南20里处的天宫乡。

唐代时，因阆中风水奇佳，天文学家袁天罡、李淳风先后来此观测天象，晚年均定居阆中西河畔，继续测地观天、著书立说。

他们去世后分别葬于观稼山和五里台，乡人为纪念两位古代天文历算学家在此建天宫院，现为省级文物保护单位。

天宫院是一座两进四合院建筑群，原有山门、亭子楼、大雄宝殿及后殿等建筑，现仅存大雄宝殿及后殿。

大雄宝殿建于明天顺三年(1459年)，五间19.4米，进深三间9.4米，高8.7米，重檐歇山顶，穿斗式梁架，顶覆青瓦。

大殿较为完整地展现了明代大木构特征，但也存在根据民间建筑传统所做的修整。

后殿(观音殿)为清雍正七年(1729年)重建，面阔五间14.5米，进深三间5.5米，高7米，悬山顶，抬梁穿斗式混合结构。

因为袁天罡、李淳风在我国地理与天文发展史上的特殊地位，再加上天宫乡独特的风水优势，使得天宫院成为了解我国传统风水文化与天文历法知识体系的重要场所。

英文翻译 English Translation

Tiangong (Heavenly Palace) Hall is located in Tiangong Township, 20 li south of Langzhong City, Sichuan Province.

In Tang dynasty, because Langzhong had excellent fengshui, astronomers Yuan Tiangang and Li Chunfeng successively came here to observe celestial phenomena; in their later years they both settled by the Xi River in Langzhong, continuing to measure the earth, observe the sky, and write books.

After their deaths, they were respectively buried on Guanjia Mountain and Wulitai; villagers built Tiangong Hall here to commemorate the two ancient astronomical and calendrical scholars, and it is now a provincial cultural relic protection unit.

Tiangong Hall is a two-courtyard siheyuan building complex; originally it had buildings such as the mountain gate, pavilion tower, Mahavira Hall, and rear hall; currently only the Mahavira Hall and rear hall survive.

The Mahavira Hall was built in the 3rd year of Tianshun (1459), Ming; it is 5 bays wide (19.4m), 3 bays deep (9.4m), 8.7m high, with double-eave xieshan roof, chuan-dou beam frame, and roof covered with grey tiles.

The main hall relatively completely shows the characteristics of Ming dynasty large timber structure, but there also exist renovations made according to folk architectural traditions.

The rear hall (Guanyin Hall) was rebuilt in the 7th year of Yongzheng (1729), Qing; it is 5 bays wide (14.5m), 3 bays deep (5.5m), 7m high, with overhanging gable roof and mixed post-and-lintel and chuan-dou structure.

Because of Yuan Tiangang and Li Chunfeng's special position in the history of China's geographical and astronomical development, plus the unique fengshui advantage of Tiangong Township, Tiangong Hall has become an important place for understanding China's traditional fengshui culture and the knowledge system of astronomy and calendrics.

丁氏庄园

Ding's Mansion
国家级 清 四合院
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address南充市仪陇县马鞍镇琳琅村
类型 Type四合院
看点 Highlights: 客家文化 天井 防御

中文描述 Description

丁氏庄园位于南充市仪陇县马鞍镇琳琅村，民间俗称丁家大院丁家花园，它是清末民初当地首富客家人后裔丁邱南、丁邱毓、丁邱玉、丁邱珍四兄弟主持修建的一座家族庄园。

丁氏庄园坐北朝南，占地面积达5800平方米，建筑面积为5400平方米，共有大小房间108间。

庄园规模宏大，集居住与防卫为一体，在民国时期号称川北第一庄，是川北地区客家建筑文化的代表性案例。

丁氏庄园属于多重四合院布局，开有东西两个院门。

建筑群核心是一个大四合院，面积达437平方米。

正房位于大院南北，均为悬山顶，穿斗式梁架。

其中背面正房面阔五间25.7米，其中明间为上堂屋；

南面，正房面阔五间25.7米，其中明间为下堂屋。

大院东西两侧还各有一个小院，院中有水池，一座石桥跨池而过，十分独特。

小天井之前、后分别为恒堂屋及退堂屋。

除了住宅功能外，庄园也非常重视防御性，大院东北角设有碉楼堡，面阔三间18.7米，进深二间12米，高14.5米，四面均设有枪眼，便于防御入口。

庄园四周采用封闭而坚固的墙面，展现典型的客家聚居性建筑特征。

英文翻译 English Translation

Ding's Mansion is located in Linlang Village, Maan Town, Yilong County, Nanchong City.

Commonly known among the people as the Ding Family Great Courtyard or Ding Family Garden, it is a family mansion presided over and built by the four brothers Ding Qiunan, Ding Qiuyu, Ding Qiuyu, and Ding Qiuzhen, descendants of the local wealthiest Hakka people, in the late Qing and early Republican period.

Ding's Mansion faces south, covering an area of 5,800 sq m, with a building area of 5,400 sq m, and a total of 108 rooms large and small.

The mansion has a grand scale, integrating residence and defense; during the Republican period it was known as the No.

1 Mansion in Northern Sichuan, and is a representative case of Hakka architectural culture in the northern Sichuan region.

Ding's Mansion belongs to a multiple siheyuan layout, with east and west courtyard gates opened.

The core of the building complex is a large siheyuan, with an area of 437 sq m.

The main houses are located in the north and south of the great courtyard, both with overhanging gable roofs and chuan-dou beam frames.

Among them, the back main house is 5 bays wide (25.7m), with the central bay as the upper main hall; on the south side, the main house is 5 bays wide (25.7m), with the central bay as the lower main hall.

On the east and west sides of the great courtyard there is also a small courtyard each; in the courtyard there is a pool, and a stone bridge crosses over the pool, very unique.

Before and after the small courtyard are respectively the Heng main hall and the Tui main hall.

Besides residential function, the mansion also attaches great importance to defensiveness; at the northeast corner of the great courtyard there is a watchtower fort, 3 bays wide (18.7m), 2 bays deep (12m), 14.5m high, with gun holes on all four sides, convenient for defending the entrance.

Around the mansion, closed and solid walls are adopted, showing typical Hakka communal-living architectural characteristics.

观音庵

Guanyin Nunnery
省级 明 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address南充市南部县平桥乡谢家楼村
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 明代遗构 斗拱 用材

中文描述 Description

观音庵位于南充市南部县平桥乡谢家楼村，交通特别不方便，没有直达的车，并且只有乡间小道，大型的车辆很难通过。

观音庵始建年代不详，但建筑形制与该县其他明代建筑相近，推断为始建于建于明代。

庵中原有前、中、后殿及戏台，现仅存中殿，推测始建于明，清同治五年(1866年)维修。

中殿面阔三间12.14米，进深11.05米，高8.55米，歇山顶，抬梁式梁架，檐下施六铺作斗拱16朵，并出斜拱。

整个木结构保存状况良好，用材硕大，柱础、柱侧角、以及斗拱构造都体现出明代建筑的特征。

或许是居于偏远乡村，使得中殿近400年来未受大的损伤，实为幸事，是川东北地区并不多见的明代建筑范例。

英文翻译 English Translation

Guanyin Nunnery is located in Xiejialou Village, Pingqiao Township, Nanbu County, Nanchong City.

Transportation is particularly inconvenient; there is no direct bus, and there are only country paths, making it difficult for large vehicles to pass.

The founding date of Guanyin Nunnery is unknown, but its architectural form is similar to other Ming dynasty buildings in the county, so it is inferred to have been first built in Ming dynasty.

The nunnery originally had front, middle, and rear halls and a theater tower; currently only the middle hall survives, inferred to have been first built in Ming and maintained in the 5th year of Tongzhi (1866), Qing.

The middle hall is 3 bays wide (12.14m), 11.05m deep, 8.55m high, with xieshan roof and post-and-lintel beam frame; under the eaves there are 16 six-set bracket sets, with diagonal brackets emitted.

The entire timber structure is in good preservation condition, with large materials; the column bases, column lateral inclination, and bracket set construction all reflect the characteristics of Ming dynasty architecture.

Perhaps because it is located in a remote countryside, the middle hall has not suffered major damage in the past 400 years — truly a fortunate thing, and a rare example of Ming dynasty architecture in the northeastern Sichuan region.

西充文庙

Temple of Confucius in Xichong
省级 明—清 文庙建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address南充市西充县晋城镇莲花湖
类型 Type文庙建筑
看点 Highlights: 儒学 形制 院落

中文描述 Description

西充文庙位于南充市西充县晋城镇莲花湖，虽然地处闹市，但是它依然保留着古老的历史古韵。

西充文庙始建于南宋淳祐年间(1241—1252年)，明弘治十五年(1502年)重建，清代多次修缮。

2002年原拆原建搬迁至莲花湖北岸址。

在川北各地的文庙中，西充文庙规模最大，保存也最为完整。

文庙现坐北朝南，两进四合院结构，主要建筑沿中轴布置，由南至北依次建有：棂星门、泮池、大成门、大成殿等建筑。

棂星门四柱三间，宽9米，明间刻楷书棂星门三字，次间分别刻有金声玉振四字。

大成门面阔三间13.7米，进深二间4.96米，通高7.11米，穿斗式梁架，悬山顶。

大成殿规模最为宏大，面阔三间15.04米，进深12.31米，通高11.30米，抬梁式结构，重檐歇山顶，檐下施五彩斗拱。

殿内梁架上有弘治拾伍年壬戌拾冬月望日望日重建立，以及一笔文明新气象，千年朱四旧规模等墨书题记。

西充文庙布局严谨，建筑精巧别致，院内绿树成荫，环境优美，是四川地区重要的文庙建筑遗存，现为省级文物保护单位。

英文翻译 English Translation

The Temple of Confucius in Xichong is located at Lianhua Lake, Jincheng Town, Xichong County, Nanchong City.

Although located in a busy downtown area, it still retains the ancient historical charm.

The Temple of Confucius in Xichong was first built during the Southern Song Chunyou era (1241-1252), rebuilt in the 15th year of Hongzhi (1502), Ming, and repaired multiple times in Qing.

In 2002 it was dismantled and rebuilt in situ, relocated to the north bank of Lianhua Lake.

Among the Confucian temples in various places in northern Sichuan, the Temple of Confucius in Xichong has the largest scale and is the most completely preserved.

The temple currently faces south, with a two-courtyard siheyuan structure; the main buildings are arranged along the central axis, built sequentially from south to north: the Lingxing Gate, Pan Pool, Dacheng Gate, Dacheng Hall, etc.

The Lingxing Gate has four columns and three bays, 9m wide; the central bay is engraved with the three regular-script characters Lingxing Gate, and the secondary bays are respectively engraved with the four characters Jinsheng Yuzhen (Golden Sound and Jade Vibration).

The Dacheng Gate is 3 bays wide (13.7m), 2 bays deep (4.96m), with a total height of 7.11m, chuan-dou beam frame, overhanging gable roof.

The Dacheng Hall has the grandest scale, 3 bays wide (15.04m), 12.31m deep, with a total height of 11.30m, post-and-lintel structure, double-eave xieshan roof, with five-color bracket sets under the eaves.

On the beam frame inside the hall there are ink inscriptions such as Rebuilt and Erected on the 15th Day of the 10th Lunar Month in the Renxu Year, the 15th Year of Hongzhi, as well as A Stroke of Civilization Brings New Atmosphere, A Thousand Years of Zhu Si Retains Old Scale, etc.

The Temple of Confucius in Xichong has a rigorous layout, with exquisite and unique buildings; inside the courtyard green trees form shade, with a beautiful environment.

It is an important surviving Confucian temple building in the Sichuan region, and is currently a provincial cultural relic protection unit.

百福寺

Baifu Temple
省级 明 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address南充市西充县仁和镇百福寺村
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 牌匾 明代木构 古柏

中文描述 Description

百福寺位于南充市西充县仁和镇百福寺村岁堂山上。

寺庙始建于隋，古称百福禅关，是古代西充八景之一。

古寺后毁于兵火，明永乐三年(1405年)重建。

百福寺坐北朝南，为合院布局，现存山门、正殿与右禅房。

山门为木结构牌楼式建筑，前檐面阔五间，后檐面阔三间14.36米，进深五间8.96米，通高8.10米。

前檐明间悬挂隋代进士程太虚题写的自天降康匾额一道，后檐在过道至上架设戏楼(万年台)，结构独特。

正殿面阔三间14.00米，进深四间14.33米，通高8.83米，抬梁式梁架，单檐歇山顶，檐下施斗拱，均为五铺作计心造。

殿内采用移柱造，殿内中柱向外移1.03米，结构复杂。

正殿梁架斗拱均保存完好，古朴敦厚，体现出明代早期木构建筑特征。

寺庙周边有几百年树龄古柏数十棵，郁郁葱葱，是人们寻古探幽的绝佳去处。

英文翻译 English Translation

Baifu Temple is located on Suitang Mountain, Baifusi Village, Renhe Town, Xichong County, Nanchong City.

The temple was first built in Sui dynasty, anciently called Baifu Chan Pass, one of the Eight Scenes of ancient Xichong.

The ancient temple was later destroyed by war and fire, and rebuilt in the 3rd year of Yongle (1405), Ming.

Baifu Temple faces south, with a courtyard layout; currently surviving are the mountain gate, main hall, and right meditation room.

The mountain gate is a timber-structure archway-style building; the front eave is 5 bays wide, the rear eave is 3 bays wide (14.36m), 5 bays deep (8.96m), with a total height of 8.10m.

On the front eave central bay there hangs one plaque of Health Descends from Heaven inscribed by Sui dynasty jinshi Cheng Taixu; on the rear eave, a theater tower (Wannian Platform) is erected from the passageway upward, with a unique structure.

The main hall is 3 bays wide (14.00m), 4 bays deep (14.33m), with a total height of 8.83m, post-and-lintel beam frame, single-eave xieshan roof, with bracket sets under the eaves, all of five-set jiuxin construction.

Inside the hall, column-shifting construction is adopted; the central columns inside the hall are shifted outward by 1.03m, with a complex structure.

The beam frame and bracket sets of the main hall are all well preserved, simple and honest, reflecting the characteristics of early Ming dynasty timber structure architecture.

Around the temple there are dozens of ancient cypresses several hundred years old, lush and green, an excellent place for people to seek ancient traces and explore secluded places.

圭心寺

Guixin Temple
省级 明—清 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address南充市西充县双凤镇圭心寺村
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 明代大殿 古树

中文描述 Description

圭心寺，又称圭心禅院，位于四川省西充县双凤镇圭心寺村。

寺庙始建于唐朝初年，是佛教华严宗五祖圭峰禅师曾经修行的道场。

历史上古刹几经损毁，明洪武八年(1375年)重建，清雍正二年(1724年)与清乾隆六十年(1795年)进一步重修，始成当下规模。

圭心寺坐北向南，合院布局，占地10,000平方米，建筑面积3,000平方米，主体建筑包括前殿、正殿与禅房，其中正殿为明代建筑，其余为清代修建。

前殿(天王殿)面阔五间20.4米，进深三间8.6米，高6.8米，悬山顶，穿斗式梁架。

正殿面阔三间10.85米、进深五间10.85米，高8.01米，抬梁式梁架，单檐歇山顶。

檐下施斗拱，前檐为五铺作计心造，角柱上施转角铺作。

圭心寺院内现存一棵千年古榕，直径两米而枝叶繁茂，庇荫数百平方米，甚为壮观。

当地民间留下诸多与古寺古榕有关的传说，为古寺增加了更多传奇色彩。

英文翻译 English Translation

Guixin Temple, also called Guixin Chan Courtyard, is located in Guixinsi Village, Shuangfeng Town, Xichong County, Sichuan Province.

The temple was first built in the early Tang dynasty, and was the practice place where Guifeng Chan Master, the 5th patriarch of the Buddhist Huayan sect, once practiced.

Historically the ancient temple was damaged and restored several times; rebuilt in the 8th year of Hongwu (1375), Ming, and further rebuilt in the 2nd year of Yongzheng (1724) and the 60th year of Qianlong (1795), Qing, finally reaching its current scale.

Guixin Temple faces south, with a courtyard layout, covering 10,000 sq m, with a building area of 3,000 sq m; the main buildings include the front hall, main hall, and meditation rooms, among which the main hall is a Ming dynasty building, and the rest were built in Qing.

The front hall (Heavenly Kings Hall) is 5 bays wide (20.4m), 3 bays deep (8.6m), 6.8m high, with overhanging gable roof and chuan-dou beam frame.

The main hall is 3 bays wide (10.85m), 5 bays deep (10.85m), 8.01m high, with post-and-lintel beam frame and single-eave xieshan roof.

Bracket sets are applied under the eaves; the front eave is of five-set jiuxin construction, and corner bracket sets are applied on the corner columns.

In the courtyard of Guixin Temple there currently survives a thousand-year-old ancient banyan, with a diameter of two meters and lush branches and leaves, shading several hundred square meters, very spectacular.

Local folklore has left many legends related to the ancient temple and ancient banyan, adding more legendary color to the ancient temple.

西充占山寺

Zhanshan Temple in Xichong
省级 明 宗教建筑
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address南充市西充县占山乡
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 明代木构 题记 彩绘

中文描述 Description

占山寺位于西充县占山乡，始建于唐，元代维修，明代重建。

寺庙原为合院布局，占地约630平方米，现有建筑仅存正殿，为明代建造。

正殿面阔五间19.4米，进深五间14.35米，高7.2米，穿斗抬梁混合式梁架，歇山顶。

正殿虽未施斗拱，更多采用民间建筑做法，但结构用材粗大，梁柱均极为粗壮，古朴敦厚，气韵十足。

现殿内梁架上仍然留有明清时期彩绘卷草纹图案，以及明初先辈建立墨书题记，非常珍贵。

英文翻译 English Translation

Zhanshan Temple is located in Zhanshan Township, Xichong County.

It was first built in Tang, maintained in Yuan, and rebuilt in Ming.

The temple originally had a courtyard layout, covering about 630 sq m; the existing buildings only have the main hall surviving, built in Ming dynasty.

The main hall is 5 bays wide (19.4m), 5 bays deep (14.35m), 7.2m high, with a mixed chuan-dou and post-and-lintel beam frame and xieshan roof.

Although the main hall does not apply bracket sets and more adopts folk architectural methods, the structural materials are thick and large, with both beams and columns extremely sturdy, simple and honest, full of charm.

Currently on the beam frame inside the hall there still remain colored painting scroll-grass patterns from the Ming-Qing period, as well as an ink inscription of Established by Ancestors in Early Ming, very precious.

中心镇古建筑群

Ancient Building Complex in Zhongxin Town
省级 明—清 建筑群
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty明—清
地址 Address广安市武胜县中心镇
类型 Type建筑群
看点 Highlights: 明清建筑群 遗迹

中文描述 Description

中心古建筑群位于广安武胜县中心镇，整体坐落在嘉陵江右岸的台地之上。

此处古为定远县治所在地，后于20世纪50年代因交通不甚方便而迁徙至沿口镇。

400余年的历史沧桑，在中心镇留下了丰富的文化遗迹，中心古建筑群现为四川省级文化保护单位。

中心古建筑群现在存有明城墙、文庙、武庙、城隍庙、万寿宫、传教士故宅等历史建筑遗迹。

其中，城墙始筑于嘉靖时期，墙体由条石叠砌、内施夯土构筑，现存北门、西门、东门三处残段共300余米。

文庙始建于清雍正时期，现仅存大成门与大成殿，均为穿斗叠梁式结构。

武庙、城隍庙与万寿宫皆始建于清朝，虽年久失修，但整体结构仍基本保存完好。

传教士故宅为工艺精良的西式建筑，保存相对完好。

英文翻译 English Translation

The Ancient Building Complex in Zhongxin Town is located in Zhongxin Town, Wusheng County, Guang'an, overall situated on the terrace on the right bank of the Jialing River.

This place was anciently the seat of Dingyuan County, and later in the 1950s, due to inconvenient transportation, it was relocated to Yankou Town.

Over 400 years of historical vicissitudes have left rich cultural relics in Zhongxin Town; the Ancient Building Complex in Zhongxin is now a Sichuan Provincial Cultural Protection Unit.

The Ancient Building Complex in Zhongxin currently has surviving historical building relics such as the Ming city wall, Confucian Temple, Martial Temple, City God Temple, Wanshou Palace, and Missionary's Former Residence.

Among them, the city wall was first built during the Jiajing period; the wall body is constructed by叠砌 dressed stones with rammed earth inside; currently there are three remaining sections at the North Gate, West Gate, and East Gate, totaling over 300m.

The Confucian Temple was first built during the Qing Yongzheng period; currently only the Dacheng Gate and Dacheng Hall survive, both with chuan-dou and叠梁 structure.

The Martial Temple, City God Temple, and Wanshou Palace were all first built in Qing dynasty; although long in disrepair, their overall structures are still basically well preserved.

The Missionary's Former Residence is a Western-style building with exquisite craftsmanship, relatively well preserved.

宝箴塞

Baozhen Fortress
国家级 清—民国 民居
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清—民国
地址 Address广安市武胜县宝箴塞乡方家沟村
类型 Type民居
看点 Highlights: 军事防御 民居

中文描述 Description

宝箴塞位于广安市武胜县宝箴塞乡方家沟村，始建于清宣统年间，为当地富豪段氏家族为防战乱所建，后于民国增修。

依山而筑的宝箴塞集军事防御与生活起居功能于一身，于2006年被国务院列为全国第六批重点文物保护单位，现为国家4A级风景区。

宝箴塞整体由条石构筑而成，呈东西宽阔、中间狭长之态，建筑风格独特，既有闽南团城重于防御的设计，亦有江南民居古韵十足的布局。

塞内建筑规模较大，有四座院落，七个天井，上百间房屋，水井、仓库、戏楼等生活设施一应俱全，令人惊叹。

此外，塞内还有坚固的防御工事，守护者既可在塞墙上防御，也可在城垛上机动作战，加之密密麻麻的射击孔，复杂的地下通道，长达千米的环形炮楼，互相防守的众多小塞，防御网络堪称完美，令人佩服。

院内还用条石砌有一座高耸的碉楼，四周布设枪眼，具有易守难攻的优势，展现出宝箴塞全面的防御设计。

无怪中国古建筑专家组组长罗哲文称赞宝箴塞为全国罕有，蜀中一绝。

英文翻译 English Translation

Baozhen Fortress is located in Fangjiagou Village, Baozhensai Township, Wusheng County, Guang'an City.

It was first built during the Qing Xuantong era, built by the wealthy local Duan family to prevent war and chaos, and later expanded during the Republican period.

Built according to the mountain, Baozhen Fortress integrates military defense and living functions; in 2006 it was listed by the State Council as the 6th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units, and is now a national 4A-level scenic area.

Baozhen Fortress is overall constructed of dressed stones,呈现 a state of broad east-west and narrow middle; its architectural style is unique, with both the Minnan (Southern Fujian)团城 design emphasizing defense, and a layout full of the ancient charm of Jiangnan residences.

The buildings inside the fortress are relatively large in scale, with four courtyards, seven skylights, over a hundred rooms, and living facilities such as wells, warehouses, and theater towers all complete — amazing.

In addition, inside the fortress there are also solid defense works; guardians can both defend on the fortress walls and maneuver on the crenellations; plus the dense shooting holes, complex underground passages, kilometer-long circular watchtowers, and numerous small fortresses defending each other, the defense network can be called perfect, admirable.

Inside the courtyard there is also a tall watchtower built of dressed stones, with gun holes arranged around it, having the advantage of easy defense and difficult attack, showing Baozhen Fortress's comprehensive defense design.

No wonder Luo Zhewen, head of the Chinese Ancient Architecture Expert Group, praised Baozhen Fortress as rare nationwide and a unique wonder in Shu (Sichuan).

褒先寺

Baoxian Temple
省级 清 祠堂
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address广安市华蓥市永兴镇安丙街
类型 Type祠堂
看点 Highlights: 轴线 雕刻

中文描述 Description

褒先寺位于广安市华蓥市永兴镇安丙街，为南宋四川宣抚使安丙的生祠，后毁于明朝战乱，于清朝重修并改建为佛寺，现为省级文物保护单位。

褒先寺坐南朝北，主要有山门，前、正、后殿、左右厢房等建筑，格局较为完整。

山门由青石砌筑，质朴厚重，散发着岁月特有的美感。

寺庙现已人迹罕至，被当成重要文物保护对象而关闭起来，寺内只有一位沧桑的守寺人与他凶猛的狗。

我们进寺很是费了一番功夫。

前殿供奉着一座弥勒佛，陈旧的香案上摆放着些许祭祀的鲜花，佛像上也落满了灰尘，破旧的前殿显得相当寂寥。

前殿与正殿之中是一座清幽的院落，流水、石桥、古树似乎诉说着褒先寺往日的辉煌荣光。

正殿的青瓦屋顶上点缀着众多雕刻精美的瑞兽。

殿内树立着描述安丙辉煌事迹的雕刻，还有众多古朴的佛像，只可惜，佛像的头部大多损毁，据守寺老人介绍，这些佛像大多都是在文革中被砸坏的，着实令人可惜。

褒先寺现正处于重修状态，相信经过保护之后的寺庙，一定能够重复往日光彩。

英文翻译 English Translation

Baoxian Temple is located on Anbing Street, Yongxing Town, Huaying City, Guang'an.

It was the living shrine of An Bing, the Sichuan Xuanfu (Pacification Commissioner) of Southern Song, later destroyed in Ming dynasty war chaos, and rebuilt and converted into a Buddhist temple in Qing dynasty; it is now a provincial cultural relic protection unit.

Baoxian Temple faces north, mainly with buildings such as the mountain gate, front, main, and rear halls, and left and right wing rooms, with a relatively complete layout.

The mountain gate is built of bluestone, simple and heavy, exuding the unique beauty of time.

The temple is now rarely visited, closed as an important cultural relic protection object; inside the temple there is only a weathered temple keeper and his fierce dog.

It took us quite some effort to enter the temple.

The front hall enshrines a Maitreya Buddha; on the old incense table there are placed some sacrificial flowers, and the Buddha statue is also covered with dust; the dilapidated front hall appears quite desolate.

Between the front hall and the main hall is a serene courtyard; flowing water, stone bridge, and ancient trees seem to tell of the past glory and splendor of Baoxian Temple.

On the grey tile roof of the main hall there are dotted numerous exquisitely carved auspicious beasts.

Inside the hall there stand carvings describing An Bing's brilliant deeds, as well as many simple and ancient Buddha statues; unfortunately, most of the heads of the Buddha statues are damaged; according to the temple keeper, most of these Buddha statues were smashed during the Cultural Revolution, truly regrettable.

Baoxian Temple is currently in a state of reconstruction; I believe that after protection, the temple will surely regain its former glory.

广安白塔

Guang'an White Pagoda
国家级 宋 砖石塔
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty宋
地址 Address广安市广安区县城南渠江之畔
类型 Type砖石塔
看点 Highlights: 宋塔 雕刻 高度

中文描述 Description

广安白塔位于广安市广安区县城南渠江之畔，又名舍利宝塔，为褒先寺故主南宋四川宣抚使安丙主持修建，现为全国第七批重点文物保护单位。

白塔坐南朝北，是一座砖石堆砌而成的四方形楼阁式宝塔，底边长近6米，通高33.6米，历经数百年风雨，却仍保存得较为完整。

塔的造型独特，塔底一到五级为条石筑造，六至九级改由方砖垒成，由底层至顶逐层内缩。

广安白塔与其他一般样式的塔不同之处在于塔顶没有宝顶与塔刹，而是以一座砖砌的方室为顶。

方室南北方设有门洞，可从此出到方室四周的走道，进而眺望四周美景，着实匠心独运。

塔南开有拱门，但由于塔身已经破损明显，加之塔基部分坍塌，已成危楼，塔身从底至上五层皆设有券门，上刻石像或用来放置佛像。

六到九级则开有窗洞以便浏览四周风景。

英文翻译 English Translation

Guang'an White Pagoda is located on the banks of the Qu River, south of the county town of Guang'an District, Guang'an City.

Also known as the Relic Stupa, it was presided over and built by An Bing, the former master of Baoxian Temple and the Sichuan Xuanfu Commissioner of Southern Song; it is now the 7th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units.

The White Pagoda faces north, a square pavilion-style pagoda built of bricks and stones, with a bottom side length of nearly 6m and a total height of 33.6m; after hundreds of years of wind and rain, it is still relatively well preserved.

The pagoda has a unique shape; the first to fifth levels of the pagoda base are built of dressed stones, and the sixth to ninth levels are changed to be built of square bricks, tapering inward layer by layer from the bottom to the top.

The difference between Guang'an White Pagoda and other generally styled pagodas is that the pagoda top has no precious top or pagoda finial, but instead takes a brick-built square room as the top.

On the north and south sides of the square room there are door openings, from which one can exit to the walkway around the square room, and then overlook the beautiful scenery around — truly ingenious.

An arched door is opened on the south of the pagoda, but because the pagoda body has obvious damage, plus the partial collapse of the pagoda base, it has become a dangerous building; from the bottom to the fifth level of the pagoda body there are all arched doors, on which stone statues are carved or used to place Buddha statues.

The sixth to ninth levels have window openings opened for viewing the surrounding scenery.

兴国寺

Xingguo Temple
市级 明 宗教建筑
级别 Level市级
年代 Dynasty明
地址 Address广安市广安区滨江大道南段
类型 Type宗教建筑
看点 Highlights: 明代木构 碑文 题记

中文描述 Description

兴国寺位于广安市广安区滨江大道南段，始建于明代，原为众多明代建筑聚集而成的庞大的建筑群，现仅存大殿。

兴国寺大殿建于明代，建筑整体保存得较为完全，格局形式坐南向北，是广安不可多得的较为完整的殿堂建筑。

大殿建筑庄严肃穆，富有典型的明代特色。

屋顶上覆绿色琉璃瓦，碧瓦朱梁，显得精美华贵。

殿内顶饰藻井，显得十分开阔。

大殿由朱红立柱支撑，内供奉着释迦牟尼佛，慈悲庄严。

寺庙内的香火鼎盛，不时有游客往来进行拜祭。

殿内还留有前人墨宝唐朝敬恭州年农年丙子正月初一丙申朔月二十日庚申吉旦兴国寺住持修造及广安千户守御所武德将军正千户亦铭、武略将军副千户吴源史等题记。

在兴国寺大殿的左右还有几座仿古佛寺楼阁，映衬着古殿，焕发兴国寺特有的韵味。

英文翻译 English Translation

Xingguo Temple is located in the southern section of Binjiang Avenue, Guang'an District, Guang'an City.

It was first built in Ming dynasty, originally a large building complex gathered from numerous Ming dynasty buildings; currently only the main hall survives.

The main hall of Xingguo Temple was built in Ming dynasty; the building overall is relatively completely preserved, with a layout facing north, and is a rare relatively complete hall building in Guang'an.

The main hall building is solemn and majestic, rich in typical Ming dynasty characteristics.

The roof is covered with green glazed tiles, with green tiles and vermilion beams, appearing exquisite and luxurious.

Inside the hall the ceiling is decorated with a caisson, appearing very open.

The main hall is supported by vermilion columns, inside which Shakyamuni Buddha is enshrined, compassionate and solemn.

The incense in the temple is flourishing, and from time to time tourists come and go to worship.

Inside the hall there are also left the calligraphic treasures of predecessors: inscriptions such as Built by the Abbot of Xingguo Temple on the Auspicious Day of Gengshen, the 20th Day of the First Lunar Month, Bingzi Year, Nong Year of Jinggong Prefecture, Tang dynasty, and Wude General Zheng Qianhu Yiming, Wulue General Vice Qianhu Wu Yuanshi of the Guang'an Qianhu Garrison, etc.

On the left and right of the main hall of Xingguo Temple there are also several antique Buddhist temple pavilions, setting off the ancient hall and radiating the unique charm of Xingguo Temple.

冲相寺及摩崖造像

Chongxiang Temple and Cliffside Statues
国家级 隋、唐—民国 摩崖造像
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty隋、唐—民国
地址 Address广安市广安区肖溪镇冲相村
类型 Type摩崖造像
看点 Highlights: 造像 游览线路图

中文描述 Description

冲相寺及摩崖造像位于广安市广安区东北部的肖溪镇，坐落于冲相村的定光岩。

冲相寺始建于隋文帝时期，本来的名称为药寺，后于唐易名为冲相，是唐末高僧定光古佛的道场，现为全国第七批重点文物保护单位。

冲相寺现仅存重修过的正殿与右厢房，正殿与右厢房分别重建于康熙年间和民国晚期。

在冲相寺外的定光岩石壁上，分布着隋唐时期开凿的50龛造像，据相关资料介绍，50龛造像之中，有15龛100尊隋代造像，另有35龛300余尊唐代造像。

摩崖造像在巴渝地区的石窟造像之中甚为主流，而冲相寺摩崖造像更是其典型代表。

冲相寺摩崖石刻的内容纷繁复杂，有日常的生产生活，也有诗词歌赋、游人题记等。

在冲相寺的摩崖造像之中，最为著名的当属岩壁上层正中的隋定光佛造像。

定光佛造像高达4米，是国内目前保存最为完整、规模最大的定光佛造像。

此外，冲相寺还保存着唐代遗存的游览线路图，甚是珍贵。

冲相寺现存正殿及右厢房，其中正殿重建于康熙五十七年(1719年)，面阔5间21米，进深6间8米，单檐歇山式屋顶，叠梁式屋架。

厢房为民国晚期所建。

英文翻译 English Translation

Chongxiang Temple and Cliffside Statues are located in Xiaoxi Town, northeast of Guang'an District, Guang'an City, situated on Dingguang Rock in Chongxiang Village.

Chongxiang Temple was first built during the Sui Wendi period; its original name was Yao (Medicine) Temple, later renamed Chongxiang in Tang; it was the practice place of the eminent monk Dingguang Ancient Buddha of late Tang, and is now the 7th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units.

Chongxiang Temple currently only has the rebuilt main hall and right wing room surviving; the main hall and right wing room were respectively rebuilt during the Kangxi era and late Republican period.

On the Dingguang Rock cliff outside Chongxiang Temple, there are distributed 50 niches of statues excavated during the Sui-Tang period; according to relevant materials, among the 50 niches of statues, there are 15 niches with 100 Sui dynasty statues, and another 35 niches with over 300 Tang dynasty statues.

Cliffside statues are very mainstream among the grotto statues in the Bayu (Chongqing) region, and the Chongxiang Temple cliffside statues are even more its typical representative.

The content of the Chongxiang Temple cliffside carvings is numerous and complex, including daily production and life, as well as poetry and songs, tourist inscriptions, etc.

Among the cliffside statues of Chongxiang Temple, the most famous is undoubtedly the Sui Dingguang Buddha statue in the center of the upper layer of the cliff wall.

The Dingguang Buddha statue is up to 4m high, and is currently the most completely preserved and largest-scale Dingguang Buddha statue in China.

In addition, Chongxiang Temple also preserves a Tang dynasty surviving tour route map, very precious.

Chongxiang Temple currently has the main hall and right wing room surviving; among them, the main hall was rebuilt in the 57th year of Kangxi (1719), 5 bays wide (21m), 6 bays deep (8m), with single-eave xieshan roof and叠梁 roof frame.

The wing room was built in the late Republican period.

龙爪塔

Longzhao Pagoda
省级 唐 塔
级别 Level省级
年代 Dynasty唐
地址 Address达州市通川区塔坨广场旁
类型 Type塔
看点 Highlights: 唐代名塔 远眺

中文描述 Description

龙爪塔坐落于四川省达州市通川区塔坨广场旁的玉印山上，该塔建于唐朝年间，清代经历两次大规模修整。

龙爪塔高30米，占地57.4平方米，塔身九级八面，呈八角锥形，通体由素白的塔身和黑亮的屋檐交替而成，敦实古朴，矗立在郁郁葱葱的玉印山上显得格外醒目。

砖石结构的龙爪塔内有盘旋的栏道，塔底端坐的佛像和塔顶直立的观音像都可供游客参拜。

龙爪塔临江而建，高居山顶，景观独特，历代诗人对此留下不少赞颂的名句。

从龙爪塔顶向四周眺望，能够看到州河、州河大桥，达州城景等重要景观，气象万千，而白塔本身也成为达州城的标志性建筑之一。

英文翻译 English Translation

Longzhao (Dragon-Claw) Pagoda is located on Yuyin Mountain, beside Tatuo Square, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province.

This pagoda was built during the Tang dynasty, and underwent two large-scale renovations in Qing dynasty.

Longzhao Pagoda is 30m high, covering 57.4 sq m; the pagoda body has nine levels and eight sides, in an octagonal conical shape; the whole body is formed by the alternation of plain white pagoda body and black-bright eaves, solid and simple, standing on the lush Yuyin Mountain and appearing particularly eye-catching.

Inside the brick-stone structure Longzhao Pagoda there are winding corridors; the Buddha statue sitting at the bottom of the pagoda and the Guanyin statue standing upright at the top of the pagoda are both available for tourists to worship.

Longzhao Pagoda was built facing the river, high on the mountain top, with unique scenery; poets of various dynasties left many famous lines praising it.

Looking around from the top of Longzhao Pagoda, one can see important landscapes such as the Zhou River, Zhou River Bridge, and Dazhou city scenery, with myriad phenomena; and the White Pagoda itself has also become one of the landmark buildings of Dazhou city.

真佛山群庙

Temples at Zhenfo Mountain
国家级 清 建筑群
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address达州市达县福善乡清河村
类型 Type建筑群
看点 Highlights: 形制 山势 合院

中文描述 Description

真佛山群庙位于四川达州市达县福善乡清河村以南的真佛山。

这是难得的集儒、释、道三教为一体的群庙建筑。

道光十八年(1838年)竣工的群庙前后经多次修整，寺庙建筑保存完好，于1981年位于省级文物保护单位之列，现为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。

真佛山群庙在海拔710米的高山上依山势而造，与周围茂盛的林木相映成趣。

群庙的总占地面积为4万平方米，当中的建筑面积有1.5万平方米，规模庞大，均是传统的四合院布局，顺着延绵的山势铺陈直达巍峨的山顶。

从山脚至山门共有1179级石阶，由山门向上依次为戏楼、天王殿、天子殿、德化寺、大雄宝殿等建筑，建筑多为近年整修，采用清代建筑式样，古迹不多。

虽然古风不再，但身处青山佛庙之中，望着袅袅的云烟、听着悠扬的钟声、闻着幽幽的焚香，仿佛置身世外，颇有超凡脱俗之感。

英文翻译 English Translation

The Temples at Zhenfo Mountain are located on Zhenfo Mountain, south of Qinghe Village, Fushan Township, Da County, Dazhou City, Sichuan.

This is a rare group of temple buildings integrating Confucianism, Buddhism, and Daoism as one.

The group of temples, completed in the 18th year of Daoguang (1838), has undergone multiple renovations before and after; the temple buildings are well preserved, and in 1981 were listed among provincial cultural relic protection units; now they are the 7th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units.

The Temples at Zhenfo Mountain are built according to the mountain terrain on a high mountain at an altitude of 710m, contrasting delightfully with the surrounding lush forests.

The total site area of the temple group is 40,000 sq m, among which the building area is 15,000 sq m, with a large scale; all are traditional siheyuan layouts, spreading along the continuous mountain terrain straight to the towering mountain top.

From the foot of the mountain to the mountain gate there are a total of 1,179 stone steps; upward from the mountain gate are sequentially the theater tower, Heavenly Kings Hall, Son of Heaven Hall, Dehua Temple, Mahavira Hall, and other buildings; the buildings were mostly renovated in recent years, adopting Qing dynasty architectural styles, with few ancient relics.

Although the ancient style is no longer, being in the green mountain and Buddhist temple, watching the curling clouds and smoke, listening to the melodious bell, and smelling the faint incense, one feels as if placed outside the world, with quite a sense of transcending the mundane.

开江牌坊

Kaijiang Memorial Archway
国家级 清 牌坊
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address达州市开江县任市镇街口
类型 Type牌坊
看点 Highlights: 形制 陶雕 雕刻

中文描述 Description

位于达州市开江县的开江牌坊，融会清代绘画、雕刻、制陶等技艺与一身，是开江县最为重要的文物建筑之一。

今天所称的开江牌坊包括任市镇牌坊和甘棠镇牌坊，其中任市镇牌坊位列1991年第三批省级保护单位之中。

开江牌坊于2006年被评为全国重点文物保护单位。

任市镇牌坊位于开江县城南的任市镇街口，是为清代官员张九封的妻子刘氏、姜妾氏所立。

牌坊坐南朝北，设有三道拱门。

最为独特的是，任市镇牌坊上镶嵌有数十处陶雕，刻有人物、花鸟、题字等不同主题，雕刻精美，细节丰富，栩栩如生，展现出极高的雕刻与制陶技艺。

虽然历经百年风雨，这些陶艺雕绘仍然保存完好，清晰可辨。

甘棠镇牌坊位于开江县甘棠乡五幅桥村雷家坡的庭院旁，是清宣宗道光二十四年(1844年)为清代胡的妻子胡氏立的。

甘棠镇牌坊为东西走向，正中间明间为拱门，次间为方形门洞。

明间檐下刻有圣旨二字，其下有坤维正气柏节松龄两块匾额分置两面。

牌坊上另有龙凤呈祥琼楼玉宇等精美的浮雕，看上去十分华丽。

两座开江牌坊均保存完好，充分展现了清末开江地区的建筑工艺水准与独特之处。

英文翻译 English Translation

The Kaijiang Memorial Archway, located in Kaijiang County, Dazhou City, integrates Qing dynasty painting, carving, pottery-making and other skills as one, and is one of the most important cultural relic buildings in Kaijiang County.

The Kaijiang Memorial Archway referred to today includes the archway at Renshi Town and the archway at Gantang Town; among them, the archway at Renshi Town was listed in the 3rd batch of provincial protection units in 1991.

The Kaijiang Memorial Archway was rated as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit in 2006.

The archway at Renshi Town is located at the street entrance of Renshi Town, south of Kaijiang County town, and was erected for Liu Shi and Jiang Qieshi, the wives of the Qing official Zhang Jiufeng.

The archway faces south, with three arched doors.

The most unique is that on the archway at Renshi Town there are inlaid dozens of pottery carvings, engraved with different themes such as figures, flowers and birds, and inscriptions, with exquisite carving, rich details, and lifelike appearance, showing extremely high carving and pottery-making skills.

Although having experienced a hundred years of wind and rain, these pottery art carvings and paintings are still well preserved, clearly distinguishable.

The archway at Gantang Town is located beside the courtyard at Leijiapo, Wufuqiao Village, Gantang Township, Kaijiang County, and was erected in the 24th year of Daoguang of Emperor Xuanzong of Qing (1844) for Hu Shi, the wife of Hu of Qing.

The archway at Gantang Town runs east-west; the central mingjian is an arched door, and the secondary jian are square door openings.

Under the eave of the mingjian there are engraved the two characters Imperial Decree, below which there are two plaques of Kunwei Zhengqi and Bojie Songling placed on both sides.

On the archway there are additionally exquisite reliefs such as Dragon and Phoenix Presenting Auspiciousness and Jade Towers and Jade Pavilions, looking very gorgeous.

Both Kaijiang Memorial Archways are well preserved, fully showing the architectural craft level and unique features of the Kaijiang area in late Qing.

渠县文庙

Temple of Confucius in Qu County
国家级 清 文庙
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty清
地址 Address达州市渠县县城
类型 Type文庙
看点 Highlights: 完整形制 规模 书法

中文描述 Description

渠县文庙位于四川省达州市渠县的县城内。

渠县历代文风昌盛，早在宋朝之前就建有文庙来供奉孔子，现存的文庙是清嘉庆二十五年(1820年)动工重修的，工程前后历时150多年才竣工，并于2013年入选为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。

渠县文庙布局完整，气势宏大。

一进文庙，就被朱红甬壁所吸引，甬壁正反都书有宫墙万仞，相传是康熙帝的手书。

甬壁之后是半月形的泮池，池上悬有三座石桥，有两条精雕的蟠龙卧于中桥的两头，甚是气派。

桥的尽端引向一座高大的牌坊——棂星门。

棂星门之后是供奉孔子的大成殿，大成殿内庄严肃穆，孔子主体立于大成殿正中，左右各卧龙相伴，上方悬有万世师表的匾额。

见贤思齐焉，见不贤而内自省也，在供奉孔子的文庙中吟诵论语，如同穿越到春秋时期，成为孔子三千弟子之一，实现自己求学于仲尼的梦想。

英文翻译 English Translation

The Temple of Confucius in Qu County is located in the county town of Qu County, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province.

Qu County has had a flourishing literary style throughout the dynasties; as early as before the Song dynasty, a Confucian temple was built to enshrine Confucius.

The existing Confucian temple was started to be rebuilt in the 25th year of Jiaqing (1820), Qing; the project took over 150 years before and after to be completed, and in 2013 was selected as the 7th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units.

The Temple of Confucius in Qu County has a complete layout and grand momentum.

Upon entering the Confucian temple, one is attracted by the vermilion corridor wall; on both the front and back of the corridor wall there are written the four characters Palace Wall Ten Thousand Ren, said to be the handwriting of the Kangxi Emperor.

Behind the corridor wall is the crescent-shaped Pan Pool; above the pool there hang three stone bridges, with two exquisitely carved coiling dragons lying at both ends of the middle bridge, very imposing.

The end of the bridge leads to a tall archway — the Lingxing Gate.

Behind the Lingxing Gate is the Dacheng Hall enshrining Confucius; inside the Dacheng Hall it is solemn and majestic; the main body of Confucius stands in the center of the Dacheng Hall, accompanied by coiling dragons on the left and right, and above hangs the plaque of Teacher of Ten Thousand Generations.

When seeing virtue, think of equaling it; when seeing un-virtue, examine yourself internally — reciting the Analects in the Confucian temple enshrining Confucius is like traveling back to the Spring and Autumn period, becoming one of Confucius's three thousand disciples, and realizing one's dream of studying under Zhongni.

冯焕阙

Feng Huan Tower
国家级 东汉 石阙
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty东汉
地址 Address达州市渠县北土溪镇汉阙村
类型 Type石阙
看点 Highlights: 汉阙 浮雕 铭文

中文描述 Description

冯焕阙位于渠县北土溪镇汉阙村(原名赵家坪)，距离渠县土溪火车站约为10公里，始建于东汉建光元年(121年)或建光二年，是为东汉幽州刺史冯焕平冤而设。

冯焕阙的阙身挺拔，风格朴素稳重，充分展现了四川汉阙精致简练、稳重优雅的艺术特征。

早在1961年，冯焕阙就被列入国务院批准的第一批全国重点文物保护单位。

在农田之中，一眼即可见安详矗立在围墙院落中高耸的冯焕阙。

这是一座完整的仿木石构，阙高4.38米，宽约0.8米，由六个部分组成，分别是阙顶、斗拱层、介石、枋子层、阙身、阙基。

下部平直厚重，无多余雕饰，上刻铭文：故尚书侍郎河南京令豫州幽州刺史冯使君道，告知此阙身世。

铭文书法遒劲张扬，是汉代书法遗存中的瑰宝，还被收入北宋李清照、赵明诚的著作《金石录》当中。

冯焕阙上部则丰富精细，由三层青石堆叠而成，配有青龙、玄武等精细浮雕。

阙顶为双层檐，上覆瓦，有草叶纹饰，很是细腻。

凝视着这经受两千多年沧桑仍保持着朴实素净而又优雅超凡的汉阙，一种历史的厚重感油然而生。

英文翻译 English Translation

Feng Huan Tower is located in Hanque Village (formerly Zhaojiaping), Tuxi Town, north of Qu County, about 10km from the Tuxi Railway Station of Qu County.

It was first built in the 1st year of Jianguang (121) or the 2nd year of Jianguang of Eastern Han, and was erected to redress the injustice of Feng Huan, the Inspector of Youzhou in Eastern Han.

The tower body of Feng Huan Tower is tall and straight, with a simple and steady style, fully showing the exquisite, concise, steady, and elegant artistic characteristics of Sichuan Han towers.

As early as 1961, Feng Huan Tower was listed in the first batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units approved by the State Council.

In the farmland, at a glance one can see Feng Huan Tower towering and peacefully standing in the walled courtyard.

This is a complete imitation-timber stone structure; the tower is 4.38m high and about 0.8m wide, composed of six parts, respectively the tower top, bracket-set layer, intermediate stone, lintel layer, tower body, and tower base.

The lower part is straight and heavy, without redundant carvings and decorations; on it is engraved the inscription: Former Shangshu Shilang, Henan Jingling, Yuzhou Youzhou Cishi Feng Shijun Dao, informing the origin of this tower.

The inscription calligraphy is vigorous and flamboyant, a treasure among Han dynasty calligraphy remains, and was also included in the work Jinshi Lu (Records of Metal and Stone) by Li Qingzhao and Zhao Mingcheng of Northern Song.

The upper part of Feng Huan Tower is rich and delicate, stacked from three layers of bluestone, equipped with fine reliefs such as Azure Dragon and Black Tortoise.

The tower top is a double eave, covered with tiles, with grass-leaf patterns, very delicate.

Gazing at this Han tower that, after over two thousand years of vicissitudes, still maintains simplicity, purity, elegance, and transcendence, a sense of historical heaviness arises spontaneously.

渠县汉阙

Stone Towers of the Han Dynasty in Qu County
国家级 东汉 石阙
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty东汉
地址 Address达州市渠县
类型 Type石阙
看点 Highlights: 汉阙 浮雕 铭文

中文描述 Description

汉晋两朝，渠县为四川东部的政治中心，因而其留存着较多珍贵精美的汉阙，闻名全国，被称为中国汉阙之乡。

除了进入首批全国重点文物保护单位的冯焕阙与沈府君阙以外，阙身无铭文的蒲家湾汉阙、赵家村汉阙、王家坪汉阙也进入了第五批全国重点文物保护单位，它们与冯焕阙、沈府君阙一起，合称渠县汉阙。

距沈府君阙不远，沿着乡间新铺的水泥路一路向前，便可到达蒲家湾无铭阙，这是一处位于堰塘旁边的汉阙，没有围墙保护，显得单薄而沧桑。

蒲家湾无铭阙本为双阙，但可惜西侧已毁，现仅存东侧主阙，上雕朱雀、青龙、花草、玉兔等图饰。

赵家村东无铭阙与赵家村西无铭阙均位于赵家村，此二阙原均为双阙，但均被毁坏而仅剩一阙。

赵家村东无铭阙仅存东阙，上雕朱雀，内刻青龙，下饰玄武，阙背雕刻狩猎图样，雕刻技艺精妙异常。

赵家村西无铭阙仅存西阙，造型同赵家村东无铭阙，与冯焕阙为邻，阙背雕刻有人物图案，惟妙惟肖。

王家坪无铭阙位于冯焕阙与沈府君阙之间，也为双阙结构，但仅存东阙主阙。

王家坪无铭阙正面也无铭文，施以朱雀、青龙、异兽等雕刻，阙背有人物、玉兔等浮雕图景，栩栩如生，别具一格。

英文翻译 English Translation

During the Han and Jin dynasties, Qu County was the political center of eastern Sichuan, hence it retains more precious and exquisite Han towers, famous nationwide, and is called the Hometown of Han Towers in China.

Besides Feng Huan Tower and Shen Fujun Tower which entered the first batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units, the Pujiawan Han Tower, Zhaojiacun Han Tower, and Wangjiaping Han Tower, whose tower bodies have no inscriptions, also entered the 5th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units; together with Feng Huan Tower and Shen Fujun Tower, they are collectively called the Stone Towers of the Han Dynasty in Qu County.

Not far from Shen Fujun Tower, walking forward along the newly paved cement road in the countryside, one can reach the Pujiawan Uninscribed Tower; this is a Han tower located beside a pond, without wall protection, appearing thin and weathered.

The Pujiawan Uninscribed Tower was originally a double tower, but unfortunately the west side has been destroyed, and now only the east main tower survives, on which are carved decorative patterns such as Vermilion Bird, Azure Dragon, flowers and plants, and Jade Rabbit.

Both the East Zhaojiacun Uninscribed Tower and the West Zhaojiacun Uninscribed Tower are located in Zhaojiacun; these two towers were originally both double towers, but both were destroyed leaving only one tower.

The East Zhaojiacun Uninscribed Tower only has the east tower surviving, on which is carved the Vermilion Bird, inside is engraved the Azure Dragon, below is decorated with the Black Tortoise, and on the back of the tower is carved a hunting pattern, with extremely exquisite carving skills.

The West Zhaojiacun Uninscribed Tower only has the west tower surviving, with the same shape as the East Zhaojiacun Uninscribed Tower, adjacent to Feng Huan Tower; on the back of the tower there are carved figure patterns, lifelike.

The Wangjiaping Uninscribed Tower is located between Feng Huan Tower and Shen Fujun Tower, also a double-tower structure, but only the east main tower survives.

The front of the Wangjiaping Uninscribed Tower also has no inscription, with carvings such as Vermilion Bird, Azure Dragon, and exotic beasts; on the back of the tower there are relief scenes such as figures and Jade Rabbit, lifelike and unique.

沈府君阙

Shen Fujun Tower
国家级 东汉 石阙
级别 Level国家级
年代 Dynasty东汉
地址 Address达州市渠县水口乡汉亭村燕家场
类型 Type石阙
看点 Highlights: 双阙 浮雕 铭文

中文描述 Description

沈府君阙位于渠县水口乡汉亭村燕家场，与冯焕阙的距离并不太远。

沈府君阙始建于东汉延光年间(122—125年)，雕刻精巧，造型古朴，为现今汉阙中仅存的双阙结构，因而被收入为第一批全国重点文物保护单位。

我们到的时候，只见沈府君阙被水磨围墙所围，围墙上的大门也上了锁，因而我们只能在围墙外瞻仰这一汉代瑰宝。

沈府君阙为东西双阙，两阙相距21.62米，大小相仿，均高4.82米，宽0.98米，厚0.66米，子阙均已损毁，仅余母阙。

两阙正面分别刻有汉谒者北屯司马左都侯沈府君神道以及汉新丰令交趾都尉沈府君神道的汉隶铭文，铭文四周以朱雀、饕餮、青龙、白虎所环绕，雕刻精美。

两阙阙身的内侧雕刻有所不同，东阙上雕青龙，似腾云之状，西阙则为白虎，做前扑之势。

两阙还有农业生产、商业活动、神话传说等各式雕刻，内容丰富，极富趣味。

沈府君阙因其完好的双阙形制，成为我国汉阙建筑中的精品。

英文翻译 English Translation

Shen Fujun Tower is located at Yanchangchang, Hanting Village, Shuikou Township, Qu County, not too far from Feng Huan Tower.

Shen Fujun Tower was first built during the Eastern Han Yanguang era (122-125), with exquisite carving and simple and ancient shape; it is the only surviving double-tower structure among current Han towers, hence it was included as the first batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units.

When we arrived, we saw that Shen Fujun Tower was surrounded by a water-milled wall, and the gate on the wall was also locked, so we could only look up at this Han dynasty treasure from outside the wall.

Shen Fujun Tower is an east-west double tower; the two towers are 21.62m apart, similar in size, both 4.82m high, 0.98m wide, and 0.66m thick; the sub-towers have all been damaged, leaving only the main towers.

On the front of the two towers there are respectively engraved Han clerical inscriptions of Spirit Path of Shen Fujun, Han Yezhe Beitun Sima Zuo Duhou, and Spirit Path of Shen Fujun, Han Xinfeng Ling Jiaozhi Duwei; around the inscriptions are surrounded by Vermilion Bird, Taotie, Azure Dragon, and White Tiger, with exquisite carving.

The inner side carvings of the two tower bodies are different; on the east tower there is carved an Azure Dragon, seemingly in a cloud-soaring state, while the west tower is a White Tiger, in a forward-pouncing posture.

The two towers also have various carvings such as agricultural production, commercial activities, and myths and legends, with rich content and great interest.

Due to its intact double-tower form, Shen Fujun Tower has become a fine example among China's Han tower architecture.
